body.text: <3.5.9> (15.9) agnau praṇīyamāne <agne prehi [4.14.5]> iti japitvā bahirvedy upaviśati ||
body.translated_text: When the fire is being led forward, having muttered [the verse] "agne prehi" (O <s>Agni</s>, go forth) [4.14.5], he sits down outside the <s>Vedi</s>.

body.text: <3.5.10> (15.10) dakṣiṇahavirdhānasya vartmābhihomam <idaṃ viṣṇuḥ [7.26.4]> iti | uttarasya <trīṇi padā [7.26.5]> iti ||
body.translated_text: The offering at the path of the southern <s>Havirdhāna</s> (Soma-cart shed) [is made] with [the verse] "idaṃ viṣṇuḥ" [7.26.4]; of the northern [shed], with [the verse] "trīṇi padā" [7.26.5].

body.text: <3.5.11> (15.11) havirdhāne pravartyamāne <itaś ca mā [18.3.38-39]> iti dvābhyām anumantrayate ||
body.translated_text: When the <s>Havirdhāna</s> carts are being rolled forward, he recites the approval mantra with two [verses beginning with] "itaś ca mā" [18.3.38-39].
With [the verse] "viṣṇor nu kam" [7.26.1], [he recites over] the support being fixed in place.
With [the verse] "manve vāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī" [4.26.1], the offering at the <s>Audumbarī</s> (fig-wood post).

body.text: <3.5.14> (15.14) agnīṣomayoḥ praṇayanāyāmantritas tīrthena patnīśālam āvrajati | cātvālotkarāv antareṇāgnīdhrīyalakṣaṇam uttareṇa sadaś ceti tīrtham ||
body.translated_text: When summoned for the bringing forth of <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>, he walks to the wives' hall by the prescribed path. The path is: between the <s>Cātvāla</s> (pit) and <s>Utkara</s> (heap), by the mark of the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> [fire], and north of the <s>Sadas</s> (assembly hall).
[The procedure extends] from the sipping of water to the examination [of the animal].
With the half-verse "somaṃ rājānam" [3.20.4ab], he follows <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s> being led forth.
After the offering in the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> fire, passing north of the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> fire and beyond it, he sits down at the seat.

body.text: <3.5.18> (15.18) athāgnīṣomīye paśāv uktā dharmāḥ | etena paśavo vyākhyātāḥ ||
body.translated_text: Now the rules stated for the <s>Āgnīṣomīya</s> (animal sacrifice to <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>) animal [apply]. By this, [all] animal [sacrifices] are explained.
[The rite] ends with the <s>Patnīsaṃyājas</s> (offerings for the wives).

children.text: <3.6.1> (16.1) vasatīvarīḥ parihriyamāṇāḥ <pūrṇa. nāri prabhara [3.12.8]> ity anumantrayate |
children.translated_text: He recites the approval mantra over the <s>Vasatīvarī</s> waters (overnight waters) being brought around with [the verse] "pūrṇā nāri prabhara" (O full woman, bring forth) [3.12.8].
And [over them] being placed in the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> [shed] with the subsequent [verse] "amūr yāḥ" [1.4.2].

body.translated_text: The consecrated one dwells there.
In the latter part of the night, the priests, having been awakened, sip water at the entrance of the hall.

body.text: <3.6.5> (16.5) havirupāvahṛta ityādi vaiśvānaro 'gniṣṭoma ityantābhir yajñatanūbhiḥ purā pracaritor āgnīdhrīye juhoti ||
body.translated_text: Starting from "havirupāvahṛta" and ending with "vaiśvānaro 'gniṣṭomaḥ," he offers in the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> fire with the sacrificial formulas (<s>yajñatanū</s>) before the commencement of the rite.

body.text: <3.6.6> (16.6) <yajūṃṣi yajñe [5.26]> iti ca | viṣpardhāyāṃ caturbhiścaturbhiḥ purastāt prātaranuvākasya ||
body.translated_text: And with [the verse] "yajūṃṣi yajñe" [5.26]. In the contest, [he offers] with four [verses] at a time before the morning litany.
Having passed south of the <s>Āhavanīya</s> (offering fire) and beyond it, he sits down at the seat.

body.text: <3.6.8> (16.8) upaviṣṭe hotari hotāraṃ <yad asmṛti [7.106]> iti hutvā purastāddhomān juhoti ||
body.translated_text: When the <s>Hotṛ</s> (invoking priest) has sat down, having offered to the <s>Hotṛ</s> with [the verse] "yad asmṛti" [7.106], he offers the preliminary oblations.

body.text: <3.6.9> (16.9) <pātaṃ na indrāpūṣaṇā [6.3-6]> iti catvāri sūktāni prātaranuvākam anu japati ||
body.translated_text: He mutters four hymns beginning with "pātaṃ na indrāpūṣaṇā" [6.3-6] following the morning litany.
Three [hymns beginning with] "ambayo yanti" [1.4-6] for the <s>Āponaptrīya</s> (offering to <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s>).

body.text: <3.6.11> (16.11) <indra juṣasva [2.5]> iti rājñy abhiṣūyamāṇe 'bhiṣavaṇahomān juhoti | upāṃśugrahahomam <sūryo dyām <13.1.45]> ity udite | antaryāmīyaṃ ca ||
body.translated_text: With [the verse] "indra juṣasva" [2.5], when King [<s>Soma</s>] is being pressed, he offers the pressing oblations. The <s>Upāṃśu-graha</s> (silent cup) offering [is made] with "sūryo dyām" [13.1.45] when [the sun] has risen. And the <s>Antaryāma</s> [cup offering] likewise.

body.text: <3.6.12> (16.12) havirdhāne pūrveṇātītya khare copaviśya <divas pṛthivyāḥ [9.1]> iti madhusūktena rājānaṃ saṃśrayati ||
body.translated_text: Having passed through the <s>Havirdhāna</s> from the east and sat down at the pressing-stone pit, with the <s>Madhu-sūkta</s> (honey hymn) "divas pṛthivyāḥ" [9.1], he attends upon King [<s>Soma</s>].
With [the verse] "indrāya somam ṛtvijaḥ" [6.2], he recites the approval mantra over [the <s>Soma</s>] placed in the <s>Droṇakalaśa</s> (wooden trough).
With [the verse] "dhṛṣat piba" (Boldly drink) [7.76.2], at the midday pressing.

body.text:
<3.6.15> (16.15) yatra vijānāti <brahmant somo 'skan> iti tam etayālabhyābhimantrayate <abhūd devaḥ savitā vandyo nū na idānīm ahna upavācyo nṛbhiḥ | vi yo ratnā bhajati mānavebhyaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ no atra draviṇaṃ yathā dadhat [ṚV 4.54.1]> iti || [GB 2.2.12]
<3.6.16> (16.16) <ye agnayo apsv antaḥ [3.21.1-7]> iti saptabhir abhijuhoti ||
body.translated_text: Where he recognizes [the signal] "brahmant somo 'skan" (O <s>Brahman</s> priest, the <s>Soma</s> has flowed), he touches it and addresses it with [the verse]: "abhūd devaḥ savitā vandyo nū naḥ" (The god <s>Savitṛ</s> is now to be praised by us, to be invoked by men at this time of day, who distributes treasures to the people, bestowing the best wealth upon us) [ṚV 4.54.1] [GB 2.2.12]. (16.16) With seven [verses beginning with] "ye agnayo apsv antaḥ" [3.21.1-7], he offers.

body.text: <3.6.17> (16.17) adhvaryuḥ pratiprasthātā prastotodgātā pratihartā brahmā sunvan samanvārabdhā bahiṣpavamānāya visṛpya vaipruṣān homān juhvati <drapsaś caskanda [18.4.28, PS 20.13.7]> iti || <yas te drapsaḥ skandati yas te aṃśur bāhucyuto dhiṣaṇāyā upasthāt | adhvaryor vā pari yaḥ pavitrāt taṃ te juhomi manasā vaṣaṭkṛtam || drapsaḥ patito 'tyasyavaś ca yaḥ paraḥ srucaḥ | ayaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ saṃ taṃ siñcatu rādhase || yas te drapsaḥ patitaḥ pṛthivyāṃ dhānāsomaḥ parīvāpaḥ karambhaḥ | ayaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ saṃ taṃ siñcatu varcase || [PS 20.13.8-10]> <yan me skannam [sakala at KauśS 6.1, not attested elsewhere]> iti ||
body.translated_text: The <s>Adhvaryu</s>, the <s>Pratiprasthātṛ</s>, the <s>Prastotṛ</s>, the <s>Udgātṛ</s>, the <s>Pratihartṛ</s>, and the <s>Brahman</s>, pressing together while holding on to each other, having gone out for the <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s> (outside Pavamāna chant), offer the sprinkling oblations with [the mantras] "drapsaś caskanda" (The drop fell) [18.4.28, PS 20.13.7] — "yas te drapsaḥ skandati" (Whatever drop of yours falls) [PS 20.13.8-10], "yan me skannam" (Whatever of mine has been spilt) [KauśS 6.1].
They sit down south of the <s>Cātvāla</s> (pit).
Muttering "doṣo gāya" [6.1], he looks at the <s>Udgātṛ</s> (chanting priest).

body.text: <3.7.3> (17.3) stotropākaraṇāt prastotā brahmāṇam āmantrayate <brahman stoṣyāmaḥ praśāstaḥ> iti ||
body.translated_text: Before the commencement of the <s>Stotra</s> (chant), the <s>Prastotṛ</s> (leader of the chant) addresses the <s>Brahman</s> priest: "brahman stoṣyāmaḥ praśāstaḥ" (O <s>Brahman</s>, we shall chant; direct us).

body.text: <3.7.4> (17.4) tatra <raśmir asi kṣayāya tvā kṣayaṃ jinva | savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta | deva savitar etat te prāha tat pra ca suva pra ca yaja | āyuṣmatyā ṛco māpagāyata tanūpāt sāmnaḥ | satyā va āśiṣaḥ santu satyā ākūtayaḥ | ṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ ca vadata | bṛhaspate 'numatyoṃ bhūr janad indravanta ity uktvā <stuta> iti prathamayā svaramātrayā prasauti | madhyamayā mādhyaṃdine | uttamayā tṛtīyasavane ||
body.translated_text: Thereupon [he recites]: "raśmir asi kṣayāya tvā kṣayaṃ jinva" (You are the ray; for dominion I take you; prosper dominion), "savitṛprasūtā bṛhaspataye stuta" (Impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, praised for <s>Bṛhaspati</s>), "deva savitar etat te prāha tat pra ca suva pra ca yaja" (O god <s>Savitṛ</s>, that which belongs to you, promote and sacrifice that), "āyuṣmatyā ṛco māpagāyata tanūpāt sāmnaḥ" (Do not sing away the life-giving <s>Ṛc</s> verses; protect the body of the <s>Sāman</s>), "satyā va āśiṣaḥ santu satyā ākūtayaḥ" (May your blessings be true, your intentions true), "ṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ ca vadata" (Speak <s>Ṛta</s> (cosmic order) and <s>Satya</s> (truth)), "bṛhaspate 'numatyoṃ bhūr janad indravanta" (O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, with the consent of <s>Anumati</s> — Oṃ, Bhūr, Janat, O possessors of <s>Indra</s>). Having said this, he gives the signal "stuta" (chant) with the first <s>Svaramātrā</s> (tonal measure) [at the morning pressing]; with the middle one at the midday pressing; with the last one at the third pressing.
"Bhuvaḥ" at the midday pressing; "Svar" at the third pressing.

body.text: <3.7.6> (17.6) ukthyādiṣv ahīne ca oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad vṛdhat karad ruhan mahat tac cham om iti ca ||
body.translated_text: In the <s>Ukthya</s> and other [rites] and in the <s>Ahīna</s>, [he recites] "oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad vṛdhat karad ruhan mahat tac cham om" and so forth.

body.text:
<3.7.7> (17.7) viṣpardhamānayoḥ savṛtasomayoḥ stomabhāgānām uparyupari <stuteṣe stutorje stuta devasya savituḥ save | bṛhaspatiṃ vaḥ prajāpatiṃ vo vasūn vo devān rudrān vo devān ādityān vo devān sādhyān vo devān āpyān vo devān viśvān vo devān sarvān vo devān viśvatas pari havāmahe | janebhyo 'smākam astu kevala itaḥ kṛṇotu vīryam> iti japan pareṣāṃ brahmāṇam avekṣeta || [GB 2.2.15]
<3.7.8> (17.8) <stutasya stutam asy ūrjasvat payasvat | ūrjaṃ mahyaṃ stutaṃ duhām ā mā stutasya stutaṃ gamet | indriyāvanto havāmahe dhukṣīmahi prajām iṣam | sā me satyāśīr deveṣv astu | brahmavarcasaṃ mā gamayet [cf. TS 3.2.7.1-2]> iti stotram anumantrayate ||
body.translated_text: In the two <s>Viṣpardhamāna</s> and two <s>Savṛtasoma</s> [sacrifices], above the portions of the <s>Stoma</s>, [he recites] "stuteṣe stutorje stuta devasya savituḥ save | bṛhaspatiṃ vaḥ prajāpatiṃ vo vasūn vo devān rudrān vo devān ādityān vo devān sādhyān vo devān āpyān vo devān viśvān vo devān sarvān vo devān viśvatas pari havāmahe | janebhyo 'smākam astu kevala itaḥ kṛṇotu vīryam" (In the praise of praise, in the vigor of praise, in the praised [gift] of god <s>Savitṛ</s>'s impulse — we invoke <s>Bṛhaspati</s> for you, <s>Prajāpati</s> for you, the <s>Vasus</s> as your gods, the <s>Rudras</s> as your gods, the <s>Ādityas</s> as your gods, the <s>Sādhyas</s> as your gods, the <s>Āpyas</s> as your gods, the <s>Viśve Devāḥ</s> as your gods, all gods for you, from all sides; may [the power] be solely ours among people, may it produce strength from here) [GB 2.2.15], thus muttering, he should look at the <s>Brahman</s> priest of the opponents. (17.8) With "stutasya stutam asy ūrjasvat payasvat | ūrjaṃ mahyaṃ stutaṃ duhām ā mā stutasya stutaṃ gamet | indriyāvanto havāmahe dhukṣīmahi prajām iṣam | sā me satyāśīr deveṣv astu | brahmavarcasaṃ mā gamayet" (You are the praise of praise, rich in nourishment and milk; may the praised yield nourishment for me, may the praise of praise come to me; possessed of power we invoke, may we milk forth offspring and sustenance; may that true blessing of mine be among the gods; may it bring me the splendor of sacred knowledge) [cf. TS 3.2.7.1-2], thus he consecrates the <s>Stotra</s> with mantras.
With "<s>Indra</s>sya kukṣiḥ" (The belly of <s>Indra</s>) [7.111.1], [he recites over] the <s>Pūtabhṛt</s> (purified-holding vessel) when the <s>Soma</s> is poured.

body.text: <3.7.10> (17.10) stute bahiṣpavamāne vācayati <śyeno 'si [6.48.1]> iti | <vṛṣāsi [6.48.3]> iti mādhyaṃdine | <ṛbhur asi [6.48.2]> ity ārbhave ||
body.translated_text: When the <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s> has been chanted, he has [the sacrificer] recite "śyeno 'si" (You are a falcon) [6.48.1]. [He recites] "vṛṣā asi" (You are a bull) [6.48.3] at the midday [pressing]. [He recites] "ṛbhur asi" (You are a <s>Ṛbhu</s>) [6.48.2] at the <s>Ārbhava</s> [pressing].
"As stated in the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>" — thus [say] the followers of the <s>Anubrāhmaṇa</s>.

body.text: <3.7.12> (17.12) athādhvaryur āha <agnīd agnīn vihara barhi stṛṇīhi paroḍāśān alaṃkuru [GB 2.2.16]> iti ||
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Adhvaryu</s> says: "O <s>Āgnīdhra</s>, spread the fires, strew the sacred grass, prepare the rice-cakes" [GB 2.2.16].

body.text: <3.8.1> (18.1) āgnīdhra āgnīdhrīyād aṅgārair dve savane viharati | śalākābhis tṛtīyasavanam | pratyaṅmukho hotṛmaitrāvaruṇabrāhmaṇācchaṃsipotṛneṣṭracchāvākānāṃ dhiṣṇyeṣu mārjālīye ||
body.translated_text: The <s>Āgnīdhra</s>, from the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> [fire], distributes fires with embers at the [first] two pressings; with wooden sticks at the third pressing; facing west, [he distributes] to the <s>Dhiṣṇya</s> hearths of the <s>Hotṛ</s>, <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>, <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s>, <s>Potṛ</s>, <s>Neṣṭṛ</s>, <s>Acchāvāka</s>, [and] at the <s>Mārjālīya</s>.
He brings [them] back to that very [place].
Having strewn [grass] along the back [of the altar], he prepares the rice-cakes.

body.text: <3.8.4> (18.4) <ye agnayo vihṛtā dhiṣṇyāḥ pṛthivīm anu | te naḥ pāntu te no 'vantu tebhyo namas te no mā hiṃsiṣuḥ [-]> iti vihṛtān anumantrayate | uttarayoḥ savanayoḥ <punar maitv indriyam [7.67.1]> iti | āhavanīyam apareṇetyuktam ||
body.translated_text: With "ye agnayo vihṛtā dhiṣṇyāḥ pṛthivīm anu | te naḥ pāntu te no 'vantu tebhyo namas te no mā hiṃsiṣuḥ" (Those fires that are distributed as <s>Dhiṣṇya</s> hearths upon the earth — may they protect us, may they help us, homage to them, may they not harm us), he consecrates the distributed [fires] with mantras. At the latter two pressings, [he recites] "punar maitv indriyam" (May power return to me) [7.67.1]. After the <s>Āhavanīya</s> — as stated [before].

body.text:
<3.8.5> (18.5) pravṛtāḥ pravṛtāhutīr juhvati <juṣṭo vāce bhūyāsaṃ juṣṭo vācaspataye devi vāg yad vāco madhumattamaṃ tasmin mā dhāḥ svāhā | vāce svāhā vācaspataye svāhā sarasvatyai svāhā []> iti | manasā caturthīm || [GB 2.2.17]
<3.8.6> (18.6) saptāhutīr ity eke <sarasvate svāhā mahobhyaḥ saṃmahobhyaḥ svāhā | ṛcā stomam> iti ||
body.translated_text: Having commenced, they offer the <s>Pravṛtā</s> oblations: "juṣṭo vāce bhūyāsaṃ juṣṭo vācaspataye devi vāg yad vāco madhumattamaṃ tasmin mā dhāḥ svāhā | vāce svāhā vācaspataye svāhā sarasvatyai svāhā" (May I be pleasing to Speech, pleasing to the Lord of Speech; O divine Speech, that which is sweetest of speech, in that place me, <s>Svāhā</s>; to Speech <s>Svāhā</s>, to the Lord of Speech <s>Svāhā</s>, to <s>Sarasvatī</s> <s>Svāhā</s>) [GB 2.2.17]; the fourth [oblation is offered] mentally. (18.6) Some [say] seven oblations: "sarasvate svāhā mahobhyaḥ saṃmahobhyaḥ svāhā | ṛcā stomam" (To <s>Sarasvatī</s> <s>Svāhā</s>, to the great ones, to the exceedingly great ones <s>Svāhā</s>; with the <s>Ṛc</s> verse, the <s>Stoma</s>).

body.text: <3.8.7> (18.7) vapāmārjanānta upotthāya <divas pṛṣṭhe [13.2.37]> ity ādityam upatiṣṭhante ||
body.translated_text: Having risen at the end of the <s>Vapā-mārjana</s> (omentum-purification), with "divas pṛṣṭhe" (On the back of heaven) [13.2.37], they worship the Sun (<s>Āditya</s>).

body.text: <3.8.8> (18.8) <mā pra gāma [13.1.59]> ity āvrajyāhavanīyaṃ nirmathyaṃ yūpam ādityam <agnayaḥ sagarā stha sagareṇa nāmnā raudreṇānīkena pāta māgnayaḥ pipṛta māgnayo gopāyata mā namo vo 'stu mā mā hiṃsiṣṭa [cf. VSM 5.34]> iti ||
body.translated_text: With "mā pra gāma" (May we not go forth [from the right path]) [13.1.59], having approached, [they address] the <s>Āhavanīya</s>, the churning-fire, the sacrificial post, [and] the Sun with "agnayaḥ sagarā stha sagareṇa nāmnā raudreṇānīkena pāta māgnayaḥ pipṛta māgnayo gopāyata mā namo vo 'stu mā mā hiṃsiṣṭa" (You are the fires with <s>Sagara</s>; by the name <s>Sagara</s>, with <s>Rudra</s>'s face, protect me; O fires, fill me; O fires, guard me; homage be to you; do not harm me) [cf. VSM 5.34].
They proceed north of the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> to the <s>Sadas</s> (sacrificial hall).

body.text: <3.8.10> (18.10) dhiṣṇyavanto yajamānaś ca pūrvayā dvārā prasarpanti | apare 'parayā ||
body.translated_text: Those with <s>Dhiṣṇya</s> hearths and the sacrificer enter by the front door; the others by the rear door.

body.text: <3.8.11> (18.11) sadaḥ prasṛpsyanto dhiṣṇyān namaskurvanti <dhiṣṇyebhyo namo namaḥ [cf. GB 2.2.18]> iti ||
body.translated_text: Those about to enter the <s>Sadas</s> pay homage to the <s>Dhiṣṇya</s> hearths with "dhiṣṇyebhyo namo namaḥ" (Homage, homage to the <s>Dhiṣṇya</s> hearths) [cf. GB 2.2.18].

body.text:
<3.8.12> (18.12) <draṣṭre namaḥ [ĀpŚS 12.20.6, 20.1.17 etc.]> iti draṣṭāraṃ prasarpantaḥ | <upaśrotre namaḥ [ĀpŚS 24.11.2]> ity upaśrotāram || [cf. GB 2.2.19]
<3.8.13> (18.13) cātvālotkaraśāmitrovadhyagohāstāvāagnīdhrīyācchāvākavādaṃ mārjālīyaṃ kharaṃ dhiṣṇyān anyāṃś copatiṣṭhante <agnayaḥ sagarā stha [cf. above]> iti ||
body.translated_text: With "draṣṭre namaḥ" (Homage to the seer) [ĀpŚS 12.20.6], [they address] the seer while entering. With "upaśrotre namaḥ" (Homage to the listener), [they address] the listener [cf. GB 2.2.19]. (18.13) They worship the <s>Cātvāla</s> (pit), <s>Utkara</s> (refuse heap), <s>Śāmitra</s> (slaughter-shed), <s>Uparava</s> (resonance hole), <s>Gohā</s> (cattle pen), the site of the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s>, <s>Acchāvāka</s>, singer's shed, the <s>Mārjālīya</s>, the <s>Khara</s> (hard ground), the <s>Dhiṣṇya</s> hearths, and others with "agnayaḥ sagarā stha" (You are the fires with <s>Sagara</s>) [cf. above].

body.text: <3.8.14> (18.14) <urv antarikṣaṃ vīhi [ĀpŚS 6.8.6]> iti sado 'bhimṛśanti | devī dvārau mā mā santāptaṃ [TS 3.2.4.4]> <lokaṃ me lokakṛtau kṛṇutam [1.1.12.1]> iti dvārye ||
body.translated_text: With "urv antarikṣaṃ vīhi" (Enter the wide atmosphere) [ĀpŚS 6.8.6], they touch the <s>Sadas</s>. [With] "devī dvārau mā mā santāptam" (O divine doors, do not scorch me) [TS 3.2.4.4], "lokaṃ me lokakṛtau kṛṇutam" (Make a place for me, you two world-makers) [1.1.12.1], [they address] the two door-posts.

body.text: <3.8.15> (18.15) prasṛpya <anukhyātre namaḥ [ĀpŚS 20.1.17 etc.]> ity anukhyātāram | uttareṇa dhiṣṇyān parikramya svaṃ svaṃ dhiṣṇyam abhiprasṛptāḥ <upadraṣṭre namaḥ [ĀpŚS 20.1.17]> ity upadraṣṭāram ||
body.translated_text: Having entered, with "anukhyātre namaḥ" (Homage to the observer) [ĀpŚS 20.1.17], [they address] the observer. Having gone around north of the <s>Dhiṣṇya</s> hearths, when they have crawled to their own respective <s>Dhiṣṇya</s>, [they say] "upadraṣṭre namaḥ" (Homage to the witness) [ĀpŚS 20.1.17], [addressing] the witness.

body.text: <3.8.16> (18.16) upaviśya japanty <abhi tvendra [6.99.1]> iti | stotraṃ yajamānaḥ ||
body.translated_text: Having sat down, they mutter "abhi tvā indra" (O <s>Indra</s>, [we come] to you) [6.99.1]. The sacrificer [chants] the <s>Stotra</s>.

body.text: <3.8.17> (18.17) sadasyo brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇena | stotrānumantraṇāj <janat> iti manasā ||
body.translated_text: The <s>Sadasya</s> (hall-attendant) [sits] to the south of the <s>Brahman</s> priest. [He recites] "janat" from the <s>Stotra</s> consecration mentally.

body.text: <3.8.18> (18.18) visaṃsthite yathādhiṣṇyam uttareṇa pūrvayā dvārā niṣkrāmanti | maitrāvaruṇadhiṣṇyam adhiṣṇyavantaḥ ||
body.translated_text: When [the rite] has concluded, they exit by the front door, north [of the hearths], according to their <s>Dhiṣṇya</s> [positions]. Those with <s>Dhiṣṇya</s> hearths [exit via] the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> <s>Dhiṣṇya</s>.
Of the <s>Savanīya</s> (pressing-day) rice-cakes, [those are] dedicated to <s>Indra</s>.

Of the dual-deity [cakes]: for the <s>Aindravāyava</s> (dedicated to <s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>), the two oblations [are made with] "vāyur antarikṣasya" (<s>Vāyu</s> of the atmosphere) [5.24.8] and "indravāyū" (<s>Indra</s> and <s>Vāyu</s>) [3.20.6].
For the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> (dedicated to <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>), [he recites] "mitrāvaruṇau vṛṣṭyāḥ" (<s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> of the rain) [5.24.5].
For the <s>Āśvina</s> (dedicated to the <s>Aśvins</s>), [he recites] with the half-verse "aśvinā brahmaṇā" (<s>Aśvins</s>, with sacred prayer) [5.26.12ab].

body.text: <3.9.5> (19.5) prasthitaiś cariṣyann adhvaryuḥ saṃpreṣyati <hotar yaja praśāstar brāhmaṇācchaṃsin potar neṣṭar agnīt [cf. ĀpŚS 12.23.16, 12.24.1]> iti ||
body.translated_text: When about to perform with the <s>Prasthita</s> (set-forth) [offerings], the <s>Adhvaryu</s> gives the order: "O <s>Hotṛ</s>, sacrifice; O <s>Praśāstṛ</s>, O <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s>, O <s>Potṛ</s>, O <s>Neṣṭṛ</s>, O <s>Āgnīdhra</s>" [cf. ĀpŚS 12.23.16, 12.24.1].

body.text: <3.9.6> (19.6) <indra tvā vṛṣabhaṃ vayam [20.1.1]> iti brāhmaṇācchaṃsī yajati | uttarābhyāṃ potrāgnīdhrau ||
body.translated_text: With "indra tvā vṛṣabhaṃ vayam" (O <s>Indra</s>, you the bull, we...) [20.1.1], the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s> sacrifices. With the next two [verses], the <s>Potṛ</s> and <s>Āgnīdhra</s>.
The [final syllable] floats within the offering verses.
"ye yajāmahe vauṣaṭ" — the beginning and end [are prolonged]; the initial syllables are prolonged (<s>Ādipluta</s>).

body.text: <3.9.9> (19.9) anavānaṃ prātaḥsavane | vaṣaṭkṛtya <vāg ojaḥ saha ojo mayi prāṇāpānau [VSM 36.1, GB 2.3.6]> ity anumantrayate ||
body.translated_text: The <s>Anavāna</s> [rite is performed] at the morning pressing. After the <s>Vaṣaṭ</s> call, he consecrates [it] with "vāg ojaḥ saha ojo mayi prāṇāpānau" (Speech, vigor, strength, vigor in me, <s>Prāṇa</s> and <s>Apāna</s>) [VSM 36.1, GB 2.3.6].
With "somasyāgne vīhī" (O <s>Agni</s>, convey the <s>Soma</s>) [ĀpŚS 19.3.1, GB 2.3.1], with a prolonged final syllable, they perform the <s>Anuvaṣaṭkāra</s> (response call).
The <s>Śukra</s>, <s>Amanthi</s>, and <s>Camasa</s> (cup) oblations dedicated to <s>Indra</s> [are offered with] "indro divaḥ" (<s>Indra</s> of heaven) [5.24.11].

body.text: <3.9.12> (19.12) anuvaṣaṭkārāṇām <ā devānām [19.59.3]> iti | anuhomāṃś ca | maitrāvaruṇam aindraṃ mārutaṃ tvāṣṭram āgneyam ||
body.translated_text: For the <s>Anuvaṣaṭkāras</s> (response calls), [he recites] "ā devānām" (Unto the gods) [19.59.3]; and the subsequent oblations — the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>, the <s>Aindra</s>, the <s>Māruta</s>, the <s>Tvāṣṭra</s>, the <s>Āgneya</s>.

body.text: <3.9.13> (19.13) agnīdheṣṭe 'dhvaryur āha <ayāḍ agnīt [ĀpŚS 12.24.3]> iti | <ayāṭ> ity agnīt ||
body.translated_text: When the <s>Āgnīdhra</s> has made his offering, the <s>Adhvaryu</s> says "ayāḍ agnīt" (The <s>Āgnīdhra</s> has obtained) [ĀpŚS 12.24.3]. The <s>Āgnīdhra</s> [responds] "ayāṭ" (It has been obtained).
The <s>Iḍā</s>-partaking [is performed] as before.
Seated in the <s>Sadas</s>, having been invited, they partake of the <s>Soma</s> draughts.

body.text: <3.9.16> (19.16) prāśitravat pratīkṣya pratigṛhya <agnihutasyendrapītasyendor indriyāvataḥ | yo bhakṣo gosanir aśvasanir dhanasaniḥ prajāsanir lokasaniḥ | tasya ta upahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi gāyatreṇa chandasā tejasā brāhmaṇavarcasena [KātyŚS 9.12.3-4, ĀpŚS 12.25.16-23]> iti ||
body.translated_text: Having watched for the <s>Prāśitra</s> (fore-portion), having received [it], [he recites] "agnihutasyendrapītasyendor indriyāvataḥ | yo bhakṣo gosanir aśvasanir dhanasaniḥ prajāsanir lokasaniḥ | tasya ta upahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi gāyatreṇa chandasā tejasā brāhmaṇavarcasena" (Of what is offered to <s>Agni</s>, drunk by <s>Indra</s>, of <s>Soma</s> possessed of power — that portion which wins cattle, wins horses, wins wealth, wins offspring, wins worlds — of that, having been invited by what has been invited, I partake, with the <s>Gāyatrī</s> meter, with radiance, with the splendor of sacred knowledge) [KātyŚS 9.12.3-4, ĀpŚS 12.25.16-23].

body.text: <3.9.17> (19.17) traiṣṭubheneti mādhyāṃdine | jāgateneti tṛtīyasavane | anuṣṭupchandaseti paryāyeṣu | paṅkticchandaseti saṃdhicamaseṣu | aticchandasety aptoryāmṇi ||
body.translated_text: "With the <s>Triṣṭubh</s>" — at the midday [pressing]. "With the <s>Jagatī</s>" — at the third pressing. "With the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> meter" — at the <s>Paryāya</s> (rotation) [rites]. "With the <s>Paṅkti</s> meter" — at the <s>Sandhi-camasa</s> (junction-cup) [rites]. "With the <s>Atichandas</s> (excess meter)" — at the <s>Aptoryāma</s>.

body.text: <3.9.18> (19.18) bhakṣita ātmānaṃ pratyabhimṛśanti <śaṃ no bhava hṛda ā pīta indro piteva soma sūnave suśevaḥ | sakheva sakhya uruśaṃsa dhīraḥ pra ṇa āyur jīvase soma tārīḥ || [GB 2.3.6]> <hinvā me gātrā harivo gaṇān me mā vyarīriṣaḥ | śivo me saptarṣīn upatiṣṭha mā me 'vāg nābhir abhi gāḥ [cf. TS 3.2.5.3]> iti ||
body.translated_text: Having partaken, they touch themselves [with the mantra] "śaṃ no bhava hṛda ā pīta indro piteva soma sūnave suśevaḥ | sakheva sakhya uruśaṃsa dhīraḥ pra ṇa āyur jīvase soma tārīḥ" (Be auspicious to us, O <s>Soma</s>, drunk into the heart; like a father to a son, O <s>Indra</s>, be gracious; like a friend to a friend, O wise one of wide fame, extend our life for living, O <s>Soma</s>) [GB 2.3.6]; "hinvā me gātrā harivo gaṇān me mā vyarīriṣaḥ | śivo me saptarṣīn upatiṣṭha mā me 'vāg nābhir abhi gāḥ" (Enliven my limbs, O <s>Hari</s>, do not destroy my host; auspiciously attend upon me and the Seven Sages; let not my navel sink downward) [cf. TS 3.2.5.3].

body.text: <3.9.19> (19.19) camasān āpyāyayanty <ā pyāyasva saṃ te payāṃsi [sakala at KauśS 68.10, possibly PS 20.55.4+6]> iti ||
body.translated_text: They replenish the <s>Camasas</s> (cups) with "ā pyāyasva saṃ te payāṃsi" (Swell up, may your streams [come together]) [KauśS 68.10, possibly PS 20.55.4+6].

body.text: <3.9.20> (19.20) tatra ślokaḥ <pañcaiva kṛtvaś camasān yajña āpyāyayet kaviḥ | ājye marutvatīye ca prasthitāś cāpi sarvaśaḥ [-]> iti ||
body.translated_text: On this there is a verse: "pañcaiva kṛtvaś camasān yajña āpyāyayet kaviḥ | ājye marutvatīye ca prasthitāś cāpi sarvaśaḥ" (Five times should the wise one replenish the cups in the sacrifice — at the <s>Ājya</s>, the <s>Marutvatīya</s>, and at all the <s>Prasthita</s> [offerings]).
The <s>Acchāvāka</s> cup oblation is dedicated to <s>Agni</s> and <s>Indra</s> (<s>Aindrāgna</s>).
If they eat, [they eat] at the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s>.
Seated in the <s>Sadas</s>, they sacrifice to the <s>Ṛtus</s> (seasons) according to the prescribed order.

body.text: <3.10.1> (20.1) <marutaḥ potrāt [20.2.1]> iti prathamottamābhyāṃ potā | dvitīyayāgnīdhraḥ | tṛtīyayā brāhmaṇācchaṃsī ||
body.translated_text: With "marutaḥ potrāt" (The <s>Maruts</s> from the <s>Potṛ</s>'s [office]) [20.2.1], the <s>Potṛ</s> [recites] the first and last [verses]; the <s>Āgnīdhra</s> the second; the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s> the third.
The sacrificer gives the additional order: "O <s>Hotṛ</s>, sacrifice this" [ĀpŚS 12.27.6 etc.].
They do not perform the <s>Anuvaṣaṭkāra</s> (response call).

body.text:
<3.10.4> (20.4) tatra ślokaḥ <dvidevatyān ṛtuyājān yaś ca pātnīvato grahaḥ | ādityagrahasāvitrau tān sma mānuvaṣaṭkṛthāḥ [BaudhŚS 25.20:252.4 etc.]> iti || [G: ṭl̥̄trāv ete nānuvaṣaṭkṛtā iti]
<3.10.5> (20.5) ṛtuhomān | aindraṃ mārutaṃ tvāṣṭram āgneyam aindraṃ maitrāvaruṇaṃ caturo drāviṇodasān āśvinaṃ gārhapatyam ||
body.translated_text: On this there is a verse: "dvidevatyān ṛtuyājān yaś ca pātnīvato grahaḥ | ādityagrahasāvitrau tān sma mānuvaṣaṭkṛthāḥ" (The dual-deity [offerings], the seasonal sacrifices, the <s>Pātnīvata</s> cup, the <s>Āditya-graha</s> and the <s>Sāvitra</s> — for these, one should not perform the <s>Anuvaṣaṭkāra</s>) [BaudhŚS 25.20:252.4]. (20.5) The seasonal oblations: the <s>Aindra</s>, <s>Māruta</s>, <s>Tvāṣṭra</s>, <s>Āgneya</s>, <s>Aindra</s>, <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>, four <s>Drāviṇodas</s> (wealth-giving) [oblations], the <s>Āśvina</s>, and the <s>Gārhapatya</s>.

body.text: <3.10.6> (20.6) ṛtupātre bhakṣayanti limpanti vāvajighranti vā <ko 'si yaśo 'si yaśodā asi yaśo mayi dhehi [-]> iti ||
body.translated_text: They partake from the <s>Ṛtu-pātra</s> (season-cups), or they smear [themselves], or they smell [them], [reciting] "ko 'si yaśo 'si yaśodā asi yaśo mayi dhehi" (Who are you? You are glory. You are the giver of glory. Bestow glory upon me).

body.text: <3.10.7> (20.7) nārāśaṃsāṃs tūṣṇīṃ pratigṛhya bhakṣayanti <narāśaṃsapītasya deva soma te nṛbhiḥ ṣṭutasya matividaḥ | ūmaiḥ pitṛbhir bhakṣitasyopahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi [cf. AB 7.34, PB 1.5.9]> iti ||
body.translated_text: They silently receive the <s>Nārāśaṃsa</s> [cups] and partake [with the mantra] "narāśaṃsapītasya deva soma te nṛbhiḥ ṣṭutasya matividaḥ | ūmaiḥ pitṛbhir bhakṣitasyopahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi" (Of the <s>Nārāśaṃsa</s> that has been drunk, O divine <s>Soma</s>, praised by men, O knower of wisdom, partaken of by the ancestral <s>Ūmas</s> — having been invited of what has been invited, I partake) [cf. AB 7.34, PB 1.5.9].

body.text:
<3.10.8> (20.8) <ūrvaiḥ> iti mādhyaṃdine | <kāvyaiḥ> iti tṛtīyasavane || [cf. AB 7.34]
<3.10.9> (20.9) <mano nv ā hvāmahi [sakala at KauśS 89.1, PS 19.24.10-13]> iti mana upāhvayante ||
body.translated_text: "ūrvaiḥ" (by the <s>Ūrvas</s>) at the midday [pressing]. "kāvyaiḥ" (by the <s>Kāvyas</s>) at the third pressing [cf. AB 7.34]. (20.9) With "mano nv ā hvāmahi" (Now we call upon the mind) [KauśS 89.1, PS 19.24.10-13], they invoke the mind.
They partake of the <s>Nārāśaṃsa</s> [cups] five times.

body.text: <3.10.11> (20.11) tatra ślokaḥ <pañcaiva kṛtvaś camasān nārāśaṃseṣu bhakṣayet | hotuḥ pūrveṣu śastreṣu yāni prāg āgnimārutāt [-]> iti ||
body.translated_text: On this there is a verse: "pañcaiva kṛtvaś camasān nārāśaṃseṣu bhakṣayet | hotuḥ pūrveṣu śastreṣu yāni prāg āgnimārutāt" (Five times should one partake of the cups at the <s>Nārāśaṃsa</s> [rites], at the <s>Hotṛ</s>'s earlier recitations, those which come before the <s>Āgnimāruta</s>).
From the <s>Ājya-śastra</s> (ghee recitation), [the offering is] dedicated to <s>Agni</s> and <s>Indra</s> (<s>Aindrāgna</s>).

body.text: <3.10.13> (20.13) hotre praugastotrāya prasauti <pretir asi dharmaṇe tvā dharmaṃ jinva [PB 1.9.2, TS 4.4.1.1, cf. GB 2.2.13]> | maitrāvaruṇāya <anvitir asi dive tvā divaṃ jinva [PB 1.9.3, TS 3.5.2.2, cf. GB 2.2.13]> | brāhmaṇācchaṃsine <saṃdhir asy antarikṣāya tvāntarikṣaṃ jinva [PB 1.9.4, TS 4.4.1.1, cf. GB 2.2.13]> | acchāvākāya <pratidhir asi pṛthivyai tvā pṛthivīṃ jinva [PB 1.9.5, TS 4.4.1.1]> iti ||
body.translated_text: For the <s>Hotṛ</s>, he gives the signal for the <s>Prauga-stotra</s>: "pretir asi dharmaṇe tvā dharmaṃ jinva" (You are departure; for <s>Dharma</s> I take you, prosper <s>Dharma</s>) [PB 1.9.2, TS 4.4.1.1]; for the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>: "anvitir asi dive tvā divaṃ jinva" (You are pursuit; for heaven I take you, prosper heaven) [PB 1.9.3, TS 3.5.2.2]; for the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s>: "saṃdhir asy antarikṣāya tvāntarikṣaṃ jinva" (You are the junction; for the atmosphere I take you, prosper the atmosphere) [PB 1.9.4, TS 4.4.1.1]; for the <s>Acchāvāka</s>: "pratidhir asi pṛthivyai tvā pṛthivīṃ jinva" (You are the support; for the earth I take you, prosper the earth) [PB 1.9.5, TS 4.4.1.1].

body.text: <3.10.14> (20.14) praugaśastrād vaiśvadevam | maitrāvaruṇasya maitrāvaruṇam | brāhmaṇācchaṃsina aindram | acchāvākasyaindrāgnam ||
body.translated_text: From the <s>Prauga-śastra</s>, [the offering is] the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> (for All-Gods); from the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>'s [recitation], the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>; from the <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s>'s, the <s>Aindra</s>; from the <s>Acchāvāka</s>'s, the <s>Aindrāgna</s>.

body.text: <3.10.15> (20.15) brāhmaṇācchaṃsy uttamāt pratīhārāt trir hiṅkṛtya <śaṃsāvom> ity adhvaryum āhvayate ||
body.translated_text: The <s>Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin</s>, having uttered "hiṅ" three times after the last <s>Pratihāra</s> (response), calls upon the <s>Adhvaryu</s> with "śaṃsāvom" (Let us recite, Om).

body.text: <3.10.16> (20.16) ahiṅkāram anurūpāyokthamukhāya paridhānīyāyai | pragāthāya ca mādhyaṃdine ||
body.translated_text: Without the "hiṅ" call, for the <s>Anurūpa</s>, the <s>Uktha-mukha</s> (laudation opening), and the <s>Paridhānīyā</s> (enclosing verse); and for the <s>Pragātha</s> at the midday [pressing].
Some [say] the <s>Yoni</s> [verses also].

body.text: <3.10.18> (20.18) <adhvaryo śaṃsāvom [GB 2.4.4]> iti stotriyāya <adhvaryo śaṃśaṃsāvom [GB 2.3.10]> iti tṛtīyasavane ||
body.translated_text: [He says] "adhvaryo śaṃsāvom" (O <s>Adhvaryu</s>, let us recite, Om) [GB 2.4.4] for the <s>Stotriya</s>; "adhvaryo śaṃśaṃsāvom" (O <s>Adhvaryu</s>, let us recite and recite, Om) [GB 2.3.10] at the third pressing.
At the calls (<s>Āhāva</s>), the <s>Adhvaryu</s> responds "śaṃsāvo daiva" (Recite, O divine one) [GB 2.3.10].

body.text: <3.10.20> (20.20) <othāmo daiva> ity avasāne | <omothāmo daiva> iti praṇave | <om> iti śastrānte ||
body.translated_text: "othāmo daiva" (We affirm, O divine one) at the conclusion. "omothāmo daiva" (Om, we affirm, O divine one) at the <s>Praṇava</s> (Om). "Om" at the end of the recitation.

body.text: <3.10.21> (20.21) ukthapratigaram āha | ukthasaṃpatsu <om ukthaśā ukthaśā yajokthaśāḥ [cf. GB 2.3.10]> iti | sāmnā śastram upasaṃtanoti | ardharcaśo mandrayā vācā | balīyasyā mādhyaṃdine | baliṣṭhatamayā tṛtīyasavane | uttariṇyottariṇyotsahed ā samāpanāt ||
body.translated_text: He speaks the <s>Uktha-pratigara</s> (laudation-response). At the <s>Uktha-saṃpatti</s> (laudation-conclusions), [he says] "om ukthaśā ukthaśā yajokthaśāḥ" (Om, partaker of the <s>Uktha</s>, partaker of the <s>Uktha</s>, sacrifice, partakers of the <s>Uktha</s>) [cf. GB 2.3.10]. He extends the recitation with a <s>Sāman</s> (chant), [reciting] each half-verse with a pleasing voice; with a stronger [voice] at the midday [pressing]; with the strongest [voice] at the third pressing; raising [the voice] ever higher until the completion.

body.text: <3.11.1> (21.1) <ā yāhi suṣumā hi te [20.3]> <ā no yāhi sutāvataḥ [20.4]> iti stotriyānurūpau ||
body.translated_text: "ā yāhi suṣumā hi te" (Come, for delightful [is your draught]) [20.3] and "ā no yāhi sutāvataḥ" (Come to us who have pressed <s>Soma</s>) [20.4] are the <s>Stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s>.

body.text: <3.11.2> (21.2) <ayam u tvā vicarṣaṇe [20.5]> ity ukthamukham | <uddhed abhi śrutām agham [20.7.1-2]> iti paryāsaḥ | uttamā paridhānīyā ||
body.translated_text: "ayam u tvā vicarṣaṇe" (This [<s>Soma</s>], O wide-gazing one, [is pressed] for you) [20.5] is the <s>Uktha-mukha</s> (laudation opening). "uddhed abhi śrutām agham" (Up through heard adversity) [20.7.1-2] is the <s>Paryāsa</s> (conclusion). The last [verse] is the <s>Paridhānīyā</s> (enclosing verse).
He recites the first [verse] thrice and the last [verse] thrice.

body.text: <3.11.4> (21.4) ardharcaśasya ṛgantaṃ praṇavenopasaṃtanoti svarādim apanīya | pacchaḥśasye 'rdharcāntam | śastrāntaṃ makārāntenaiva ||
body.translated_text: For [recitation] by half-verses, he extends the verse-ending with a <s>Praṇava</s> (Om), removing the initial <s>Svarādi</s> (accent). At the end of a verse-by-verse [recitation], [he extends] the half-verse ending. At the end of the [entire] recitation, [he concludes] with just the <s>Makāra</s> (the syllable "m").

body.text: <3.11.5> (21.5) śastvā <ukthaṃ vāci [GB 2.3.10 etc.]> ity āha | <ukthaṃ vācīndrāya [GB 2.3.10 etc.]> iti mādhyaṃdine | <ukthaṃ vācīndrāya devebhyaḥ [GB 2.3.10 etc.]> iti tṛtīyasavane ||
body.translated_text: After reciting, he says "ukthaṃ vāci" (The <s>Uktha</s> is in speech) [GB 2.3.10 etc.]; "ukthaṃ vācīndrāya" (The <s>Uktha</s> is in speech for <s>Indra</s>) at the midday pressing; "ukthaṃ vācīndrāya devebhyaḥ" (The <s>Uktha</s> is in speech for <s>Indra</s> and the gods) at the third pressing.
The <s>Ukthya</s> completions. The <s>Paridhānīyā</s> (enclosing verse) is the concluding offering verse.

body.text: <3.11.7> (21.7) acchāvākabhakṣād <agniḥ prātaḥsavane [6.47.1]> <śyeno 'si [6.48.1]> <yathā somaḥ prātaḥsavane [9.1.11]> iti yathāsavanam ājyaṃ juhoti ||
body.translated_text: After the <s>Acchāvāka</s>'s partaking, he offers clarified butter according to each pressing with "agniḥ prātaḥsavane" [6.47.1], "śyeno 'si" [6.48.1], "yathā somaḥ prātaḥsavane" [9.1.11].
The concluding oblations [are offered].

body.text: <3.11.9> (21.9) saṃsthitesaṃsthite savane vācayati <mayi bhargo mayi maho mayi yaśo mayi sarvam [GB 1.5.15 etc.]> iti ||
body.translated_text: At the conclusion of each pressing, he has [the sacrificer] recite "mayi bhargo mayi maho mayi yaśo mayi sarvam" (In me splendor, in me greatness, in me fame, in me everything) [GB 1.5.15 etc.].

body.text: <3.11.10> (21.10) preṣitā mādhyaṃdināyaudumbarīm abhyaparayā dvārā niṣkramyāgnīdhrīyāt sarpanti | yajamānaḥ pūrvayā ||
body.translated_text: Being sent forth for the midday [pressing], they creep from the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> toward the <s>Audumbarī</s> (fig-wood post), going out through the back door; the sacrificer [goes] through the front door.
The preliminary oblations [are offered].
The pressing [procedure] beginning with the pressing has been stated.
They creep to the <s>Sadas</s> (assembly hall) for the <s>Pavamāna</s> [chant].

body.text: <3.11.14> (21.14) āmantritaḥ prasauti <viṣṭambho 'si vṛṣṭyai tvā vṛṣṭiṃ jinva [PB 1.9.6, TS 4.4.1.1, cf. GB 2.2.13]> iti ||
body.translated_text: When addressed, he gives the signal: "viṣṭambho 'si vṛṣṭyai tvā vṛṣṭiṃ jinva" (You are the support; for rain I take you; prosper rain) [PB 1.9.6, TS 4.4.1.1, cf. GB 2.2.13].

body.text: <3.11.15> (21.15) viharaṇe dhiṣṇyavān bahiś ced dhiṣṇyam abhyetya <pari tvāgne [7.71.1]> iti japati ||
body.translated_text: During the separation, one who has a <s>Dhiṣṇya</s> (subsidiary fire-hearth), if he is outside, having approached the <s>Dhiṣṇya</s> fire, mutters "pari tvāgne" [7.71.1].
And the <s>Brahman</s> priest [likewise].
The consecrated one, outside the <s>Vedi</s>, at the <s>Abhyāśrāvaṇa</s> (calling), at sunset or sunrise, [recites] "agnaya upāhvayadhvam" (Call upon the fires).
The curd-<s>Gharma</s> offering [is made] with "śrātaṃ manya" [7.72.3].
The partaking is like [that of] the <s>Gharma</s>, with the tasting of the juice.
[This relates to] the animal cake offering.
"evā pāhi" [20.8.1-3] are the offering verses for the <s>Prasthita</s> (set-forth) oblations.
The <s>Prasthita</s> oblations are <s>Aindra</s> (dedicated to <s>Indra</s>).

body.text: <3.11.23> (21.23) gārhapatye dākṣiṇahomāv <ud u tyaṃ [13.2.16]> <citraṃ devānām [13.2.35]> iti ||
body.translated_text: In the <s>Gārhapatya</s> fire, the two southern oblations [are offered] with "ud u tyam" [13.2.16] and "citraṃ devānām" [13.2.35].

body.text: <3.11.24> (21.24) hiraṇyahasto yajamāno bahirvedi dakṣiṇā āyatīḥ <ā gāvaḥ [4.21.1]> iti pratyuttiṣṭhati ||
body.translated_text: The sacrificer, with gold in hand, outside the <s>Vedi</s>, rises to greet the <s>Dakṣiṇās</s> (priestly fees) coming [toward him] with "ā gāvaḥ" (Come, O cows) [4.21.1].
He gives gold to the <s>Ātreya</s> (one descended from <s>Atri</s>). To the <s>Āgnīdhra</s>, a cushion.

body.text: <3.11.26> (21.26) agreṇa gārhapatyaṃ jaghanena sado 'ntar āgnīdhrīyaṃ ca sadaś ca cātvālaṃ codīcīr dakṣiṇā utsṛjyamānāḥ <saṃ vaḥ sṛjatu [3.14.2-3]> iti dvābhyām anumantrayate ||
body.translated_text: In front of the <s>Gārhapatya</s>, behind the <s>Sadas</s>, between the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> and the <s>Sadas</s>, and toward the <s>Cātvāla</s> — he recites the approval mantra over the fees being released northward with two [verses beginning with] "saṃ vaḥ sṛjatu" [3.14.2-3].

body.text: <3.12.1> (22.1) <yasyāṃ pūrve bhūtakṛtaḥ [12.1.39]> iti bhāgaliḥ | <ihed asātha [3.8.4]> iti kauśikaḥ ||
body.translated_text: "yasyāṃ pūrve bhūtakṛtaḥ" [12.1.39] — [this is] the [view of] <s>Bhāgali</s>. "ihed asātha" [3.8.4] — [this is the view of] <s>Kauśika</s>.
At the end, [the fee] should be given to the <s>Pratihartṛ</s> (responser in chanting).
The <s>Marutvatīya</s> offering [is made] with "indro mā marutvān" [18.3.25].

body.text: <3.12.4> (22.4) śastrayājyāyāḥ | hotrādibhyaḥ prasauti <pravāsy ahne tvāhar jinva | anuvāsi rātryai tvā rātriṃ jinva | uśig asi vasubhyas tvā vasūn jinva | praketo 'si rudrebhyas tvā rudrān jinva [cf. PB 1.9.8, TS 3.5.2.3, GB 2.2.13]> iti ||
body.translated_text: For the <s>Śastra</s> (recitation) offering verse: for the <s>Hotṛ</s> and others, he gives the signal "pravāsy ahne tvāhar jinva" (You are the blower forth; for the day I take you, prosper the day), "anuvāsi rātryai tvā rātriṃ jinva" (You are the after-blower; for the night I take you, prosper the night), "uśig asi vasubhyas tvā vasūn jinva" (You are the willing one; for the <s>Vasus</s> I take you, prosper the <s>Vasus</s>), "praketo 'si rudrebhyas tvā rudrān jinva" (You are the foreknower; for the <s>Rudras</s> I take you, prosper the <s>Rudras</s>) [cf. PB 1.9.8, TS 3.5.2.3, GB 2.2.13].
For the <s>Niṣkevalya</s> [recitation], the <s>Māhendra</s> (great <s>Indra</s>) cup offering.
For the <s>Praśāstṛ</s> (director) and others, the <s>Aindra</s> cup offering.

body.text: <3.12.7> (22.7) <taṃ vo dasmamṛtīṣaham [20.9.2]> <tat tvā yāmi suvīryam [20.9.3]> iti stotriyānurupau ||
body.translated_text: "taṃ vo dasmam ṛtīṣaham" [20.9.2] and "tat tvā yāmi suvīryam" [20.9.3] are the <s>Stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s> (model and corresponding) [verses].

body.text: <3.12.8> (22.8) dve tisraḥ karoti punar ādāyam | prathamāṃ śastvā tasyā uttamaṃ pādam abhyasyāvasāyottarasyā ardharcena dvitīyāṃ śastvā tasyā uttamaṃ pādam abhyasyottareṇārdharcena tṛtīyāṃ śaṃsati ||
body.translated_text: He makes two into three by repetition. Having recited the first, appending the last foot of that, pausing, then reciting the second with the half-verse of the next, appending the last foot of that, he recites the third with the next half-verse.
Thus is the interweaving of the <s>Bārhatī</s> <s>Stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s> [verses].
They should be recited in a moderate to loud voice.

body.text: <3.12.11> (22.11) <ud u tye madhumattamāḥ [20.10]> iti sāmapragāthaḥ svaravatyā ||
body.translated_text: "ud u tye madhumattamāḥ" [20.10] is the <s>Sāma-pragātha</s> (Sāman verse-pair), [recited] with the <s>Svaravatī</s> (tonal) [intonation].

body.text: <3.12.12> (22.12) <indraḥ pūrbhid ātirat [20.11]> ity ukthamukhaṃ pacchaḥ prativītatamayā ||
body.translated_text: "indraḥ pūrbhid ātirat" [20.11] is the opening of the <s>Uktha</s> (laudatory recitation), recited from the end, in the <s>Prativītatamā</s> (most interwoven) arrangement.

body.text: <3.12.13> (22.13) <ud u brahmāṇy airata śravasya [20.12.1]> iti paryāsaḥ ||
body.translated_text: "ud u brahmāṇy airata śravasya" [20.12.1] is the <s>Paryāsa</s> (concluding section).
With "eved indram" [20.12.6] he encloses [the recitation]. With the concluding [verse] he makes the offering.

body.text: <3.12.15> (22.15) acchāvākabhakṣād ādityagrahahomaṃ <yad devā devaheḍanam [6.114-115]> iti dvābhyām | pavamānasarpaṇāntam ||
body.translated_text: After the <s>Acchāvāka</s>'s partaking, the <s>Āditya-graha</s> (solar cup) offering [is made] with two [hymns] "yad devā devaheḍanam" [6.114-115]; ending with the creeping for the <s>Pavamāna</s>.
He recites the approval mantra over the <s>Āśira</s> (mixed oblation) being poured from the <s>Pūtabhṛt</s> vessel with "āśīrṇa ūrjam" [2.29.3].

body.text:
<3.12.17> (22.17) pavamānāya prasauti <suditir asy ādityebhyas tvādityān jinva [PB 1.9.11, GB 2.2.1]> iti
<3.12.18> (22.18) avadānahomam āgneyam ||
body.translated_text: For the <s>Pavamāna</s>, he gives the signal "suditir asy ādityebhyas tvādityān jinva" (You are the good gift; for the <s>Ādityas</s> I take you; prosper the <s>Ādityas</s>) [PB 1.9.11, GB 2.2.1]. (22.18) The cut-portion offering is <s>Āgneya</s> (dedicated to <s>Agni</s>).

body.text: <3.12.19> (22.19) aindrāgnam ukthye | aindraṃ ṣoḍaśini | sārasvatam atirātre ||
body.translated_text: <s>Aindrāgna</s> (dedicated to <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>) in the <s>Ukthya</s>. <s>Aindra</s> (dedicated to <s>Indra</s>) in the <s>Ṣoḍaśin</s>. <s>Sārasvata</s> (dedicated to <s>Sarasvatī</s>) in the <s>Atirātra</s>.

body.text: <3.12.20> (22.20) paśv ekādaśinyām āgneyaṃ sāumyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ sārasvataṃ pauṣṇam bārhaspatyaṃ vaiśvadevam aindram aindrāgnaṃ sāvitraṃ vāruṇam ||
body.translated_text: At the animal <s>Ekādaśinī</s> (eleven-victim sacrifice): <s>Āgneya</s>, <s>Saumya</s>, <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>, <s>Sārasvata</s>, <s>Pauṣṇa</s>, <s>Bārhaspatya</s>, <s>Vaiśvadeva</s>, <s>Aindra</s>, <s>Aindrāgna</s>, <s>Sāvitra</s>, <s>Vāruṇa</s>.

body.text: <3.12.21> (22.21) savanīyahomādi | <indraś ca somaṃ pibataṃ bṛhaspate [20.13.2-3]> iti prasthitayājyāḥ | homān aindraṃ maitrāvaruṇam aindrābārhaspatyaṃ mārutaṃ tvāṣṭram aindrāvaiṣṇavam āgneyam ||
body.translated_text: Beginning with the <s>Savanīya</s> (pressing-day) oblations; "indraś ca somaṃ pibataṃ bṛhaspate" [20.13.2-3] are the <s>Prasthita</s> offering verses; the oblations are: <s>Aindra</s>, <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s>, <s>Aindrā-Bārhaspatya</s>, <s>Māruta</s>, <s>Tvāṣṭra</s>, <s>Aindrā-Vaiṣṇava</s>, <s>Āgneya</s>.

body.text: <3.12.22> (22.22) havirdhāne yathācamasaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ svebhya upāsanebhyas trīṃstrīn puroḍāśasaṃvartān <etat te pratatāmaha [18.4.75]> iti nipṛṇanti ||
body.translated_text: In the <s>Havirdhāna</s>, according to each cup, from the south, at their respective seats, they distribute three <s>Puroḍāśa</s> (rice cake) portions each with "etat te pratatāmaha" (This is for you, O great-grandfather) [18.4.75].

body.text: <3.12.23> (22.23) <atra pitaraḥ [sakala at KauśS 88.18, cf. VSM 2.31, ManB 2.3.6 etc.]> iti japitvā <etaṃ bhāgam [6.122.1]> <etaṃ sadhasthāḥ [6.123.1]> <śyeno nṛcakṣāḥ [7.42.2]> ity anumantrayate ||
body.translated_text: Having muttered "atra pitaraḥ" (Here, O Fathers) [KauśS 88.18], he recites the approval mantra with "etaṃ bhāgam" [6.122.1], "etaṃ sadhasthāḥ" [6.123.1], "śyeno nṛcakṣāḥ" [7.42.2].
In the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s> [shed], they partake of the remnants of the oblation.
The <s>Sāvitra-graha</s> (<s>Savitṛ</s> cup) offering.

body.text: <3.13.3> (23.3) vaiśvadevayājyāyāḥ | dhiṣṇyahomāt <aibhir agne [20.13.4]> ity upāṃśu pātnīvatasyāgnīdhro yajati ||
body.translated_text: For the <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> (All-Gods) offering verse: after the <s>Dhiṣṇya</s> oblation, with "aibhir agne" [20.13.4], the <s>Āgnīdhra</s> silently offers the <s>Pātnīvata</s> (wives' oblation).
Its oblation [is offered].
Sitting in the lap of the <s>Neṣṭṛ</s> (leader) or at the end of the <s>Dhiṣṇya</s>, he partakes.

body.text: <3.13.6> (23.6) agniṣṭomasāmne hotre prasauti <ojo 'si pitṛbhyas tvā pitṝn jinva [PB 1.9.12, TS 3.5.2.3, GB 2.2.13]> iti ||
body.translated_text: For the <s>Agniṣṭoma-sāman</s>, he gives the signal to the <s>Hotṛ</s>: "ojo 'si pitṛbhyas tvā pitṝn jinva" (You are strength; for the Fathers I take you; prosper the Fathers) [PB 1.9.12, TS 3.5.2.3, GB 2.2.13].
With "dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa" [7.94.1], he recites the approval mantra over the <s>Dhruva</s> (fixed) cup being brought down.

body.text: <3.13.8> (23.8) āgnimārutayājyāhomaṃ <prati tyaṃ cārum adhvaram [sakala at KauśS 127.7, PS 6.17.1, ṚV 1.19.1]> iti saṃpreṣita āgnīdhra ity uktam ||
body.translated_text: The <s>Āgnimāruta</s> (<s>Agni</s>-<s>Marut</s>) offering-verse oblation [is made] with "prati tyaṃ cārum adhvaram" [KauśS 127.7, PS 6.17.1, ṚV 1.19.1], being directed by the <s>Āgnīdhra</s> — as has been stated.
The <s>Hāriyojana</s> (chariot-yoking) offering [is made] with "ā mandraiḥ" [7.117.1].
By that same [path] they go out.
In the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s>, he offers all the expiatory oblations.

body.text: <3.13.12> (23.12) agnau śākalān sarve | <devakṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi svāhā | pitṛkṛtasya | manuṣyakṛtasya | ātmakṛtasya | anājñātājñātakṛtasya || [TS 3.2.5.7, PB 1.6.10]> <yad vo devāś cakṛma jihvayā guru manaso vā prayutī devaheḍanam | arāvā yo no abhi ducchunāyate tasmiṃs tad eno vasavo ni dhattana [ṚV 10.37.12]> iti || devaheḍanasya sūktābhyāṃ ca ||
body.translated_text: In the fire, all [offer] the <s>Śākalā</s> offerings: "devakṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi svāhā | pitṛkṛtasya | manuṣyakṛtasya | ātmakṛtasya | anājñātājñātakṛtasya" (You are the expiation for sin committed by the gods, <s>svāhā</s>; for that committed by the fathers; by men; by oneself; by the unknown and the known) [TS 3.2.5.7, PB 1.6.10], and "yad vo devāś cakṛma jihvayā guru" (Whatever heavy [sin] we committed against you, O gods, with the tongue) [ṚV 10.37.12]. And with the two hymns on offending the gods.

body.text: <3.13.13> (23.13) droṇakalaśād dhānā hasta ādāya bhasmānte nivapante ||
body.translated_text: Taking roasted grain from the <s>Droṇakalaśa</s> (wooden trough) into the hand, they scatter it at the edge of the ashes.
From the <s>Cātvāla</s>, from behind, they carry away the <s>Apsusoma</s> cups placed by the <s>Adhvaryu</s>, with a <s>Vaiṣṇavī</s> verse.

body.text: <3.13.15> (23.15) <ubhā kavī yuvānā satyādā dharmaṇas pari | satyasya dharmaṇā vi sakhyāni sṛjāmahe [ĀpŚS 13.18.2 etc.]> iti sakhyāni visṛjante ||
body.translated_text: "ubhā kavī yuvānā satyādā dharmaṇas pari | satyasya dharmaṇā vi sakhyāni sṛjāmahe" (Both wise ones, young, truth-giving, from the law; by the law of truth we dissolve the friendships) [ĀpŚS 13.18.2 etc.] — thus they dissolve the friendships.
"saṃ sakhyāni" (Together the friendships) — thus they reunite the friendships during a multi-day rite, before the last [day].
In the <s>Āgnīdhrīya</s>, they partake of curds with "dadhikrāvṇaḥ" [20.137.3].
After the <s>Patnīsaṃyājas</s> (offerings for the wives), he sits down at the entrance of the hall.
Having passed south of the <s>Āhavanīya</s> and beyond it by the <s>Dakṣiṇā</s> (fee) path, he offers the concluding oblations for the <s>Samiṣṭayajus</s> (concluding sacrificial formulas).

body.text: <3.13.20> (23.20) apsv avabhṛtheṣṭyām <apsu te [7.83.1]> iti purastāddhomān | sāvikān saṃsthitahomān | vāruṇaṃ <tvaṃ no agne [3.20.5]> <sa tvaṃ naḥ [20.46.3]> iti ||
body.translated_text: In the <s>Avabhṛtha</s> (purificatory bath) offering to the waters, the preliminary oblations [are made] with "apsu te" [7.83.1]; the <s>Sāvika</s> concluding oblations; the <s>Vāruṇa</s> [offering] with "tvaṃ no agne" [3.20.5] and "sa tvaṃ naḥ" [20.46.3].
Some [say it] ends with the <s>Iḍā</s> and the <s>Anuyājas</s> (after-offerings).

body.text: <3.13.22> (23.22) somaliptāni dadhnābhijuhoty <abhūd devaḥ [VaitS 16.15]> drapsavatyo <yat te grāvā [VaitS 24.1]> ity etaiḥ ||
body.translated_text: He pours clarified butter over the <s>Soma</s>-smeared [implements] with "abhūd devaḥ" [VaitS 16.15], the <s>Drapsa</s> (drop) verses, and "yat te grāvā" [VaitS 24.1].

body.text: <3.14.1> (24.1) <yat te grāvā bāhucyuto acucyon naro yad vā te hastayor adhukṣan | tat ta āpyāyatāṃ tat te niṣṭyāyatāṃ soma rājan || yat te grāvṇā cicchiduḥ soma rājan priyāṇy aṅgā sukṛtā purūṇi | tat saṃdhatsvājyenota vardhayasvānāgaso yathā sadam it saṃkṣiyema || yāṃ te tvacaṃ bibhidur yāṃ ca yoniṃ yad vā sthānāt pracyuto yadi vāsuto 'si | tvayā soma kḷptam asmākam etad upa no rājan sukṛte hvayasva | saṃ prāṇāpānābhyāṃ sam u cakṣuṣā saṃ śrotreṇa gacchasva soma rājan | yat te viriṣṭaṃ samu tat ta etaj jānītān naḥ saṃgamane pathīnām || ahāḥ śarīraṃ payasā samety anyo anyo bhavati varṇo asya | tasmai ta indo haviṣā vidhema vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām || abhikṣaranti juhvo ghṛtenāṅgā parūṃṣi tava vardhayanti | tasmai te soma nama id vaṣaṭ copa no rājan sukṛte hvayasva [PS 2.39]> ||
body.translated_text: [The verses are]: "Whatever [<s>Soma</s>] your pressing-stone, moved by the arms, dropped; whatever they milked from your hands — may that swell for you, may that flow back for you, O King <s>Soma</s>. Whatever lovely limbs of yours, O King <s>Soma</s>, well-made and many, the pressing-stones cut apart — join those together with clarified butter and increase; may we dwell forever without sin. Whatever skin of yours they split, whatever womb, if you were displaced from your place, or pressed out — by you, O <s>Soma</s>, this of ours is arranged; call us, O King, to good fortune. Come together with your <s>Prāṇa</s> (in-breath) and <s>Apāna</s> (out-breath), with your sight, with your hearing, O King <s>Soma</s>; whatever of yours was damaged, let that be made whole — know us at the meeting of paths. Day after day the body comes together with milk, each time his color changes — to you, O <s>Indu</s> (drop), we would offer oblation; may we be lords of riches. The ladles pour with ghee, your limbs and joints they make increase — to you, O <s>Soma</s>, homage indeed, <s>vaṣaṭ</s>; call us, O King, to good fortune" [PS 2.39].
Having laid down a black antelope skin, he sprinkles [it].

body.text:
<3.14.3> (24.3) apāṃ sūktair ityādy upasparśanāntam || [KauśS 7.14]
<3.14.4> (24.4) <ud vayam [7.53.7]> ity utkrāmanti ||
body.translated_text: With the hymns to the waters, [the procedure from] the beginning up to the touching of water [is performed] [KauśS 7.14]. (24.4) With "ud vayam" [7.53.7], they depart.

body.text: <3.14.5> (24.5) <apāma somam [AtharvaśirasUp 3, ṚV 8.48.3, TS 3.2.4.5]> <aganma svar [16.9.3]> ity āvrajanti ||
body.translated_text: With "apāma somam" (We have drunk the <s>Soma</s>) [AtharvaśirasUp 3, ṚV 8.48.3, TS 3.2.4.5] and "aganma svar" (We have gone to the light) [16.9.3], they return.
With "apo divyāḥ" (O celestial waters) [7.89.1], they stand before the <s>Āhavanīya</s> fire.

body.text:
<3.14.7> (24.7) vimuñcāmītyādi mārjanāntam || [KauśS 6.11-13]
<3.14.8> (24.8) udayanīyā prāyaṇīyāvat | pathyāyāś caturtham ||
body.translated_text: Beginning with "vimuñcāmi" (I release), up to the purification [KauśS 6.11-13]. (24.8) The <s>Udayanīya</s> (concluding) offering is like the <s>Prāyaṇīya</s> (introductory offering). The <s>Pathyā</s> is the fourth [offering].
[The rite] concludes within [the same day].

body.text: <3.14.10> (24.10) anūbandhyāyām aparājitāyāṃ tiṣṭhantyāṃ <sapatnahanam [9.2.1]> iti kāmaṃ namaskaroti ||
body.translated_text: When the <s>Anūbandhyā</s> (supplementary) cow remains standing unconquered, with "sapatnahanam" (slayer of rivals) [9.2.1], he makes obeisance at will.
If there is an <s>Ekādaśinī</s> (set of eleven) of sacrificial posts, the <s>Tvāṣṭra</s> (dedicated to <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>) animal [is offered] with the wiping of the omentum.
The release of [the animal] that has been led around the fire.
Its ghee and cut-portion offerings. After the cow and animal cake offering, the <s>Devikā</s> (minor deity) oblations.

body.text:
<3.14.14> (24.14) <ayaṃ te yoniḥ [3.20.1]> ity araṇyor agniṃ samāropyamāṇam anumantrayate | <yā te agne yajñiyā tanūs tayā me hy āroha tayā me hy āviśa | ayaṃ te yoniḥ> ity ātman || [GB 2.4.9]
<3.14.15> (24.15) <apamityam apratīttam [6.117.1]> iti vedim upoṣyamāṇām ||
body.translated_text: With "ayaṃ te yoniḥ" (This is your womb) [3.20.1], he recites the approval mantra over the fire being placed back on the fire-sticks; [and recites] for himself: "yā te agne yajñiyā tanūs tayā me hy āroha tayā me hy āviśa | ayaṃ te yoniḥ" (O <s>Agni</s>, with that sacrificial body of yours, mount into me, enter into me; this is your womb) [GB 2.4.9]. (24.15) With "apamityam apratīttam" [6.117.1], [he recites over] the <s>Vedi</s> being strewn.

body.text: <3.14.16> (24.16) saktuhome <viśvalopa viśvadāvasya tvāsan juhomi [TS 3.3.8.2, GB 2.4.8]> ity āha ||
body.translated_text: At the barley-flour offering, he says "viśvalopa viśvadāvasya tvāsan juhomi" (I offer you for <s>Viśvalopa</s>, for the sake of all-giving) [TS 3.3.8.2, GB 2.4.8].
Having made obeisance with "yo agnau" [7.87.1], they go out by that same [path].

body.text: <3.14.18> (24.18) <upāvaroha [sakala at KauśS 40.13, cf. TB 2.5.8.8 etc.]> iti mathyamānam anumantrayate ||
body.translated_text: With "upāvaroha" (Descend upon [this]) [KauśS 40.13, cf. TB 2.5.8.8 etc.], he recites the approval mantra over [the fire] being kindled by friction.
Thus [ends] the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>.
Even one of small means should sacrifice, should sacrifice, with even a single [priestly] fee.

body.text: <4.1.1> (25.1) agniṣṭomasāmno hotre ṣoḍaśistotreṇātyagniṣṭome | ukthye maitrāvaruṇādibhyaḥ prasauti <tantur asi prajābhyas tvā prajāṃ jinva | revad asy oṣadhībhyas tvauṣaṣīr jinva | pṛtanāṣāḍ asi paśubhyas tvā paśūn jinva [cf. PB 1.10.1-3, GB 2.2.13]> iti ||
body.translated_text: For the <s>Agniṣṭoma-sāman</s> to the <s>Hotṛ</s>, [there is] the <s>Ṣoḍaśi-stotra</s> (sixteen-versed chant) in the <s>Atyagniṣṭoma</s>. In the <s>Ukthya</s>, for the <s>Maitrāvaruṇa</s> and others, he gives the signal: "tantur asi prajābhyas tvā prajāṃ jinva" (You are the thread; for offspring I take you, prosper offspring), "revad asy oṣadhībhyas tvauṣadhīr jinva" (You are wealth; for plants I take you, prosper plants), "pṛtanāṣāḍ asi paśubhyas tvā paśūn jinva" (You are the conqueror in battle; for cattle I take you, prosper cattle) [cf. PB 1.10.1-3, GB 2.2.13].

body.text: <4.1.2> (25.2) eteṣāṃ yājyāhomān <indrāvaruṇā sutapau [7.58.1]> <bṛhaspatir naḥ [7.51]> <ubhā jigyathuḥ [7.44]> iti ||
body.translated_text: Their offering-verse oblations [are made] with "indrāvaruṇā sutapau" [7.58.1], "bṛhaspatir naḥ" [7.51], "ubhā jigyathuḥ" [7.44].

body.text: <4.1.3> (25.3) <vayam u tvām apūrvya [20.14.2]> <yo na idam idaṃ purā [20.14.3]> iti stotriyānurupau ||
body.translated_text: "vayam u tvām apūrvya" [20.14.2] and "yo na idam idaṃ purā" [20.14.3] are the <s>Stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s> (model and corresponding) [verses].

body.text: <4.1.4> (25.4) stotriyasya prathamāṃ śastvā tasyā uttamaṃ pādaṃ dvitīyasyāḥ pūrveṇa saṃdhāyāvasāya dvitīyena dvitīyāṃ śaṃsati | tasyā evottamam uttareṇa saṃdhāyāvasāyottamena tṛtīyām ||
body.translated_text: Having recited the first of the <s>Stotriya</s>, joining the last foot of that with the first [foot] of the second, pausing, he recites the second with the second [foot]; joining the last of that with the next, pausing, he recites the third with the last [foot].
Thus is the interweaving of the <s>Kākubha</s> (irregular-metered) <s>Stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s> [verses].
From here he recites in reverse order.
"pra maṃhiṣṭhāya bṛhate bṛhadraye" [20.15] is the opening of the <s>Uktha</s> (laudatory recitation).

body.text: <4.1.8> (25.8) <udapruto na vayo rakṣamāṇāḥ [20.16]> iti bārhaspatyaṃ sāṃśaṃsikam ||
body.translated_text: "udapruto na vayo rakṣamāṇāḥ" [20.16] is the <s>Bārhaspatya</s> (<s>Bṛhaspati</s>-related) supplementary recitation.

body.text: <4.1.9> (25.9) <acchā ma indraṃ matayaḥ svarvidaḥ [20.17.1]> iti paryāsaḥ ||
body.translated_text: "acchā ma indraṃ matayaḥ svarvidaḥ" [20.17.1] is the <s>Paryāsa</s> (concluding section).
Thus, for the <s>Ekāhika</s> (one-day) rites, he encloses with the last [verse].
With the concluding [verse] he makes the offering.

body.text:
<4.1.12> (25.12) ṣoḍaśini graham upatiṣṭhante <ya ā babhūva bhuvanāni viśvā yasmād anyan na paraṃ kiṃ canāsti | prajāpatiḥ prajābhiḥ saṃvidānas trīṇi jyotīṃṣi dadhate sa ṣoḍaśī [cf. VSM 32.5, PB 12.13.32; PS 18.25.10d, PS 16.151.9cd]> iti
<4.1.13> (25.13) hotre prasauty <abhijid asi yuktagrāvendrāya tvendraṃ jinva [TS 3.5.2.4, PB 1.10.4]> iti ||
body.translated_text: In the <s>Ṣoḍaśin</s> (sixteen-versed sacrifice), they stand before the cup [with the mantra]: "ya ā babhūva bhuvanāni viśvā yasmād anyan na paraṃ kiṃ canāsti | prajāpatiḥ prajābhiḥ saṃvidānas trīṇi jyotīṃṣi dadhate sa ṣoḍaśī" (He who came into being, [who is] all the worlds, than whom there is nothing else higher — <s>Prajāpati</s>, united with his offspring, holding three lights, he is the sixteenth) [cf. VSM 32.5, PB 12.13.32]. (25.13) He gives the signal to the <s>Hotṛ</s>: "abhijid asi yuktagrāvendrāya tvendraṃ jinva" (You are the victorious one; your pressing-stone is yoked; for <s>Indra</s> I take you, prosper <s>Indra</s>) [TS 3.5.2.4, PB 1.10.4].

body.text: <4.1.14> (25.14) ṣoḍaśigrahasya <indra juṣasva [2.5.1]> iti | <indra ṣoḍaśinn ojasvāṃs tvaṃ deveṣv asi | ojasvantaṃ mām āyuṣmantaṃ manuṣyeṣu kṛṇuhi | tasya ta upahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi [ĀśvŚS 6.3.22]> iti bhakṣayanti | dvau dvau trayaś chandogāḥ ||
body.translated_text: For the <s>Ṣoḍaśi-graha</s> (sixteenth cup) [he recites] "indra juṣasva" [2.5.1]. They partake with "indra ṣoḍaśinn ojasvāṃs tvaṃ deveṣv asi | ojasvantaṃ mām āyuṣmantaṃ manuṣyeṣu kṛṇuhi" (O <s>Indra</s> of the sixteenth, you are powerful among the gods; make me powerful and long-lived among men) [ĀśvŚS 6.3.22]. Two by two, three for the chanters.
Like the <s>Gharma</s> [partaking] in a <s>Sattra</s>.

body.text: <4.2.1> (26.1) atirātre hotrādibhyaḥ prasauty <adhipatir asi prāṇāya tvā prāṇaṃ jinva | dharuṇo 'sy apānāya tvāpānaṃ jinva | saṃsarpo 'si cakṣuṣe tvā cakṣur jinva | vayodhā asi śrotrāya tvā śrotraṃ jinva [cf. TS 4.4.1.2-3, KS 17.7, PB 1.10.5-9, GB 2.2.14]> iti ||
body.translated_text: In the <s>Atirātra</s> (overnight sacrifice), for the <s>Hotṛ</s> and others, he gives the signal: "adhipatir asi prāṇāya tvā prāṇaṃ jinva" (You are the overlord; for <s>Prāṇa</s> (breath) I take you, prosper breath), "dharuṇo 'sy apānāya tvāpānaṃ jinva" (You are the support; for <s>Apāna</s> (downward breath) I take you, prosper downward breath), "saṃsarpo 'si cakṣuṣe tvā cakṣur jinva" (You are the creeper; for sight I take you, prosper sight), "vayodhā asi śrotrāya tvā śrotraṃ jinva" (You are the bestower of vitality; for hearing I take you, prosper hearing) [cf. TS 4.4.1.2-3, KS 17.7, PB 1.10.5-9, GB 2.2.14].
The oblations are <s>Aindra</s> (dedicated to <s>Indra</s>). From the <s>Āśvina</s> [cup], the <s>Āśvina</s> [offering].

body.text: <4.2.3> (26.3) stotriyānurūpayoḥ prathamāni padāni punarādāyam ardharcaśasyavac chaṃsati | madhyame paryāye madhyamāny uttama uttamāni ||
body.translated_text: Of the <s>Stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s>, he recites the first feet as a repetition, in the manner of half-verse recitation. In the middle <s>Paryāya</s> (round), the middle [feet]; in the last, the last [feet].
Like the morning pressing, the call and the <s>Uktha</s> completions, without tonal accent.

body.text: <4.2.5> (26.5) <vayam u tvā tad id arthāḥ [20.18.1-3]> <vayam indra tvāyavaḥ [20.18.4]> iti stotriyānurūpau ||
body.translated_text: "vayam u tvā tad id arthāḥ" [20.18.1-3] and "vayam indra tvāyavaḥ" [20.18.4] are the <s>Stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s>.

body.text: <4.2.6> (26.6) ūrdhvaṃ sarvatra trīṇi sūktāni | antyaṃ pacchaḥ paryāsaḥ ||
body.translated_text: Beyond [this], everywhere three hymns. The last, in reverse order, is the <s>Paryāsa</s> (conclusion).

body.text: <4.2.7> (26.7) <ya ud ṛci [20.21.11]> iti paridhānīyā | <apsu dhūtasya [20.33.1]> iti yājyā ||
body.translated_text: "ya ud ṛci" [20.21.11] is the <s>Paridhānīyā</s> (enclosing verse). "apsu dhūtasya" [20.33.1] is the offering verse.

body.text: <4.2.8> (26.8) madhyame <trivṛd asi trivṛte tvā trivṛtaṃ jinva | pravṛd asi pravṛte tvā pravṛtaṃ jinva | svavṛd asi svavṛte tvā svavṛtaṃ jinva | anuvṛd asy anuvṛte tvānuvṛtaṃ jinva [cf. TS 4.4.1.3, PB 1.10.9, KS 37.17, GB 2.2.14]> iti ||
body.translated_text: In the middle [round]: "trivṛd asi trivṛte tvā trivṛtaṃ jinva" (You are the threefold; for the threefold I take you, prosper the threefold), "pravṛd asi pravṛte tvā pravṛtaṃ jinva" (You are the forth-turning; for the forth-turning I take you, prosper the forth-turning), "svavṛd asi svavṛte tvā svavṛtaṃ jinva" (You are the self-turning; for the self-turning I take you, prosper the self-turning), "anuvṛd asy anuvṛte tvānuvṛtaṃ jinva" (You are the after-turning; for the after-turning I take you, prosper the after-turning) [cf. TS 4.4.1.3, PB 1.10.9, KS 37.17, GB 2.2.14].

body.text: <4.2.9> (26.9) <abhi tvā vṛṣabhā sute [20.22.1-3]> <abhi pra gopatiṃ girā [20.22.4-6]> iti stotriyānurūpau ||
body.translated_text: "abhi tvā vṛṣabhā sute" [20.22.1-3] and "abhi pra gopatiṃ girā" [20.22.4-6] are the <s>Stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s>.

body.text: <4.2.10> (26.10) <barhir vā yat svapatyāya [20.25.6]> iti paridhānīyā | <progrāṃ pītim [20.25.7]> iti yājyā ||
body.translated_text: "barhir vā yat svapatyāya" [20.25.6] is the <s>Paridhānīyā</s> (enclosing verse). "progrāṃ pītim" [20.25.7] is the offering verse.

body.text: <4.2.11> (26.11) uttame <āroho 'sy ārohāya tvārohaṃ jinva | praroho 'si prarohāya tvā prarohaṃ jinva | saṃroho 'si saṃrohāya tvā saṃrohaṃ jinva | anuroho 'sy anurohāya tvānurohaṃ jinva [cf. TS 4.4.1.3, PB 1.10.10, GB 2.2.14]> iti ||
body.translated_text: In the last [round]: "āroho 'sy ārohāya tvārohaṃ jinva" (You are the ascent; for the ascent I take you, prosper the ascent), "praroho 'si prarohāya tvā prarohaṃ jinva" (You are the sprouting forth; for the sprouting forth I take you, prosper the sprouting forth), "saṃroho 'si saṃrohāya tvā saṃrohaṃ jinva" (You are the growing together; for the growing together I take you, prosper the growing together), "anuroho 'sy anurohāya tvānurohaṃ jinva" (You are the growing after; for the growing after I take you, prosper the growing after) [cf. TS 4.4.1.3, PB 1.10.10, GB 2.2.14].
"yogeyoge tavastaram" [20.26.1-3] and "yuñjanti bradhnam aruṣam" [20.26.4-6] are the <s>Stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s>.

body.text: <4.2.13> (26.13) <apāḥ pūrveṣām [20.32.3]> iti paridhānīyā | <ūtī śacīvaḥ [20.33.3]> iti yājyā ||
body.translated_text: "apāḥ pūrveṣām" [20.32.3] is the <s>Paridhānīyā</s>. "ūtī śacīvaḥ" [20.33.3] is the offering verse.

body.text: <4.2.14> (26.14) hotra āśvināya prasauti <vasuko 'si vasyaṣṭir asi veṣaśrīr asi | vasukāya tvā vasyaṣṭyai tvā veṣaśriyai tvā | vasukaṃ jinva vasyaṣṭiṃ jinva veṣaśriyaṃ jinva [cf. TS 4.4.1.3, PB 1.10.11, KS 37.17, GB 2.2.14]> iti ||
body.translated_text: For the <s>Hotṛ</s>, for the <s>Āśvina</s> [cup], he gives the signal: "vasuko 'si vasyaṣṭir asi veṣaśrīr asi | vasukāya tvā vasyaṣṭyai tvā veṣaśriyai tvā | vasukaṃ jinva vasyaṣṭiṃ jinva veṣaśriyaṃ jinva" (You are the wealth-giver, you are the attainer of better, you are the beauty of form; for the wealth-giving I take you, for the attaining of better, for the beauty of form; prosper the wealth-giving, prosper the attaining of better, prosper the beauty of form) [cf. TS 4.4.1.3, PB 1.10.11, KS 37.17, GB 2.2.14].
Thus the fourfold <s>Jyotiṣṭoma</s> (light-praise sacrifice), excluding the <s>Atyagniṣṭoma</s>.
This is the archetype of the <s>Soma</s> sacrifices.
The <s>Vājapeya</s> (drink of strength) [is performed] in autumn.
Everything [in it] is in seventeens.
The priests wear golden garlands.
After the <s>Marutvatīya</s>, the <s>Bārhaspatya-iṣṭi</s> (offering to <s>Bṛhaspati</s>), from the ghee portions to the <s>Iḍā</s>.

body.text: <4.3.6> (27.6) yūpam ārohyamāṇo yajamāna āha <devasya savituḥ save svargaṃ varṣiṣṭhaṃ nākaṃ ruheyam [GB 2.5.8]> <pṛṣṭhāt pṛthivyā aham [4.14.3-5]> iti ||
body.translated_text: The sacrificer, climbing the sacrificial post, says: "devasya savituḥ save svargaṃ varṣiṣṭhaṃ nākaṃ ruheyam" (By the impulsion of god <s>Savitṛ</s>, may I ascend to the highest heaven, the vault) [GB 2.5.8], and "pṛṣṭhāt pṛthivyā aham" [4.14.3-5].
Having climbed, he gazes [around] with "yāvat te" [12.1.33].

body.text: <4.3.8> (27.8) avaruhya <bhūme mātaḥ [12.1.63]> iti yūpavāsāṃsi brahmaṇe dadāti ||
body.translated_text: Having descended, with "bhūme mātaḥ" [12.1.63], he gives the garments tied to the post to the <s>Brahman</s> priest.

body.text: <4.3.9> (27.9) tīrthadeśe rathacakram āruhyāparājitābhimukho 'śvarathān īkṣamāṇa āsīno vājasāmābhigāyati triḥ <āvir maryā ā vājaṃ vājino 'gman | devasya savituḥ save svargam arvanto jayema [SV 1.435]> iti ||
body.translated_text: At a designated spot, having mounted a chariot wheel, facing the unconquered [direction], looking at the horse-chariots, seated, he sings the <s>Vāja-sāman</s> (strength-chant) three times: "āvir maryā ā vājaṃ vājino 'gman | devasya savituḥ save svargam arvanto jayema" (Openly the young men have come for the prize, the prize-seekers; by the impulsion of god <s>Savitṛ</s>, may we conquer heaven with our steeds) [SV 1.435].
"tad vo gāya" [20.78.1] is the <s>Stotriya</s>.
He inserts the <s>Abhiplava</s> (overflow) <s>Stotriyas</s>.

body.text: <4.3.12> (27.12) mādhyaṃdine <indra kratuṃ na ā bhara [20.79.1-2]> iti stotriyaḥ | <indra jyeṣṭham [20.80.1-2]> <ud u tye madhumattamāḥ [20.59.1-2]> iti vā ||
body.translated_text: At the midday pressing, "indra kratuṃ na ā bhara" [20.79.1-2] is the <s>Stotriya</s>; or "indra jyeṣṭham" [20.80.1-2] and "ud u tye madhumattamāḥ" [20.59.1-2].
"kan navyo atasīnām" [20.50.1-2] is the <s>Sāma-pragātha</s> (Sāman verse-pair).
He inserts the <s>Ahīna</s> (multi-day) hymn.

body.text: <4.3.15> (27.15) tṛtīyasavane <ya eka id vidayate [20.63.4-6]> <ya indra somapātamaḥ [20.63.7-9]> ity ukthastotriyānurūpau ||
body.translated_text: At the third pressing, "ya eka id vidayate" [20.63.4-6] and "ya indra somapātamaḥ" [20.63.7-9] are the <s>Uktha-stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s>.

body.text: <4.3.16> (27.16) ūrdhvaṃ ṣoḍaśino hotre <nābhur asi saptadaśa prajāpatir asi prajāpataye tvā prajāpatiṃ jinva [cf. GB 2.2.13]> iti ||
body.translated_text: Beyond the <s>Ṣoḍaśin</s>, for the <s>Hotṛ</s>: "nābhur asi saptadaśa prajāpatir asi prajāpataye tvā prajāpatiṃ jinva" (You are the navel, [you are] the seventeenth, you are <s>Prajāpati</s>; for <s>Prajāpati</s> I take you, prosper <s>Prajāpati</s>) [cf. GB 2.2.13].
Some [say] the <s>Bṛhaspati-sava</s> (Bṛhaspati consecration) [is performed] alongside the sacrifice.
In the <s>Aptoryāma</s> (complete-course sacrifice), he recites the <s>Garbhakāra</s> (embryo-forming) [section].

body.text: <4.3.19> (27.19) <yuñjanti bradhnam aruṣam [20.26.4-6]> iti stotriyam | abhitaḥ <ā yāhi [20.3.1-3]> iti ||
body.translated_text: "yuñjanti bradhnam aruṣam" [20.26.4-6] is the <s>Stotriya</s>; on both sides, "ā yāhi" [20.3.1-3].

body.text: <4.3.20> (27.20) <bhindhi viśvā apa dviṣaḥ [20.43.1-3]> ity anurūpam | abhitaḥ <ā no yāhi [20.4.1-3]> iti ||
body.translated_text: "bhindhi viśvā apa dviṣaḥ" [20.43.1-3] is the <s>Anurūpa</s>; on both sides, "ā no yāhi" [20.4.1-3].
The insertions are as in the <s>Vājapeya</s>.

body.text: <4.3.22> (27.22) mādhyaṃdine <yad dyāva indra te śatam [20.81.1-2]> <yad indra yāvatas tvam [20.82.1-2]> iti stotriyānurūpāv abhitaḥ stotriyānurūpau ||
body.translated_text: At the midday pressing, "yad dyāva indra te śatam" [20.81.1-2] and "yad indra yāvatas tvam" [20.82.1-2] are the <s>Stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s>, with [another] <s>Stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s> pair on both sides.
After the <s>Sāma-pragātha</s>, "indra tridhātu śaraṇam" [20.83.1-2] is the <s>Sāma-pragātha</s>.
The <s>Sukīrti</s>, <s>Vṛṣākapi</s>, the <s>Sāma-sūkta</s>, and the <s>Ahīna-sūkta</s> — he inserts [these].

body.text: <4.3.25> (27.25) tṛtīyasavane <surūpakṛtnum ūtaye [20.57.1-3]> <śuṣmintamaṃ na ūtaye [20.57.4-6]> iti stotriyānurūpāv abhitaḥ stotriyānurūpau ||
body.translated_text: At the third pressing, "surūpakṛtnum ūtaye" [20.57.1-3] and "śuṣmintamaṃ na ūtaye" [20.57.4-6] are the <s>Stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s>, with [another] <s>Stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s> pair on both sides.
The remainder is like the <s>Pṛṣṭhya-ṣaḍaha</s> (six-day Pṛṣṭha cycle), including the <s>Atirātra</s> portion.

body.text: <4.3.27> (27.27) atiriktoktheṣu hotrādibhyaḥ prasauty <ākramo 'sy ākramāya tvākramaṃ jinva | saṃkramo 'si saṃkramāya tvā saṃkramaṃ jinva | utkramo 'sy utkramāya tvotkramaṃ jinva | utkrāntir asy utkrāntyai tvotkrāntiṃ jinva [VSM 15.9, PB 1.10.12, GB 2.2.14]> iti ||
body.translated_text: For the additional <s>Ukthas</s> (laudations), for the <s>Hotṛ</s> and others, he gives the signal: "ākramo 'sy ākramāya tvākramaṃ jinva" (You are the step; for the step I take you, prosper the step), "saṃkramo 'si saṃkramāya tvā saṃkramaṃ jinva" (You are the crossing over; for the crossing I take you, prosper the crossing), "utkramo 'sy utkramāya tvotkramaṃ jinva" (You are the ascent; for the ascent I take you, prosper the ascent), "utkrāntir asy utkrāntyai tvotkrāntiṃ jinva" (You are the transcendence; for the transcendence I take you, prosper the transcendence) [VSM 15.9, PB 1.10.12, GB 2.2.14].

body.text: <4.3.28> (27.28) <tam indraṃ vājayāmasi [20.47.1-3]> <mahā;m indro ya ojasā [20.138.1-3]> iti stotriyānurupau | uttarau vā ||
body.translated_text: "tam indraṃ vājayāmasi" [20.47.1-3] and "mahām indro ya ojasā" [20.138.1-3] are the <s>Stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s>; or the following [pair].

body.text: <4.3.29> (27.29) <ā nūnam aśvinā yuvam [20.139]> <taṃ vāṃ ratham [20.143]> iti sūkte | pūrvasya daśamīṃ dvādaśīm uttaraṃ ca pacchaḥ ||
body.translated_text: "ā nūnam aśvinā yuvam" [20.139] and "taṃ vāṃ ratham" [20.143] are the hymns. Of the first, the tenth and twelfth [verses], and the latter [hymn] in reverse order.

body.text: <4.3.30> (27.30) <madhumatīr oṣadhīḥ [20.143.8]> iti paridhānīyā | uttarā yājyuttarā yājyā ||
body.translated_text: "madhumatīr oṣadhīḥ" [20.143.8] is the <s>Paridhānīyā</s> (enclosing verse). The next is the offering verse, the next is the offering verse.
Optionally, [when it is] not the first sacrifice, [there is] the fire [altar construction].
In connection with the <s>Mahāvrata</s> (great vow), [it is] obligatory.
[It is performed] at the <s>Phālgunī</s> [full moon]. In a <s>Sattra</s>, at the <s>Pauṣī</s> [full moon], following the qualities of that [season].

body.text: <5.1.4> (28.4) prājāpatye paśau samidhyamānavatīm anu <samās tvāgne [2.6]> iti japati ||
body.translated_text: At the <s>Prājāpatya</s> (dedicated to <s>Prajāpati</s>) animal [sacrifice], while [the fire] is being kindled, he mutters following [it] with "samās tvāgne" [2.6].
"ya ātmadāḥ" [4.2.1] [is recited] over the cut portions.
On the eighth [day], the fire-pan (<s>Ukhā</s>) is to be assembled.

body.text:
<5.1.7> (28.7) aṣṭagṛhītasyarcā stomam iti || [KauśS 5.7]
<5.1.8> (28.8) <pari tvāgne [7.71.1]> iti mṛtpiṇḍaṃ parilikhyamānam ||
body.translated_text: With the <s>Ṛc</s> verse "aṣṭagṛhītasya stomam" (The stoma of eight-taken) [KauśS 5.7]. (28.8) With "pari tvāgne" [7.71.1], [he recites over] the lump of clay being marked.
With "purīṣyo 'si" (You are the filler) [TS 4.1.3.2-3, VaitS 5.14], [he recites over it] being touched.
With "tvām agne" [2.6.3], [he recites over it] being placed on a lotus leaf.
With "āpo hi ṣṭhā" (For you, O waters) [1.5.1-4], [he recites over it] being sprinkled with a <s>Palāśa</s> (Butea frondosa) sprinkler.

body.text: <5.1.12> (28.12) <pṛthivīṃ tvā pṛthivyām [12.3.22-23]> ity ukhāṃ kriyamāṇām | punaḥkaraṇa iti bhāgaliḥ ||
body.translated_text: With "pṛthivīṃ tvā pṛthivyām" [12.3.22-23], [he recites over] the fire-pan being made. "At the remaking" — [this is the view of] <s>Bhāgali</s>.
With the third [verse, he recites over it] being fired.

body.text: <5.1.14> (28.14) āmāvāsyeneṣṭe | dīkṣaṇīyāyāṃ vaiśvānarādityayoś ca | <yad agne yāni kāni cid [19.64.3]> ity ukhye samidha ādhīyamānāḥ ||
body.translated_text: Having offered at the new-moon [day]; at the <s>Dīkṣaṇīya</s> (consecration) offering [and] that to <s>Vaiśvānara</s> and <s>Āditya</s>. With "yad agne yāni kāni cit" [19.64.3], the fuel sticks being placed on the portable fire.
With "saṃśitaṃ me" [3.19], [he recites over] the portable fire being raised.
With "ā tvāhārṣam" [6.87.1], [he recites over it] having been raised.
With "ud uttamam" [7.83.3], [he recites over] the bonds being unfastened.
He carries the portable fire for a year. Or [he does it] on the same day.
With "ā no bhara" [5.7], he has [the sacrificer] recite during the <s>Vanīvāhana</s> (carrying ceremony).

body.text: <5.1.20> (28.20) <garbho asy oṣadhīnām [5.25.7]> ity ukhyaṃ bhasmāpsv opyamānam ||
body.translated_text: With "garbho asy oṣadhīnām" (You are the embryo of the plants) [5.25.7], [he recites over] the portable fire being immersed in water among the ashes.

body.text: <5.1.21> (28.21) <saha rayyā nivartasva [sakala at KauśS 72.14, PS 1.41.3-4]> iti dvābhyām uptam ādīyamānam ||
body.translated_text: With two [verses beginning with] "saha rayyā nivartasva" (Return with wealth) [KauśS 72.14, PS 1.41.3-4], [he recites over the ashes] having been sown and being collected.
With "punas tvā" [12.2.6], the fuel sticks being placed on the portable fire.
At the end of the <s>Dīkṣā</s> (consecration), with "vi mimīṣva" [13.1.27], [he recites over] the altar-fire being measured.
With "apeta vīta" (Go away, depart) [18.1.55], [he recites over] the <s>Gārhapatya</s> being dug out.
With "ayaṃ te yoniḥ" (This is your womb) [3.20.1], [he recites over] the <s>Gārhapatya</s> bricks being placed.
With "namo 'stu te nirṛte" (Homage to you, O <s>Nirṛti</s>) [6.63.2], wearing the sacred thread on the right shoulder (<s>Pitryupavītin</s>), [he places] those dedicated to <s>Nirṛti</s>.

body.text: <5.1.27> (28.27) <yat te devī [6.63.1]> iti śikyāsandīrukmapāśān nairṛtyāṃ prāstān ||
body.translated_text: With "yat te devī" [6.63.1], [he recites over] the sling, seat, gold disc, and cords cast toward the <s>Nairṛtī</s> (southwest) direction.

body.text: <5.1.28> (28.28) anapekṣamāṇā etya <niveśanaḥ saṃgamanaḥ [10.8.42]> ity aindryā gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhante ||
body.translated_text: Without looking back, having come, with the <s>Aindrī</s> (verse to <s>Indra</s>) "niveśanaḥ saṃgamanaḥ" (The settler, the uniter) [10.8.42], they stand before the <s>Gārhapatya</s>.
Beginning with the <s>Prāyaṇīya</s> (introductory) offering [the procedure continues].
With "sīrā yuñjanti" (They yoke the ploughs) [3.17.1-2a], [he recites over] the plough being yoked.
With "lāṅgalaṃ pavīravat" (The plough with a share) [3.17.3], [he recites over it] ploughing.
With "kṛte yonau" (In the prepared womb) [3.17.2bcd], [he recites over one] sowing the plants.
With "brahma jajñānam" [4.1.1], [he recites over] the gold disc being placed.
With "hiraṇyagarbhaḥ" (The golden embryo) [4.2.7], [he recites over] the golden man.

body.text: <5.2.1> (29.1) <madhu vātāḥ [sakala at KauśS 91.1, PS 19.45.5-7]> iti kūrmam abhyajyamānam ||
body.translated_text: With "madhu vātāḥ" (Sweet blow the winds) [KauśS 91.1, PS 19.45.5-7], [he recites over] the tortoise being anointed.
With "viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi" (The deeds of <s>Viṣṇu</s>) [7.26.6], [he recites over] the mortar and pestle being placed.
With "ajo hi" [4.14.1], [he recites over] the goat's head.
After the forenoon <s>Upasads</s> (approach rites), they pile up the layers.

body.text: <5.2.5> (29.5) <vārtrahatyāya śavase [20.19.1]> <vi na indra [1.21.2]> <mṛgo na bhīmaḥ [7.84.3]> <vaiśvānaro na ūtaye [6.35.1]> iti citiṃcitiṃ purīṣācchannām ||
body.translated_text: With "vārtrahatyāya śavase" [20.19.1], "vi na indra" [1.21.2], "mṛgo na bhīmaḥ" [7.84.3], "vaiśvānaro na ūtaye" [6.35.1], [he recites over] each layer covered with filling material.

body.text: <5.2.6> (29.6) <agne jātān [7.34.1, 7.35.1]> iti dvābhyāṃ pañcamyāṃ citāv asapatneṣṭakā nidhīyamānāḥ ||
body.translated_text: <5.2.6> (29.6) With the two [verses] "agne jātān" [7.34.1, 7.35.1], on the fifth [layer], the <s>asapatnā</s> (rivalry-removing) bricks being placed.
<5.2.7> (29.7) The <s>stomabhāgikī</s> (stoma-portion) [bricks] with twenty-nine <s>stomabhāga</s> (stoma-portion) [mantras].

body.text: <5.2.8> (29.8) <tvām agne puṣkarād adhi [TS 4.1.3.2, VaitS 5.14]> iti gāyatrīḥ | <abodhy agniḥ [13.2.46]> iti traiṣṭubhīḥ | <saṃ samid [6.63.4]> ity ānuṣṭubhīḥ | <agniṃ hotāraṃ manye [20.67.3]> ity aticchāndasīḥ | gārhapatya uktham ||
body.translated_text: <5.2.8> (29.8) With "tvām agne puṣkarād adhi" [<s>TS</s> 4.1.3.2, <s>VaitS</s> 5.14], the <s>Gāyatrī</s> [verses]; with "abodhy agniḥ" [13.2.46], the <s>Triṣṭubh</s> [verses]; with "saṃ samid" [6.63.4], the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> [verses]; with "agniṃ hotāraṃ manye" [20.67.3], the <s>Atichandas</s> (hypermetric) [verses]. At the <s>Gārhapatya</s>, [he recites] the <s>Uktha</s> (laudation).
