<5.2.9> (29.9) With "ayam agniḥ satpatiḥ" [7.62.1] and "yenā sahasram" [9.5.17], at the <s>Punaściti</s> (re-piling).

body.text: <5.2.10> (29.10) <mā no devāḥ [6.56.1]> <bhavāśarvau mṛḍatam [11.2.1]> <yas te sarpaḥ [12.1.46]> iti raudrān ||
body.translated_text: <5.2.10> (29.10) With "mā no devāḥ" [6.56.1], "bhavāśarvau mṛḍatam" [11.2.1], and "yas te sarpaḥ" [12.1.46], the <s>Raudra</s> (relating to <s>Rudra</s>) [oblations].
<5.2.11> (29.11) With "aśmavarma me" [5.10.1-7], the enclosing [bricks].

body.text: <5.2.12> (29.12) havanaprāsanād āgnīdhraḥ <yā āpo divyāḥ [4.8.5]> iti citiṃ pariṣiñcati ||
body.translated_text: <5.2.12> (29.12) After the offering and eating, the <s>Āgnīdhra</s> sprinkles the [fire-altar] layer with "yā āpo divyāḥ" (Which waters are celestial) [4.8.5].

body.text: <5.2.13> (29.13) <idaṃ va āpaḥ [3.13.7]> <himasya tvā [6.106.3]> <upa dyām upa vetasam [18.3.5]> <apām idam [6.106.2]> iti maṇḍūkāvakāvetasair dakṣiṇādi pratidiśaṃ vikṛṣyamāṇām ||
body.translated_text: <5.2.13> (29.13) With "idaṃ va āpaḥ" [3.13.7], "himasya tvā" [6.106.3], "upa dyām upa vetasam" [18.3.5], and "apām idam" [6.106.2], [he recites over] the [layer] being dragged in each direction beginning from the south, with frogs, reeds, and cane.

body.text: <5.2.14> (29.14) <yo viśvacarṣaṇiḥ [13.2.26]> ity aupavasathye ṣoḍaśagṛhītārdhasya | <sa naḥ pitā janitā [2.1.3]> ity uttarārdhasya ||
body.translated_text: <5.2.14> (29.14) With "yo viśvacarṣaṇiḥ" [13.2.26], [he recites over] the first half of the <s>Aupavasathya</s> (dwelling-fire) sixteen-grasped [<s>Graha</s>]; with "sa naḥ pitā janitā" [2.1.3], the second half.

body.text: <5.2.15> (29.15) <ud enam uttaraṃ naya [6.5.1]> iti samidha ādhīyamānāḥ ||
body.translated_text: <5.2.15> (29.15) With "ud enam uttaraṃ naya" (Lead him upward to the highest) [6.5.1], the fuel-sticks being placed.
<5.2.16> (29.16) Having been directed, he mutters the <s>Apratiratha</s> (irresistible) [hymn].
<5.2.17> (29.17) With "kramadhvam agninā" [4.14.2-5], with the four [verses] they ascend the [fire-altar] layer.
<5.2.18> (29.18) With "tāṃ savitaḥ" [7.15], the fuel-sticks being placed.

body.text: <5.2.19> (29.19) <catvāri śṛṅgā [sakala at GB 1.2.16, PS 8.13.3]> <abhy arcata [7.82.1]> iti japati ||
body.translated_text: <5.2.19> (29.19) He mutters "catvāri śṛṅgā" (Four horns) [<s>sakala</s> at <s>GB</s> 1.2.16, <s>PS</s> 8.13.3] and "abhy arcata" [7.82.1].

body.text: <5.2.20> (29.20) <agne acchā [3.20.2-4]> iti tisraḥ | <aryamaṇaṃ bṛhaspatim [3.20.7-8]> iti dve | <vājasya nu prasave [7.6.4]> iti vājaprasavīyahomān ||
body.translated_text: <5.2.20> (29.20) With "agne acchā" [3.20.2-4], three [verses]; with "aryamaṇaṃ bṛhaspatim" [3.20.7-8], two [verses]; with "vājasya nu prasave" [7.6.4], the <s>Vājaprasavīya</s> (oblations for the impelling of vigor) oblations.
<5.2.21> (29.21) With "saṃ mā siñcantu" (May they sprinkle me together) [7.33.1], he has [the sacrificer] recite while being consecrated by sprinkling.

body.text: <5.2.22> (29.22-23) <ye bhakṣayantaḥ [2.35]> <etaṃ sadhasthāḥ [6.123.1-2]> iti dve | <yenā sahasram [9.5.17]> iti vaiśvakarmaṇahomān ||
body.translated_text: <5.2.22> (29.22-23) With "ye bhakṣayantaḥ" [2.35] and "etaṃ sadhasthāḥ" [6.123.1-2], two [verses]; with "yenā sahasram" [9.5.17], the <s>Vaiśvakarmaṇa</s> (oblations to <s>Viśvakarman</s>) oblations.

<5.3.1> (30.1) One who has piled the fire-altar (<s>Agnicit</s>), one whose <s>Soma</s> has been excessively purified (<s>Somātipūta</s>), or one who has vomited <s>Soma</s> (<s>Somavāmin</s>) is consecrated by the <s>Sautrāmaṇī</s> rite.
<5.3.2> (30.2) [It is] for one who has risen up [in society], desiring preeminence over those who are better.
<5.3.3> (30.3) Not for one who has not performed the <s>Soma</s> sacrifice.
<5.3.4> (30.4) [There is] the <s>Āditya</s> offering.
<5.3.5> (30.5) An animal [sacrifice] dedicated to <s>Indra</s>.

body.text: <5.3.6> (30.6) rasaprāśanyā <yā babhravaḥ [8.7]> ity oṣadhībhiḥ surāṃ saṃdhīyamānām ||
body.translated_text: <5.3.6> (30.6) At the tasting of the juice (<s>rasaprāśana</s>), with "yā babhravaḥ" (Which are brown) [8.7], [he recites over] the <s>surā</s> (liquor) being prepared with herbs.
<5.3.7> (30.7) With "vāyoḥ pūtaḥ" [6.51], [he recites over] the <s>Somātipūta</s>'s [<s>Soma</s>] being purified.
<5.3.8> (30.8) For the <s>Somavāmin</s> (one who has vomited <s>Soma</s>), with the modified [version beginning] "prāk somaḥ" (First <s>Soma</s>).

body.text: <5.3.9> (30.9) <adhvaryo adribhiḥ sutaṃ somaṃ pavitra āsṛja | punīhīndrāya pātave [ṚV 9.51.1]> ity adhvaryuṃ pāvayantam ||
body.translated_text: <5.3.9> (30.9) With "adhvaryo adribhiḥ sutaṃ somaṃ pavitra āsṛja, punīhīndrāya pātave" (O <s>Adhvaryu</s>, release the <s>Soma</s> pressed by stones into the filter; purify [it] for <s>Indra</s> to drink) [<s>ṚV</s> 9.51.1], [he recites over] the <s>Adhvaryu</s> purifying [the <s>Soma</s>].

body.text: <5.3.10> (30.10) gṛhīteṣv ājyeṣu <kuvid aṅga yavamantaḥ [20.125.2]> iti payograhān gṛhṇantam ||
body.translated_text: <5.3.10> (30.10) When the <s>ājya</s> (clarified butter) [portions] have been taken, with "kuvid aṅga yavamantaḥ" [20.125.2], [he recites over one] taking the milk-portions (<s>payograha</s>).

body.text: <5.3.11> (30.11) vapāmārjanāt <yuvaṃ surāmam aśvinā [20.125.4-7]> iti catasṛbhiḥ payaḥsurāgrahāṇām | saurāṇāṃ na bhakṣaṇam ||
body.translated_text: <5.3.11> (30.11) After the wiping of the omentum, with "yuvaṃ surāmam aśvinā" (You two, O <s>Aśvins</s>, [drank] the <s>surā</s>) [20.125.4-7], four [verses] for the milk and <s>surā</s> cups. There is no partaking of the <s>surā</s> [cups].

body.text: <5.3.12> (30.12) āśvinasyaike <yam aśvinā namucer āsurād adhi sarasvaty asunod indriyāya | imaṃ taṃ śukraṃ madhumantam induṃ somaṃ rājānam iha bhakṣayāmi [VS 19.34, TB 2.6.3.1]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <5.3.12> (30.12) Some [authorities prescribe] for the <s>Āśvina</s> (cup dedicated to the <s>Aśvins</s>): "yam aśvinā namucer āsurād adhi sarasvaty asunod indriyāya, imaṃ taṃ śukraṃ madhumantam induṃ somaṃ rājānam iha bhakṣayāmi" (The one whom <s>Sarasvatī</s> pressed out from the <s>Asura</s> <s>Namuci</s> for <s>Indra</s>'s sake, for the <s>Aśvins</s> — this bright, honey-sweet drop, <s>Soma</s> the king, I partake of here) [<s>VS</s> 19.34, <s>TB</s> 2.6.3.1].

body.text: <5.3.13> (30.13) <punantu mā [6.19]> <girāv aragarāṭeṣu [6.69]> <yad giriṣu [9.1.18]> iti śatātṛṇām āsicyamānām ||
body.translated_text: <5.3.13> (30.13) With "punantu mā" (May they purify me) [6.19], "girāv aragarāṭeṣu" [6.69], and "yad giriṣu" [9.1.18], [he recites over] the <s>Śatātṛṇā</s> (hundred-stemmed plant) being poured.

body.text: <5.3.14> (30.14) <ud īratām [18.1.44-45]> iti dve <barhiṣadaḥ pitaraḥ [18.1.51]> <upahūtā naḥ pitaraḥ [18.3.45]> <agniṣvāttāḥ [18.3.44]> iti pañca japati ||
body.translated_text: <5.3.14> (30.14) He mutters five [verses]: "ud īratām" [18.1.44-45], two [verses]; "barhiṣadaḥ pitaraḥ" (O fathers seated on the sacred grass) [18.1.51]; "upahūtā naḥ pitaraḥ" (Our fathers have been invoked) [18.3.45]; and "agniṣvāttāḥ" (Consumed by fire) [18.3.44].

body.text: <5.3.15> (30.15) āśvinasārasvataindrapaśūnām | vanaspatiyāgād abhiṣicyamānam <oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad om> iti vācayati ||
body.translated_text: <5.3.15> (30.15) [These are] for the animal [sacrifices] dedicated to the <s>Aśvins</s>, <s>Sarasvatī</s>, and <s>Indra</s>. After the offering to the Lord of the Forest (<s>Vanaspati</s>), he has [the sacrificer] recite while being consecrated: "oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad om."

body.text: <5.3.16> (30.16) sāmagānāya preṣitaḥ <bṛhad indrāya gāyata maruto vṛtrahantamam | yena jyotir ajanayann ṛtāvṛdho devaṃ devāya jāgṛvi [ṚV 8.89.1, SV 1.258]> ity aindryāṃ bṛhatyāṃ saṃśānāni gāyati ||
body.translated_text: <5.3.16> (30.16) When directed for the <s>Sāma</s>-chanting, he sings the <s>Saṃśāni</s> (chants of praise) to the <s>Aindrī Bṛhatī</s> (the <s>Bṛhatī</s> meter dedicated to <s>Indra</s>): "bṛhad indrāya gāyata maruto vṛtrahantamam, yena jyotir ajanayann ṛtāvṛdho devaṃ devāya jāgṛvi" (Sing the great [chant] to <s>Indra</s>, the foremost <s>Vṛtra</s>-slayer, O <s>Maruts</s>; by whom the upholders of cosmic order generated the light, the god [sung] for the god, ever wakeful) [<s>ṚV</s> 8.89.1, <s>SV</s> 1.258].

body.text: <5.3.17> (30.17) <saṃ tvā hinvanti dhāitāibhī3ḥ saṃ tvā riṇanti saṃ tvā śiśanti saṃ tvā tatakṣuḥ [LāṭyŚS 8.8.11-13]> iti pratipadaḥ ||
body.translated_text: <5.3.17> (30.17) "saṃ tvā hinvanti dhāitāibhī3ḥ, saṃ tvā riṇanti, saṃ tvā śiśanti, saṃ tvā tatakṣuḥ" (They impel you with streams, they release you, they sharpen you, they fashioned you) [<s>LāṭyŚS</s> 8.8.11-13] — these are the opening verses (<s>pratipads</s>).

<5.3.18> (30.18) "saṃśravase viśravase satyaśravase śravase" (For hearing together, for hearing widely, for hearing truly, for hearing) [<s>GB</s> 2.5.7] — these are the final syllables (<s>nidhanas</s>).

body.text: <5.3.19> (30.19) <saṃjityai vijityai satyajityai jityai [LāṭyŚS 5.4.19]> iti kṣatriyasya | <saṃpuṣṭyai vipuṣṭyai satyapuṣṭyai puṣṭyai [LāṭyŚS 5.4.19]> iti vaiśyasya ||
body.translated_text: <5.3.19> (30.19) For a <s>Kṣatriya</s>: "saṃjityai vijityai satyajityai jityai" (For conquering together, for conquering fully, for conquering truly, for conquering) [<s>LāṭyŚS</s> 5.4.19]; for a <s>Vaiśya</s>: "saṃpuṣṭyai vipuṣṭyai satyapuṣṭyai puṣṭyai" (For nourishing together, for nourishing fully, for nourishing truly, for nourishing) [<s>LāṭyŚS</s> 5.4.19].
<5.3.20> (30.20) All join in the final syllable (<s>nidhana</s>).
<5.3.21> (30.21) After the oblation on the sacred grass, [there is] the <s>Avabhṛtha</s> (concluding bath).
<5.3.22> (30.22) With "yad devāḥ" [6.114], [he recites over] the <s>māsara</s>-pot (fermentation vessel) being set afloat.
<5.3.23> (30.23) With "drupadād iva" (As from a tree-trunk) [6.115.3], [he recites over] the garment.
<5.3.24> (30.24) At the <s>Maitrāvaruṇī</s> (full-moon dedicated to <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>), the <s>Ikṣeṣṭi</s> (sugarcane offering).
<5.3.25> (30.25) An animal [sacrifice] to <s>Indra Vayodhasa</s> (<s>Indra</s> the bestower of vigor).
<5.3.26> (30.26) [There is] the <s>Āditya</s> offering.

body.text: <5.3.27> (30.27) <dūre cit santam [3.3.2]> iti praṇavāntayā tānena mantroktam upatiṣṭhante mantroktam upatiṣṭhante ||
body.translated_text: <5.3.27> (30.27) With "dūre cit santam" (Even being far away) [3.3.2], ending with <s>praṇava</s> (the syllable <s>Om</s>), they approach with a prolonged chant what is prescribed by the mantra — they approach what is prescribed by the mantra.

body.text: <6.1.1> (31.1) mādhyāḥ purastād ekādaśyāṃ saptadaśāvarāḥ sattram upayanto brāhmaṇoktena dīkṣeran ||
body.translated_text: <6.1.1> (31.1) The middling [priests], on the eleventh [day] preceding, seventeen or fewer, entering upon a <s>Sattra</s> (communal sacrifice), should undergo <s>Dīkṣā</s> (consecration) as described in the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>.
<6.1.2> (31.2) [They should be] those whose first sacrifice has been an <s>Iṣṭi</s> (offering); or [it may be led by] the householder (<s>Gṛhapati</s>).
<6.1.3> (31.3) Having heaped [the fires] together in his fire, they sacrifice to <s>Prajāpati</s> as the <s>Agnīt</s> (fire-kindler).

body.text: <6.1.4> (31.4) ahnāṃ vidhānyām ekāṣṭakāyām apūpaṃ catuḥśarāvaṃ paktvā prātar etena kakṣam upoṣet <ayaṃ no nabhasaspatiḥ [6.79.1]> iti mantroktadevatābhyaḥ saṃkalpayan ||
body.translated_text: <6.1.4> (31.4) In the ritual prescriptions for the days, on the <s>Ekāṣṭakā</s> (eighth day after the full moon), having cooked a cake (<s>apūpa</s>) in four dishes, in the morning he should fast until the [appointed] time with this [verse], dedicating to the deities mentioned in the mantra "ayaṃ no nabhasaspatiḥ" (This our lord of the sky) [6.79.1].

body.text: <6.1.5> (31.5) yadi dahati puṇyasamaṃ bhavaty atha na dahati pāpasamam ||
body.translated_text: <6.1.5> (31.5) If [the fire] burns [the cake], [the year will be] equal in merit; if it does not burn [it], [the year will be] equal in demerit.
<6.1.6> (31.6) Now the <s>Gavāmayana</s> (year-long <s>Soma</s> sacrifice, lit. "cow's march").

body.text: <6.1.7> (31.7) prāyaṇīyaś caturviṃśam abhiplavāś catvāraḥ pṛṣṭhya iti prathamo māsaḥ ||
body.translated_text: <6.1.7> (31.7) The <s>Prāyaṇīya</s> (introductory day) has the <s>Caturviṃśa</s> (twenty-four-fold) <s>Stoma</s>; four <s>Abhiplava</s> (six-day cycles) and a <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> (six-day cycle) — this [constitutes] the first month.
<6.1.8> (31.8) Similarly [for] the [next] four [months], excluding the <s>Prāyaṇīya</s> and <s>Caturviṃśa</s> [day].
<6.1.9> (31.9) Three <s>Abhiplava</s> [cycles], a <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s>, an <s>Abhijit</s> (victory day), and a <s>Svarasāman</s> (self-sounding <s>Sāman</s> day) — this [constitutes] the sixth [month].
<6.1.10> (31.10) The extra [day], the self (<s>Ātman</s>), is the <s>Viṣuvat</s> (solstice day, the midpoint).
<6.1.11> (31.11) The latter half is reversed [in sequence].

body.text: <6.1.12> (31.12) svarasāmāno viśvajit pṛṣṭhyo 'bhiplavāś catvāra iti saptamaḥ ||
body.translated_text: <6.1.12> (31.12) A <s>Svarasāman</s>, a <s>Viśvajit</s> (all-conquering day), a <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s>, and four <s>Abhiplava</s> [cycles] — this [constitutes] the seventh [month].
<6.1.13> (31.13) Similarly [for] the [next] four [months], excluding the <s>Svarasāman</s> and <s>Viśvajit</s>.

body.text: <6.1.14> (31.14) abhiplavau gavāyuṣī daśarātra ūrdhvastomo mahāvratam udayanīya iti dvādaśaḥ ||
body.translated_text: <6.1.14> (31.14) Two <s>Abhiplava</s> [cycles], the <s>Gavāyuṣī</s> (cow-life [days]), a <s>Daśarātra</s> (ten-day rite), an <s>Ūrdhvastoma</s> (ascending <s>Stoma</s> day), the <s>Mahāvrata</s> (great vow day), and the <s>Udayanīya</s> (concluding day) — this [constitutes] the twelfth [month].

body.text:
<6.1.15> (31.15) tad etac chloko 'bhivadati <dvāv atirātrau ṣaṭśatam agniṣṭomā dve viṃśatiśate ukthyānām | dvādaśa ṣoḍaśinaḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ ṣaḍahā vaiṣuvataṃ ca [GB 1.5.23]> iti
<6.1.16> (31.16) caturviṃśe <indram id gāthino bṛhat [20.38.4-6]> ity ājyastotriyaḥ | <indrā yāhi citrabhāno [20.84]> iti vā ||
body.translated_text: <6.1.15> (31.15) On this, a verse declares: "Two <s>Atirātras</s> (overnight rites), six hundred <s>Agniṣṭomas</s>, two thousand and twenty <s>Ukthyas</s> (laudation days), twelve <s>Ṣoḍaśins</s> (sixteen-fold days), sixty <s>ṣaḍahas</s> (six-day cycles), and the <s>Vaiṣuvata</s> (solstice day)" [<s>GB</s> 1.5.23]. <6.1.16> (31.16) At the <s>Caturviṃśa</s> (twenty-four-fold) [day], "indram id gāthino bṛhat" [20.38.4-6] is the <s>Ājya-stotriya</s> (butter-chant verse); or "indrā yāhi citrabhāno" [20.84].
<6.1.17> (31.17) He inserts the <s>Ābhiplavika</s> (relating to the <s>Abhiplava</s> cycle) <s>Stotriyas</s> from the third [day] onward.

body.text: <6.1.18> (31.18) <abhi pra vaḥ surādhasam [20.51.1-2]> <pra su śrutaṃ surādhasam [20.51.3-4]> iti pṛṣṭhastotriyānurūpau bārhatau pragāthau | <mā cid anyad vi śaṃsata [20.85.1-2]> <yac cid dhi tvā janā ime [20.85.3-4]> iti vā ||
body.translated_text: <6.1.18> (31.18) "abhi pra vaḥ surādhasam" [20.51.1-2] and "pra su śrutaṃ surādhasam" [20.51.3-4] are the <s>Pṛṣṭha-stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s>, the <s>Bārhatī Pragāthas</s> (couplets in <s>Bṛhatī</s> meter). Or "mā cid anyad vi śaṃsata" [20.85.1-2] and "yac cid dhi tvā janā ime" [20.85.3-4].

body.text: <6.1.19> (31.19) <asmā id u pra tavase turāya [20.35]> ity ahīnasūktam āvapate ||
body.translated_text: <6.1.19> (31.19) He inserts "asmā id u pra tavase turāya" [20.35] as the <s>Ahīna-sūkta</s> (hymn for the multi-day rite).

body.text: <6.1.20> (31.20) abhijiti viṣauvati viśvajiti mahāvrate ca | <ya eka id vidayate [20.63.4-6]> <ya indra somapātamaḥ [20.63.7-9]> ity ukthastotriyānurūpau ||
body.translated_text: <6.1.20> (31.20) At the <s>Abhijit</s>, <s>Viṣuvat</s>, <s>Viśvajit</s>, and <s>Mahāvrata</s> [days]: "ya eka id vidayate" [20.63.4-6] and "ya indra somapātamaḥ" [20.63.7-9] are the <s>Uktha-stotriya</s> (laudation verse) and <s>Anurūpa</s>.

body.text: <6.1.21> (31.21) abhiplave <ā yāhi suṣumā hi te [20.38]> iti ṣaḍ ājyastotriyā ārambhaṇīyāparyāsavarjam ||
body.translated_text: <6.1.21> (31.21) In the <s>Abhiplava</s> [cycle], "ā yāhi suṣumā hi te" [20.38] — six [verses] are the <s>Ājya-stotriyas</s>, excluding the opening and concluding [verses].

body.text: <6.1.22> (31.22) <vātrahatyāya śavase [20.19.1-3]> <śuṣmintamaṃ na ūtaye [20.20.1-3]> <ā tū na indra madryak [20.23.1-3]> <upa naḥ sutam ā gahi [20.24.1-3]> <yad indrāhaṃ yathā tvam aśīya [20.27.1-3]> <apām ūrmir madann iva [20.28.4, 20.29.1-2]> iti tṛcān āvapate ||
body.translated_text: <6.1.22> (31.22) He inserts the <s>tṛcas</s> (verse-triplets): "vātrahatyāya śavase" [20.19.1-3], "śuṣmintamaṃ na ūtaye" [20.20.1-3], "ā tū na indra madryak" [20.23.1-3], "upa naḥ sutam ā gahi" [20.24.1-3], "yad indrāhaṃ yathā tvam aśīya" [20.27.1-3], and "apām ūrmir madann iva" [20.28.4, 20.29.1-2].
<6.1.23> (31.23) "taṃ vo dasmamṛtīṣaham" [20.49.4-7] — [these are] the <s>Pṛṣṭha-stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s>.
<6.1.24> (31.24) "abhi pra vaḥ surādhasam" [20.51] on the even [days].

body.text: <6.1.25> (31.25) <indraḥ pūrbhid ātirad dāsam arkaiḥ [20.11]> <ya eka id dhavyaś carṣaṇīnām [20.36]> <yas tigmaśṛṅgo vṛṣabho na bhīmaḥ [20.37]> iti saṃpātānām ekaikam aharahar āvapate | pṛṣṭhye chandomeṣu daśame ca ||
body.translated_text: <6.1.25> (31.25) "indraḥ pūrbhid ātirad dāsam arkaiḥ" [20.11], "ya eka id dhavyaś carṣaṇīnām" [20.36], and "yas tigmaśṛṅgo vṛṣabho na bhīmaḥ" [20.37] — one each of the <s>Saṃpātas</s> (insertions) is inserted day by day; in the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> [cycle], in the <s>Chandomas</s> (meter-days), and on the tenth [day].

body.text: <6.1.26> (31.26) madhyameṣu <evā hy asi vīrayuḥ [20.60-62]> ity ukthastotriyānurūpāḥ ||
body.translated_text: <6.1.26> (31.26) On the middle [days], "evā hy asi vīrayuḥ" [20.60-62] — [these are] the <s>Uktha-stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s> [pairs].

body.text: <6.1.27> (31.27) pṛṣṭhyaṣaṣṭhe <vanoti hi sunvan kṣayaṃ parīṇasaḥ [20.67.1-3]> <viśveṣu hi tvā savaneṣu tuñjate [20.72.1-3]> iti pārucchepīr upadadhati dvayoḥ savanayoḥ purastāt prasthitayājyānām | <yajñaiḥ saṃmiślāḥ pṛṣatībhir ṛṣṭibhiḥ [20.67.4-7]> ity ṛtuyājyānām upariṣṭāt ||
body.translated_text: <6.1.27> (31.27) On the sixth [day] of the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> [cycle], he adds the <s>Pārucchepa</s> [hymns] "vanoti hi sunvan kṣayaṃ parīṇasaḥ" [20.67.1-3] and "viśveṣu hi tvā savaneṣu tuñjate" [20.72.1-3] at both pressings, before the <s>Prasthitayājyā</s> (offering verse recited during the carrying forward); "yajñaiḥ saṃmiślāḥ pṛṣatībhir ṛṣṭibhiḥ" [20.67.4-7] after the <s>Ṛtuyājyās</s> (seasonal offering verses).

body.text: <6.2.1> (32.1) ṣaḍahe 'bhiplavavad ājyastotriyāḥ | prathamayor āvāpaḥ pṛṣṭhastotriyānurūpau ca ||
body.translated_text: <6.2.1> (32.1) In the <s>Ṣaḍaha</s> (six-day cycle), the <s>Ājya-stotriyas</s> are as in the <s>Abhiplava</s>; for the first two [days], the insertions and the <s>Pṛṣṭha-stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s> [pairs] also [follow the <s>Abhiplava</s> pattern].
<6.2.2> (32.2) On the third [day], "vājeṣu sāsahir bhava" (Be victorious in the contests) [20.19.6, 7.20.1-3] — five verses.
<6.2.3> (32.3) On the fourth [day], "puruṣṭutasya dhāmabhiḥ" [20.19.4-7; 20.1-5] — nine [verses].

body.text: <6.2.4> (32.4) pañcame <yad indrāhaṃ yathā tvam [20.27-29]> iti pañcadaśa ||
body.translated_text: <6.2.4> (32.4) On the fifth [day], "yad indrāhaṃ yathā tvam" [20.27-29] — fifteen [verses].

body.text: <6.2.5> (32.5) ṣaṣṭhe <abhi pra gopatiṃ girā [20.92]> ity ekaviṃśatiḥ ||
body.translated_text: <6.2.5> (32.5) On the sixth [day], "abhi pra gopatiṃ girā" [20.92] — twenty-one [verses].

body.text: <6.2.6> (32.6) tṛtīyādīnāṃ <vayaṃ gha tvā sutāvantaḥ [20.52-56; 57.1-6]> iti pṛṣṭhastotriyānurūpāḥ ||
body.translated_text: <6.2.6> (32.6) For the third and following [days], "vayaṃ gha tvā sutāvantaḥ" [20.52-56; 57.1-6] — [these are] the <s>Pṛṣṭha-stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s> [pairs].

body.text: <6.2.7> (32.7) caturthe <tubhyedimā savanā śūra viśvā [20.73]> iti ṣaṭ purastāt saṃpātāt | tisro 'rdharcaśaḥ ||
body.translated_text: <6.2.7> (32.7) On the fourth [day], "tubhyedimā savanā śūra viśvā" [20.73] — six [verses] before the <s>Saṃpāta</s> (insertion); three in half-verses.

body.text: <6.2.8> (32.8) pañcame <yac cid dhi satya somapāḥ [20.74]> iti pāṅktaṃ saptarcam | dvaudvāv avasāya pañcamaṃ saṃtanoti | trayaṃ vāvasāya dvayam ||
body.translated_text: <6.2.8> (32.8) On the fifth [day], "yac cid dhi satya somapāḥ" [20.74] — a <s>Pāṅkta</s> (five-fold) [arrangement], seven verses. He combines two pairs, extending the fifth; or combines three, extending a pair.

body.text: <6.2.9> (32.9) ṣaṣṭhe <vi tvā tatasre mithunā avasyavaḥ [20.75]> iti sapta | padānām ekaikam avasāya dvayaṃ saṃtanoti | dvayam avasāya dvayam ||
body.translated_text: <6.2.9> (32.9) On the sixth [day], "vi tvā tatasre mithunā avasyavaḥ" [20.75] — seven [verses]. He combines each pair of <s>pādas</s> (metrical feet), extending a pair; [or] combines two, extending a pair.

body.text: <6.2.10> (32.10) <vane na vā yo nyadhāyi cākan [20.73]> ity aṣṭarcaṃ ca ||
body.translated_text: <6.2.10> (32.10) And "vane na vā yo nyadhāyi cākan" [20.73] — eight verses.
<6.2.11> (32.11) On the middle [days], the <s>Uktha-stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s> [pairs] are as in the <s>Abhiplava</s>.

body.text: <6.2.12> (32.12) ṣaṣṭhe <imā nu kaṃ bhuvanā sīṣadhāma [20.63.1, 2ab]> <hatvāya devā asurān yad āyan [20.63.2cd, 3]> iti dvaipadau pacchaḥ ||
body.translated_text: <6.2.12> (32.12) On the sixth [day], "imā nu kaṃ bhuvanā sīṣadhāma" [20.63.1, 2ab] and "hatvāya devā asurān yad āyan" [20.63.2cd, 3] — the two half-verse [pairs], in reverse order.

body.text: <6.2.13> (32.13) <apendra prāco maghavann amitrān [20.125]> iti sukīrtim | caturthīm ardharcaśaḥ ||
body.translated_text: <6.2.13> (32.13) "apendra prāco maghavann amitrān" [20.125] is the <s>Sukīrti</s> (hymn of good praise); the fourth [verse] in half-verses.

body.text: <6.2.14> (32.14) <vi hi sotor asṛkṣata [20.126]> iti vṛṣākapim | padāvagrāham anavānaṃ dvitīyeṣv avasyati | tṛtīyeṣu dvitīyāntyasvarayos tadādyoś ca nyūṅkhaninardān kṛtvā dvayaṃ saṃtanoti ||
body.translated_text: <6.2.14> (32.14) "vi hi sotor asṛkṣata" [20.126] is the <s>Vṛṣākapi</s> [hymn]. [He performs] a <s>pāda</s>-by-<s>pāda</s> grasping (<s>padāvagrāha</s>) without a pause in the second [sections]; in the third [sections], having made <s>nyūṅkha</s>-calls and <s>ninarda</s>-calls at the second and final <s>svaras</s> (tonal accents) and at the initial [notes] of those, he combines a pair.

body.text: <6.2.15> (32.15) nyūṅkhapratigareṣu prathamacaturthāṣṭamadvādaśeṣu plutiḥ | ninardeṣv ādyatṛtīyayoḥ | madhyamaḥ svaritaḥ ||
body.translated_text: <6.2.15> (32.15) In the <s>nyūṅkha</s>-responses (<s>pratigara</s>), the prolongation (<s>pluti</s>) [occurs] at the first, fourth, eighth, and twelfth [syllables]; in the <s>ninardas</s>, at the first and third; the middle [note] is <s>svarita</s> (circumflex).

body.text:
<6.2.16> (32.16) nidarśanam
<6.2.17> (32.17) <vi hi sotor asṛkṣata nendraṃ devam amaṃsata | yatro3 o o o3 o o o o3 o o o o3 madad vṛṣākapo3 o o3 aryaḥ puṣṭeṣu matsakhā viśvasmād indra uktarom [20.126.1]> | <parā hīndra [20.126.2]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <6.2.16> (32.16) An illustration: <6.2.17> (32.17) "vi hi sotor asṛkṣata nendraṃ devam amaṃsata, yatro3 o o o3 o o o o3 o o o o3 madad vṛṣākapo3 o o3 aryaḥ puṣṭeṣu matsakhā viśvasmād indra uktarom" [20.126.1]; "parā hīndra" [20.126.2].

body.text: <6.2.18> (32.18) pratigare <o3 o o o3 o o o o3 o o o o3> | ninardasya <madetha madaivo3 o o3 thāmo daiva> iti ||
body.translated_text: For the <s>Pratigara</s> (response), [he recites] "o3 o o o3 o o o o3 o o o o3"; for the <s>Ninarda</s> (thundering response): "madetha madaivo3 o o3thāmo daiva" (You shall be intoxicated, by intoxication indeed, we affirm, O divine one).

body.text: <6.2.19> (32.19) <idaṃ janā upa śruta [20.127; 128]> iti kuntāpam ardharcaśaḥ | caturdaśa padāvagrāham ||
body.translated_text: "idaṃ janā upa śruta" (Listen to this, O people) [20.127-128] is the <s>Kuntāpa</s> [hymn], [recited] by half-verses, with groups of fourteen words.

body.text: <6.2.20> (32.20) <etā aśvā ā plavante [20.129-132]> ity aitaśapralāpaṃ padāvagrāham | tāsām uttamena pādena praṇauti ||
body.translated_text: "etā aśvā ā plavante" (These horses swim across) [20.129-132] is the <s>Aitaśa-pralāpa</s> (Aitaśa dialogue), [recited] with word-grouping; with the last foot of those [verses] he makes the <s>Praṇava</s> (Om).
"vitatau kiraṇau dvau" (Two rays stretched out) [20.133] are the <s>Pravalhikās</s> (riddles).

body.text: <6.2.22> (32.22) <ihettha prāg apāg udag adharāk [20.134]> iti pratirādhān | na saṃtanoti ||
body.translated_text: "ihettha prāg apāg udag adharāk" (Here, eastward, westward, northward, downward) [20.134] are the <s>Pratirādhas</s> (counter-verses); he does not extend [them with the <s>Sāman</s>].
"bhug ity abhigataḥ" (Having approached with 'bhug') [20.135.1-3] — the three <s>Ājijñāsenyā</s> (inquiry) [verses].
In the <s>Pravalhikā</s> and following [sections], there are fifteen <s>Pratigaras</s> (responses).

body.text: <6.2.25> (32.25) <dundubhim āhananābhyāṃ jaritarothāmo daiva [20.135.1bc]> | <kośabile rajani granther dānam upānahi pādam | uttamāṃ janimāṃ janyām uttāmāṃ janīn vartmanyāt [20.135.2]> | <alābūni pṛṣātakāny aśvatthapalāśaṃ pippīlikāvaṭaḥ śvasaḥ vidyut śvā parṇaśadaḥ gośapho jaritaḥ [20.135.3]> iti | pūrvāsu pūrveṣu ||
body.translated_text: "dundubhim āhananābhyāṃ jaritarothāmo daiva" (The drum with the two striking [sticks], O singer, we affirm, O divine one) [20.135.1bc]; "kośabile rajani granther dānam upānahi pādam | uttamāṃ janimāṃ janyām uttāmāṃ janīn vartmanyāt" (Basket-gourd, O night, the gift of the knotter, a shoe, a foot; the highest birth, the lady to be born, the highest ladies on the path) [20.135.2]; "alābūni pṛṣātakāny aśvatthapalāśaṃ pippīlikāvaṭaḥ śvasaḥ vidyut śvā parṇaśadaḥ gośapho jaritaḥ" (Gourds, spotted dice, a leaf of the <s>Aśvattha</s> tree, an ant-hill, breath, lightning, a dog, a falling leaf, a cow's hoof, O singer) [20.135.3] — for the earlier [verses], the earlier [responses].
"vīme devā akraṃsata" (Indeed the gods accomplished [this]) [20.135.4] is the <s>Ativāda</s> (surpassing speech).

body.text: <6.2.27> (32.27) <patnī yad dṛśyate .... jaritarothāmo daiva [20.135.5ab]> <hotā viṣṭīmena jaritarothāmo daiva [20.135.5cd]> iti pratigarau ||
body.translated_text: "patnī yad dṛśyate ... jaritarothāmo daiva" (When the wife is seen ... O singer, we affirm, O divine one) [20.135.5ab]; "hotā viṣṭīmena jaritarothāmo daiva" (The <s>Hotṛ</s> with the attendant, O singer, we affirm, O divine one) [20.135.5cd] — these are the two <s>Pratigaras</s> (responses).
"ādityā ha jaritaḥ" (Indeed the <s>Ādityas</s>, O singer) [20.135.6] is the <s>Devanītha</s> (divine leading), [recited] like the <s>Aitaśa-pralāpa</s>.

body.text: <6.2.29> (32.29) <oṃ ha jaritas tathā ha jaritaḥ> iti pratigarau vyatyāsam ||
body.translated_text: "oṃ ha jaritas tathā ha jaritaḥ" (Om indeed, O singer; so indeed, O singer) — these are the two <s>Pratigaras</s> (responses), in alternation.
"tvam indra śarma riṇāḥ" (You, O <s>Indra</s>, bestow protection) [20.135.11-13] are the <s>Bhūtecchadas</s> (coverings of beings).
"yad asyā aṃhubhedyāḥ" (That of this narrow-piercing one) [20.136.1-16] is the <s>Āhanasyā</s>, [recited] like the <s>Vṛṣākapi</s> [hymn].

body.text: <6.2.32> (32.32) pratigara īkāraḥ | ninardasya <kim ayam idam āho3 o o3thāmo daiva> iti ||
body.translated_text: The <s>Pratigara</s> (response) has the syllable 'ī'. For the <s>Ninarda</s> (thundering response): "kim ayam idam āho3 o o3thāmo daiva" (What is this, what did he say? We affirm, O divine one).

body.text: <6.2.33> (32.33) <dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣam [20.137.3]> ity ardharcaśaḥ | <sutāso madhumattamāḥ [20.137.4-6]> iti pāvamānīḥ | <ava drapso aṃśumatīm atiṣṭhat [20.137.7-9]> iti pacchaḥ ||
body.translated_text: "dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣam" (I have made [the praise] of <s>Dadhikrāvan</s>) [20.137.3], [recited] by half-verses. "sutāso madhumattamāḥ" (The most honey-sweet pressed [<s>Somas</s>]) [20.137.4-6] are the <s>Pāvamānī</s> verses. "ava drapso aṃśumatīm atiṣṭhat" (The drop descended upon the <s>Aṃśumatī</s>) [20.137.7-9], [recited] verse by verse.

body.text:
<6.2.34> (32.34) asyottamayā paridadhāti nityayā vā
<6.2.35> (32.35) aindrājāgatam utsṛjanty eke | aindrābārhaspatyaṃ tṛcam antyam aindrājāgataṃ ca śastvety apare ||
body.translated_text: Of this [hymn], he encloses with the last [verse], or with the regular one. (32.35) Some omit the <s>Aindrā-jāgata</s>. Others [say] one should recite the <s>Aindrā-Bārhaspatya</s> triplet as the final and the <s>Aindrā-jāgata</s> as well.

body.text: <6.3.1> (33.1) navarātre 'bhijid viṣuvān viśvajic caturviṃśavad ukthavarjam | ābhiplavikāṃs tu sarvān ||
body.translated_text: In the nine-night [rite], the <s>Abhijit</s>, <s>Viṣuvat</s>, and <s>Viśvajit</s> [days are performed] like the <s>Caturviṃśa</s> (twenty-fourth) day, except for the <s>Uktha</s>; but all the <s>Ābhiplavika</s> [chants are included].

body.text: <6.3.2> (33.2) <abhi tvā vṛṣabhā sute [20.22.1-3]> <uddhed abhi śrutām agham [20.7.1-3]> <yuñjanti bradhnam aruṣaṃ carantam [20.26.4-6]> ity ājyastotriyāḥ ||
body.translated_text: "abhi tvā vṛṣabhā sute" (O bull, at the pressing, to you) [20.22.1-3], "uddhed abhi śrutām agham" [20.7.1-3], "yuñjanti bradhnam aruṣaṃ carantam" (They yoke the ruddy, tawny, moving one) [20.26.4-6] are the <s>Ājya-stotriya</s> (ghee-chant) verses.

body.text: <6.3.3> (33.3) svarasāmasu <ā yāhi suṣumā hi te [20.38.1-3]> <indram id gāthino bṛhat [20.38.4-6]> <indreṇa saṃ hi dṛkṣase [20.40.1-3]> iti ||
body.translated_text: In the <s>Svara-sāman</s> (melodic chants): "ā yāhi suṣumā hi te" (Come, for delightful [is your draught]) [20.38.1-3], "indram id gāthino bṛhat" (Indeed <s>Indra</s>, the singers, the great) [20.38.4-6], "indreṇa saṃ hi dṛkṣase" (For you shall meet with <s>Indra</s>) [20.40.1-3].

body.text: <6.3.4> (33.4) śeṣam abhiplavasya dvitīyādi tryahavat | pañcarcas tv āvāpaḥ ||
body.translated_text: The remainder of the <s>Abhiplava</s> [is performed] like the second through [sixth] three-day cycle; but the insertions are five-versed.

body.text: <6.3.5> (33.5) viṣuvati sauryapṛṣṭhe <ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam [20.47.13-21, 20.48.1-6]> iti ṣaṭ stotriyaḥ ||
body.translated_text: On the <s>Viṣuvat</s> (solstice) day, with the <s>Saurya-pṛṣṭha</s> (solar back-chant), "ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam" (Up that <s>Jātavedas</s>) [20.47.13-21, 20.48.1-6] — six [verses form] the <s>Stotriya</s>.

body.text: <6.3.6> (33.6) <citraṃ devānām ud agād anīkam [20.107.14-15]> <tat sūryasya devatvaṃ tan mahitvam [20.123]> iti pṛṣṭhastotriyānurūpau | <baṇ mahā;m asi sūrya [20.58.3-4]> <śrāyanta iva sūryam [20.58.1-2]> iti vā | <indra kratuṃ na ā bhara [20.79.1-2]> <indra jyeṣṭhaṃ na ā bhara [20.80.1-2]> iti vā ||
body.translated_text: "citraṃ devānām ud agād anīkam" (The bright face of the gods has risen) [20.107.14-15], "tat sūryasya devatvaṃ tan mahitvam" (That is <s>Sūrya</s>'s divinity, that is [his] greatness) [20.123] are the <s>Pṛṣṭha-stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s>; or "baṇ mahām asi sūrya" (Truly great are you, O <s>Sūrya</s>) [20.58.3-4], "śrāyanta iva sūryam" (As if turning toward the sun) [20.58.1-2]; or "indra kratuṃ na ā bhara" (O <s>Indra</s>, bring us wisdom) [20.79.1-2], "indra jyeṣṭhaṃ na ā bhara" (O <s>Indra</s>, bring us the highest) [20.80.1-2].

body.text: <6.3.7> (33.7) nityau vottare pakṣe | anurūpāt <taṃ vo dasmam ṛtīṣaham [20.49.4-5]> <abhi pra vaḥ surādhasam [20.51.1-2]> iti naudhasaśyaitayonī kāmam ||
body.translated_text: Or the regular [pair] in the latter half [of the year]. After the <s>Anurūpa</s>, "taṃ vo dasmam ṛtīṣaham" (Him, the wondrous, the truth-conquering, for you) [20.49.4-5], "abhi pra vaḥ surādhasam" (To you, the bountiful one) [20.51.1-2] — these have their source in the <s>Naudhas</s> and <s>Syaita</s> [<s>Sāmans</s>], optionally.

body.text: <6.3.8> (33.8) <vaiśvānarasya pratimopari dyauḥ [8.9.6-23]> <cittaś cikitvān mahiṣaḥ suparṇaḥ [13.2.32-46]> iti sūktaśeṣāv āvapate ||
body.translated_text: "vaiśvānarasya pratimopari dyauḥ" (Above the measure of <s>Vaiśvānara</s> is heaven) [8.9.6-23], "cittaś cikitvān mahiṣaḥ suparṇaḥ" (The knowing, discerning buffalo, the beautiful-winged) [13.2.32-46] — he inserts these two as hymn-completions.

body.text: <6.3.9> (33.9) <viśvajiti vairājapṛṣṭhe <yad dyāva indra te śatam [20.81]> <yad indra yāvatas tvam [20.82]> iti pṛṣṭhastotriyānurūpau bārhatau ||
body.translated_text: At the <s>Viśvajit</s> (all-conquering) [day], with the <s>Vairāja-pṛṣṭha</s>: "yad dyāva indra te śatam" (If, O <s>Indra</s>, the heavens [were] your hundred) [20.81], "yad indra yāvatas tvam" (If, O <s>Indra</s>, as great as you) [20.82] are the <s>Pṛṣṭha-stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s>, belonging to the <s>Bṛhat</s> [<s>Sāman</s>].

body.text: <6.3.10> (33.10) ukte yonī | <indra kratuṃ na ā bhara [20.79]> iti tṛtīyām ||
body.translated_text: The two source [verses] are as stated. [He recites] "indra kratuṃ na ā bhara" (O <s>Indra</s>, bring us wisdom) [20.79] as the third.
"indra tridhātu śaraṇam" (<s>Indra</s>, [grant] threefold shelter) [20.83] is the <s>Sāma-pragātha</s>.

body.text: <6.3.12> (33.12) sukīrtivṛṣākapī <yo jāta eva prathamo manasvān [20.34]> iti sāmasūktam ahīnasūktam āvapate ||
body.translated_text: The <s>Sukīrti</s>, <s>Vṛṣākapi</s>, "yo jāta eva prathamo manasvān" (He who, born first, was full of wisdom) [20.34] as the <s>Sāma-sūkta</s>, and the <s>Ahīna-sūkta</s> — he inserts [these].
In the ten-night [rite], the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> [<s>ṣaḍaha</s>] has been described [above].

body.text: <6.3.14> (33.14) chandomeṣu <indrā yāhi citrabhāno [20.84]> <tam indraṃ vājayāmasi [20.47.1-3; 137.12-14]> <mahā;m indro ya ojasā [20.138]> ity ājyastotriyāḥ ||
body.translated_text: On the <s>Chandoma</s> days: "indrā yāhi citrabhāno" (Come, O <s>Indra</s> of brilliant light) [20.84], "tam indraṃ vājayāmasi" (That <s>Indra</s> we urge to victory) [20.47.1-3; 137.12-14], "mahām indro ya ojasā" (Great is <s>Indra</s> who by might) [20.138] are the <s>Ājya-stotriya</s> (ghee-chant) verses.

body.text: <6.3.15> (33.15) <surūpakṛtnum ūtaye [20.68]> iti dvādaśarcaḥ | <sa ghā no yoga ā bhuvat [20.69-70]> iti dvātriṃśatam | <vīlu cid ārujatnubhiḥ [20.70-71]> iti ṣaṭtriṃśatam āvapate ||
body.translated_text: "surūpakṛtnum ūtaye" (The beautifully-formed one for aid) [20.68] — twelve verses. "sa ghā no yoga ā bhuvat" (May he be present at our yoking) [20.69-70] — thirty-two [verses]. "vīlu cid ārujatnubhiḥ" (Even the firm, with those who break through) [20.70-71] — he inserts thirty-six [verses].

body.text: <6.3.16> (33.16) <vayaṃ gha tvā sutāvantaḥ [20.52]> ity ādi <baṇ mahā;m asi sūrya [20.58-3-4]> ityantāḥ pṛṣṭhastotriyānurūpau ||
body.translated_text: "vayaṃ gha tvā sutāvantaḥ" (We, having pressed [<s>Soma</s>], you) [20.52] and so forth, ending with "baṇ mahām asi sūrya" (Truly great are you, O <s>Sūrya</s>) [20.58.3-4] — are the <s>Pṛṣṭha-stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s>.

body.text: <6.3.17> (33.17) uttarayor aṣṭarcam <ā satyo yātu maghavā;m ṛjīṣī [20.77]> iti cāvapate ||
body.translated_text: For the latter two [days], he also inserts the eight-versed "ā satyo yātu maghavām ṛjīṣī" (May the true, bountiful, victorious one come) [20.77].

body.text: <6.3.18> (33.18) anyeṣu mahāstotreṣv aṣṭarcam | <ya eka id vidayate [20.63.4-6 etc.]> ṣaḍ ukthastotriyānurūpau ||
body.translated_text: At the other great chants, [he inserts] the eight-versed [hymn]. "ya eka id vidayate" (He who alone is known) [20.63.4-6 etc.] — six <s>Uktha-stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s> [pairs].

body.text: <6.3.19> (33.19) dvitīye <adhvaryavo 'ruṇaṃ dugdham aṃśum [20.87]> <yas tastambha sahasā vi jmo antān [20.88]> <asteva su prataraṃ lāyam asyan [20.89]> ity aikāhikāni ||
body.translated_text: On the second [<s>Chandoma</s> day]: "adhvaryavo 'ruṇaṃ dugdham aṃśum" (O <s>Adhvaryus</s>, the ruddy, milked <s>Soma</s> stalk) [20.87], "yas tastambha sahasā vi jmo antān" (He who firmly established by force the ends of the earth) [20.88], "asteva su prataraṃ lāyam asyan" (Like a skillful archer, shooting the target further) [20.89] — these are the one-day [recitations].

body.text: <6.3.20> (33.20) tṛtīye <adhvaryavo 'ruṇam [20.87]> <yo adribhit prathamajā ṛtāvā [20.90]> <ā yātv indraḥ svapatir madāya [20.94]> iti ||
body.translated_text: On the third [<s>Chandoma</s> day]: "adhvaryavo 'ruṇam" [20.87], "yo adribhit prathamajā ṛtāvā" (He who breaks stones, first-born, devoted to truth) [20.90], "ā yātv indraḥ svapatir madāya" (May <s>Indra</s>, the good protector, come for exhilaration) [20.94].

body.text: <6.3.21> (33.21) <yo adribhit [20.90]> <imāṃ dhiyaṃ saptaśīrṣṇīṃ pitā naḥ [20.91]> ity ubhayor ekaikaṃ madhyamasyādāv ante vā ||
body.translated_text: "yo adribhit" [20.90], "imāṃ dhiyaṃ saptaśīrṣṇīṃ pitā naḥ" (This prayer, seven-headed, our father) [20.91] — one each from both [hymns], at the beginning or end of the middle [day's recitation].
The tenth [day is performed] like the fourth [day] of the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> [cycle], except for the <s>Uktha</s>.
"ut tvā mandantu" (May they delight you) [20.93.1-3] is the <s>Ājya-stotriya</s>.

body.text: <6.3.24> (33.24) <ud u tye madhumattamāḥ [20.59.1-2]> <ud in nv asya ricyate [20.59.3-4]> iti pṛṣṭhastotriyānurūpau ||
body.translated_text: "ud u tye madhumattamāḥ" (Up, those most honey-sweet ones) [20.59.1-2], "ud in nv asya ricyate" (Indeed now his [praise] overflows) [20.59.3-4] are the <s>Pṛṣṭha-stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s>.
From the <s>Patnīsaṃyāja</s> (wives' offerings), for the <s>Mānasa-stotra</s> (mental chant), having made the signal, they proceed to the <s>Sadas</s>.
Mentally, the entire [recitation is performed] without error.

body.text: <6.3.27> (33.27) hotra <āroho 'si mānaso manase tvā mano jinva [-]> iti prasauti ||
body.translated_text: For the <s>Hotṛ</s>, he gives the signal: "āroho 'si mānaso manase tvā mano jinva" (You are the mental ascent; for the mind I take you, prosper the mind).
With "āyaṃ gauḥ" (This cow) [6.31], he also consecrates [it] with mantras.

body.text: <6.3.29> (33.29) <dhṛtir asi svadhṛtir asi [-]> ity audumbarīṃ madhye 'nvālabhyāsate ||
body.translated_text: With "dhṛtir asi svadhṛtir asi" (You are steadiness, you are self-support), having touched the <s>Audumbarī</s> (Udumbara-wood post) in the middle, they sit down.

body.text: <6.4.1> (34.1) prādurbhūteṣu nakṣatreṣu niṣkramya japanti <yuvaṃ tam indrāparvatā puroyodhā yo naḥ pṛtanyād apa taṃtam id dhataṃ vajrena taṃtam id dhatam | dūre cattāya chantsad gahanaṃ yad inakṣat | asmākaṃ śatrūn pari śūra viśvato darmā darṣīṣṭa viśvataḥ [ṚV 1.132.6, VSM 8.53]> iti ||
body.translated_text: When the stars have appeared, having gone out, they mutter: "yuvaṃ tam indrāparvatā puroyodhā yo naḥ pṛtanyād apa taṃtam id dhataṃ vajrena taṃtam id dhatam | dūre cattāya chantsad gahanaṃ yad inakṣat | asmākaṃ śatrūn pari śūra viśvato darmā darṣīṣṭa viśvataḥ" (O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Parvata</s>, you two who fight in front — whoever would battle us, strike him down, with the thunderbolt strike him down; for one cast far away, who would penetrate what is impenetrable — O hero, shatter our enemies on all sides, shatter them on all sides) [ṚV 1.132.6, VSM 8.53].

body.text: <6.4.2> (34.2) adhvaryupathena gatvā dakṣiṇapaścād agner upaviśya kāmān kāmayitvā <yad ihonam akarma yad atyarīricāma prajāpatiṃ tat pitaram apyetu [AB 5.24]> iti ||
body.translated_text: Having gone by the <s>Adhvaryu</s>'s path, having sat down to the south-west of the fire, having made wishes, [he recites] "yad ihonam akarma yad atyarīricāma prajāpatiṃ tat pitaram apyetu" (Whatever deficiency we have made here, whatever we have done in excess — may that go to <s>Prajāpati</s> the father) [AB 5.24].

body.text: <6.4.3> (34.3) tiṣṭhanto vācam āhvayante <vāg aitu vāg upaitu vāg upa maitu vāk> iti ||
body.translated_text: Standing, they call upon speech: "vāg aitu vāg upaitu vāg upa maitu vāk" (Let speech come, let speech approach, let speech come near — speech!).
And the <s>Subrahmaṇyā</s> [call as well].
One who has not studied [the formula says] "subrahmaṇyo3m" three times.
At the <s>Mahāvrata</s> (great vow), "surūpakṛtnum ūtaye" (The beautifully-formed one for aid) [20.57.1-3] is the <s>Ājya-stotriya</s>.
"īṅkhayantīr apasyuvaḥ" (The active ones swinging) [20.93.4-8] — he inserts [this]; and the <s>Abhiplava-stotriya</s> verses.
At the midday [pressing], the priestly assistants, having made grass bundles (<s>Kūrca</s>), sit down [upon them].

body.text: <6.4.9> (34.9) kumbhinīr mārjālīyaṃ pariyāntīr anumantrayate <gāva eva surabhayo gāvo guggulugandhayaḥ | gāvo ghṛtasya mātaras tā iha santu bhūyasīr idaṃ madhu || na vai gāvo maṅgīrasya gaṅgāyā udakaṃ papuḥ | papuḥ sarasvatyā nadyās tāḥ prācyaḥ saṃjigāhira idaṃ madhu || etā vayaṃ plavāmahe śamyāḥ prataratā iva | nikīrya tubhyam abhya āsaṃ gīḥ kośvoṣyaur yadā gira idaṃ madhu || yadā rāghaṭī varado vyāghraṃ maṅgīradāsa gauḥ | janaḥ sa bhadram edhati rāṣṭre rājñaḥ parikṣitaḥ [cf. ĀpŚS 21.20.3 etc.]> iti ||
body.translated_text: He consecrates with mantras the pot-bearing [women] going around the <s>Mārjālīya</s>: "gāva eva surabhayo gāvo guggulugandhayaḥ | gāvo ghṛtasya mātaras tā iha santu bhūyasīr idaṃ madhu" (Cows indeed are fragrant, cows have the scent of <s>Guggulu</s>; cows are the mothers of ghee — may they be here in abundance; this is honey); "na vai gāvo maṅgīrasya gaṅgāyā udakaṃ papuḥ | papuḥ sarasvatyā nadyās tāḥ prācyaḥ saṃjigāhira idaṃ madhu" (Indeed the cows did not drink the water of <s>Maṅgīra</s>'s <s>Gaṅgā</s>; they drank from the river <s>Sarasvatī</s> — gather those eastern ones; this is honey); "etā vayaṃ plavāmahe śamyāḥ prataratā iva | nikīrya tubhyam abhya āsaṃ gīḥ kośvoṣyaur yadā gira idaṃ madhu" (These we swim across, like crossing with a staff; having scattered, I have sat near you — the song, when like a vessel the songs [flow]; this is honey); "yadā rāghaṭī varado vyāghraṃ maṅgīradāsa gauḥ | janaḥ sa bhadram edhati rāṣṭre rājñaḥ parikṣitaḥ" (When the water-wheel, the boon-granter, the tiger, the <s>Maṅgīra</s>-slave, the cow — that people prospers well in the kingdom of king <s>Parikṣit</s>) [cf. ĀpŚS 21.20.3 etc.].
[Each verse ends with] "idaṃ madhv idaṃ madhu" (This is honey, this is honey).

body.text: <6.4.11> (34.11) patnīśāle bhūmidundubhim auṣṭreṇāpinaddhaṃ pucchenāghnanty <uccair ghoṣaḥ [5.20]> <upa śvāsaya [6.126]> iti ||
body.translated_text: In the wives' hall, they strike the earth-drum (<s>Bhūmi-dundubhi</s>) covered with camel [hide] with the tail [end of the stick], [reciting] "uccair ghoṣaḥ" (Loud is the sound) [5.20], "upa śvāsaya" (Make it breathe) [6.126].

body.text: <6.4.12> (34.12) tīrthadeśe rājānam anyaṃ vā <marmāṇi te [7.118]> iti ||
body.translated_text: At the sacred bathing place, [they address] the king or another [worthy person with] "marmāṇi te" (Your vital spots) [7.118].
He consecrates the armored [warrior] with mantras: "indro jayāti" (<s>Indra</s> conquers) [6.98].

body.text: <6.4.14> (34.14) saṃnaddhāya madhuparkam āhārayati | taṃ sa brāhmaṇena pratigrāhayati ||
body.translated_text: He has the honey-mixture (<s>Madhuparka</s>) brought for the armored one. He has a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> receive it.
With "vanaspate vīḍvaṅgaḥ" (O Lord of the forest, firm-limbed) [6.125], having consecrated [it] with mantras, he makes [him] mount the chariot.
With "uddharṣantām" (May they be uplifted) [3.19.6-7], he consecrates the one who has mounted with mantras.

body.text: <6.4.17> (34.17) <avasṛṣṭā parā pata [3.19.8]> iti caturthīm iṣum avasṛṣṭām ||
body.translated_text: With "avasṛṣṭā parā pata" (Released, fly forth) [3.19.8], [he recites over] the fourth arrow released.

body.text: <6.4.18> (34.18) sa yadā brāhmaṇadhanaṃ gṛhṇāti tad yajamāno niṣkrīṇāti ||
body.translated_text: When he seizes <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> property, the sacrificer redeems it.

body.text: <6.4.19> (34.19) <trikadrukeṣu mahiṣaḥ [20.95.1]> <pro ṣv asmai puroratham [20.95.2]> iti stotriyānurūpau ||
body.translated_text: "trikadrukeṣu mahiṣaḥ" (The buffalo at the <s>Trikadrukas</s>) [20.95.1], "pro ṣv asmai puroratham" (Forward for him, the chariot in front) [20.95.2] are the <s>Stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s>.
"tīvrasyābhivayaso asya pāhi" (Protect [us] from the overwhelming [force] of the fierce one) [20.96] — he inserts twenty-four [verses].

Then he should hasten with the <s>Jyotiṣṭoma</s>, the <s>Agniṣṭoma</s>, as self-redemption (<s>Ātmaniṣkrayaṇa</s>), with a thousand as the priestly fee, with the <s>Pṛṣṭha-śamanīya</s> (back-appeasing) offering.
He recites following [the chant] according to what was chanted.

body.text: <6.5.2> (35.2) ekayā dvābhyāṃ vā stomam atiśaṃset | na prāg dvādaśāt ||
body.translated_text: He may extend the <s>Stoma</s> (praise-form) by one or two [verses]; [but] not before the twelfth.
And [likewise] in the insertions of the <s>Ṣaḍaha-stotriya</s> (six-day chant) verses.
With unlimited [verses] at the latter two pressings.
The <s>Anurūpa</s> should correspond [to the <s>Stotriya</s>] in meter and deity.
When [the <s>Anurūpa</s>] is not known, [one recites] the <s>Stotriya</s> twice.
In one-day rites, the insertion [comes] after the <s>Anurūpa</s>.
The <s>Pragātha</s> [verses are recited] at the midday [pressing].
In the year[-long rite], for the opening [verse], the next day's <s>Stotriya</s> serves as the <s>Anurūpa</s>.
"indraṃ vo viśvatas pari" (<s>Indra</s> for you, from all sides) [20.39.1] is the opening verse.
"vyantarikṣam atirat" (He crossed over the atmosphere) [20.39.2-5] is the <s>Paryāsa</s> (conclusion).

body.text: <6.5.12> (35.12) mādhyandine <kan navyo atasīnām [20.50]> iti kadvānt sāmapragāthaḥ ||
body.translated_text: At the midday [pressing], "kan navyo atasīnām" (What new one of the flax[-like <s>Somas</s>]) [20.50] — the <s>Sāma-pragātha</s> containing the word 'kad'.
"brahmaṇā te brahmayujā yunajmi" (With sacred prayer, I yoke you with the prayer-yoking) [20.86.1] is the opening verse.
For the purpose of extended recitation, we shall now explain the <s>Stomas</s> (praise-forms).

body.text: <6.5.15> (35.15) gorājye trivṛt | pañcadaśa āyuṣaḥ | ubhayoḥ pṛṣṭhe saptadaśaḥ ||
body.translated_text: At the <s>Go-rājya</s> (cow-sovereignty) [day], the <s>Trivṛt</s> (nine-fold) [<s>Stoma</s>]; the fifteen-fold at the <s>Āyus</s> [day]; the seventeen-fold at the <s>Pṛṣṭha</s> (back-chant) of both.
At the <s>Uktha</s>, the twenty-one-fold. At the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> [<s>ṣaḍaha</s>]: the nine-fold, fifteen-fold, seventeen-fold, twenty-one-fold, thirty-fold, and thirty-three-fold.
At the <s>Abhijit</s> and <s>Viśvajit</s> [days], at the <s>Rājya</s> (sovereignty [chant]): the fifteen-fold and twenty-one-fold. At the <s>Pṛṣṭha</s>: the thirty-fold and thirty-three-fold.
At the <s>Svara-sāman</s> (melodic chants), the seventeen-fold.
On the <s>Viṣuvat</s> (solstice day), the twenty-one-fold.
On the <s>Chandoma</s> days: the twenty-four-fold, forty-four-fold, and forty-eight-fold.
On the tenth [day], at the <s>Ājya</s> and <s>Pṛṣṭha</s> [chants], the twenty-one-fold.
At the <s>Mahāvrata</s>, the twenty-five-fold.
Everywhere, the concluding <s>Stoma-stotriya</s> is based on the <s>Sāma Veda</s>, based on the <s>Sāma Veda</s>.
<7.1.1> (36.1) Now the <s>Rājasūya</s> (royal consecration).
<7.1.2> (36.2) Before the [full moon of] <s>Taiṣa</s> (Pauṣa month), [there is] the <s>Pavitra</s> (purificatory rite).
<7.1.3> (36.3) In the intervening months, [there are] ten <s>Saṃsṛps</s> (preliminary offerings).
<7.1.4> (36.4) On the [full moon of] <s>Māgha</s>, the <s>Abhiṣecanīya</s> (consecration ceremony).
<7.1.5> (36.5) After the <s>Marutvatīya</s> [oblation], the <s>Bārhaspatya</s> offering (dedicated to <s>Bṛhaspati</s>).

body.text: <7.1.6-7> (36.6-7) havirdhānayoḥ purastād vaiyāghracarmopabarhaṇāyām āsandyām <bhūto bhūteṣu [4.8]> ity ārohayaty abhiṣiñcati ca ||
body.translated_text: <7.1.6-7> (36.6-7) In front of the <s>Havirdhāna</s> (offering-shed), on a throne (<s>Āsandī</s>) with a tiger-skin cushion, with "bhūto bhūteṣu" (Being among beings) [4.8], he makes [the king] ascend and consecrates him.
<7.1.8> (36.8) On the [full moon of] <s>Phālguna</s>, the <s>Daśapeya</s> (ten-cup [rite]).
<7.1.9> (36.9) The annual <s>Cāturmāsya</s> (four-monthly) [rites are performed].
<7.1.10> (36.10) When these are concluded, on the [full moon of] <s>Caitra</s>, the <s>Pratyavarohaṇīya</s> (re-descent rite).
<7.1.11> (36.11) On the [full moon of] <s>Vaiśākha</s>, the <s>Vyuṣṭidvyaha</s> (two-day dawn rite).
<7.1.12> (36.12) On the [full moon of] <s>Jyaiṣṭha</s>, the <s>Kṣatradhṛti</s> (warrior-power-sustaining [rite]).
<7.1.13> (36.13) On the [full moon of] <s>Āṣāḍha</s>, the <s>Pavitra</s> (purificatory rite) for the conclusion.
<7.1.14> (36.14) Now the <s>Aśvamedha</s> (horse sacrifice).
<7.1.15> (36.15) On the [full moon of] <s>Phālguna</s>, he gives the <s>Brahmaudana</s> (rice-porridge for the <s>Brahman</s>) to those having the <s>Udgātṛ</s> as fourth.
<7.1.16> (36.16) When the morning oblation has been offered, [he gives] a boon to the <s>Brahman</s> [priest].
<7.1.17> (36.17) [There is] the <s>Āgneya</s> (offering to <s>Agni</s>) offering; and the <s>Pauṣṇī</s> (offering to <s>Pūṣan</s>) as well.
<7.1.18> (36.18) With "vātaraṃhā bhava" (Be swift as the wind) [6.9.2], he recites following the horse as it is being yoked.
<7.1.19> (36.19) With "abhi tvā jarimāhita" [3.11.8], [he recites following] it as it is being unyoked.
<7.1.20> (36.20) [The horse] released, [is guarded] by the <s>Āśāpālīya</s> (boundary-guardian) [ceremony].
<7.1.21> (36.21) For a year, [there are] three <s>Sāvitrī</s> (dedicated to <s>Savitṛ</s>) offerings.

body.text: <7.1.22> (36.22) pāriplavākhyānāya dakṣiṇena vediṃ hiraṇmayeṣv āsaneṣu upaviśanti ||
body.translated_text: <7.1.22> (36.22) For the <s>Pāriplava</s> narration (cyclical legends), they sit to the south of the altar on golden seats.
<7.1.23> (36.23) The <s>Brahman</s> [priest] has a silk cushion; the sacrificer has a bundle of grass (<s>kūrca</s>).
<7.1.24> (36.24) During the narrations, he has [them] recite the <s>Vyāhṛtis</s> (sacred utterances) according to the respective <s>Veda</s>.
<7.1.25> (36.25) At the end of the year, the consecration (<s>Dīkṣaṇa</s>); twenty-one [days of] <s>Dīkṣā</s> (consecration).
<7.1.26> (36.26) The first day is like the first [day] of the <s>Abhiplava</s>; the second like the fourth [day] of the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s>.

body.text: <7.1.27> (36.27) bahiṣpavamānād aśvaṃ niyujyamānam anumantrayate <saṃ tvāṃ gandharvāḥ sam u yuñjantv āpo nadyoḥ sāṃvaidye parivatsarāya | ye tvā rakṣanti sadam apramādaṃ tebhya āyuḥ savitā bodhi gopāya [-]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <7.1.27> (36.27) After the <s>Bahiṣpavamāna</s> (external purification chant), he recites following along as the horse is being yoked: "saṃ tvāṃ gandharvāḥ sam u yuñjantv āpo nadyoḥ sāṃvaidye parivatsarāya, ye tvā rakṣanti sadam apramādaṃ tebhya āyuḥ savitā bodhi gopāya" (May the <s>Gandharvas</s> yoke you together, may the waters [yoke you] at the confluence of the two rivers for the full year; those who guard you always without negligence — to them may <s>Savitṛ</s> grant life; be their protector).

body.text:
<7.1.28> (36.28) <divyo gandharvaḥ [2.2.1]> ity etayā kauśikaḥ
<7.1.29> (36.29) saṃjñaptaṃ mahiṣīm upaveśyādhīvāsasā saṃprorṇuvanti ||
body.translated_text: <7.1.28> (36.28) <s>Kauśika</s> [prescribes the verse] "divyo gandharvaḥ" (The celestial <s>Gandharva</s>) [2.2.1]. <7.1.29> (36.29) Having had the chief queen (<s>Mahiṣī</s>) lie down beside the slaughtered [horse], they cover [both] with an upper garment.

body.text: <7.1.30> (36.30) tau yajamāno 'bhimethati <svargeṇa lokena saṃprorṇuvāthām adhāma sakthyor ava gudaṃ dhehi | arvāñcam añjim ā bhara yat strīṇāṃ jīvabhojanam [cf. VSM 23.20 + TS 7.4.19.1]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <7.1.30> (36.30) The sacrificer cohabits with them [symbolically, saying] "svargeṇa lokena saṃprorṇuvāthām adhāma sakthyor ava gudaṃ dhehi, arvāñcam añjim ā bhara yat strīṇāṃ jīvabhojanam" (May you two be covered with the heavenly world; place [it] at the thighs, put down the rectum; bring hither the ointment that is the sustenance of women) [cf. <s>VSM</s> 23.20 + <s>TS</s> 7.4.19.1].

body.text: <7.1.31> (36.31) hotrabhimethanād evaṃ vāvātāṃ brahmā <ūrdhvām enām ucchrayatād girau bhāraṃ harann iva | athāsyai madhyam edhatu śīte vāte punann iva [VSM 23.26-27]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <7.1.31> (36.31) After the <s>Hotṛ</s>'s ritual cohabitation [dialogue], even so the <s>Brahman</s> [priest recites] "ūrdhvām enām ucchrayatād girau bhāraṃ harann iva, athāsyai madhyam edhatu śīte vāte punann iva" (Raise her upward like one carrying a burden up a mountain; then may her middle swell, like one winnowing in a cold wind) [<s>VSM</s> 23.26-27].
<7.1.32> (36.32) "ūrdhvam enam" (Raise him) — [this is] the response following the <s>Brahman</s> [priest].
<7.1.33> (36.33) In the assembly, from the theological debate (<s>Brahmodya</s>) between the <s>Hotṛ</s> and <s>Adhvaryu</s>, the <s>Brahman</s> [priest] questions the <s>Udgātṛ</s>.

body.text: <7.2.1> (37.1) <pṛcchāmi tvā citaye devasakha yadi tvaṃ tatra manasā jagantha | keṣu viṣṇus triṣu padeṣu jiṣṇuḥ keṣv idaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanam āviveśa [VSM 23.49]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <7.2.1> (37.1) "pṛcchāmi tvā citaye devasakha yadi tvaṃ tatra manasā jagantha, keṣu viṣṇus triṣu padeṣu jiṣṇuḥ keṣv idaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanam āviveśa" (I ask you for understanding, O friend of the gods, if you have gone there in mind: in which three steps did conquering <s>Viṣṇu</s> — in which has this entire world entered?) [<s>VSM</s> 23.49].

body.text: <7.2.2> (37.2) tasya pratipraśnād āha <pañcasv antaḥ puruṣa āviveśa tāny antaḥ puruṣa ārpitāni | etat tvātra pratimanvāno asmi na yajñapā bhavasy uttaro mat [VSM 23.52]> || <na tvaṃ paro 'varo man na pūrvaḥ kim aṅga vā matiman kṣama tena | śikṣeṇyāṃ vadasi vācam enāṃ na mayā tvaṃ saṃsamako bhavāsi [-]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <7.2.2> (37.2) In reply to his counter-question, he says: "pañcasv antaḥ puruṣa āviveśa tāny antaḥ puruṣa ārpitāni, etat tvātra pratimanvāno asmi na yajñapā bhavasy uttaro mat" (In five [elements] has the person entered; those are fixed within the person — this I reflect upon for you here; you are not the guardian of the sacrifice superior to me). "na tvaṃ paro 'varo man na pūrvaḥ kim aṅga vā matiman kṣama tena, śikṣeṇyāṃ vadasi vācam enāṃ na mayā tvaṃ saṃsamako bhavāsi" (You are neither above nor below me, nor before me; what then, O wise one, be patient with that; you speak this speech worth teaching — you are not equal to me).

body.text: <7.2.3> (37.3) niṣkramya sarve yajamānaṃ <pṛcchāmi tvā param antaṃ pṛthivyāḥ [9.10.13]> iti | <iyaṃ vediḥ [9.10.14]> iti yajamānaḥ ||
body.translated_text: <7.2.3> (37.3) Having come out, all [address] the sacrificer with "pṛcchāmi tvā param antaṃ pṛthivyāḥ" (I ask you about the farthest end of the earth) [9.10.13]; the sacrificer [replies] with "iyaṃ vediḥ" (This is the altar) [9.10.14].
<7.2.4> (37.4) On the third [day], two pressings as in the <s>Caturviṃśa</s> (twenty-four-fold) [day].
<7.2.5> (37.5) The <s>Ājya-stotriya</s> and <s>Anurūpa</s> are in the standard form.
<7.2.6> (37.6) The third pressing and what follows are as in the <s>Atirātra</s> (overnight rite).
<7.2.7> (37.7) When [the rite] is concluded, [there is] the five-animal [sacrifice] at a forked sacrificial post (<s>Viśākhayūpa</s>).

body.text: <7.2.8> (37.8) pratyṛtu ṣaṭ paśava āgneyā aindrā mārutā maitrāvaruṇā aindrāvaruṇā āgnāvaiṣṇavā iti ||
body.translated_text: <7.2.8> (37.8) Six animals [are offered] in each season: [those] dedicated to <s>Agni</s>, to <s>Indra</s>, to the <s>Maruts</s>, to <s>Mitra-Varuṇa</s>, to <s>Indra-Varuṇa</s>, and to <s>Agni-Viṣṇu</s>.
<7.2.9> (37.9) The forked-post and seasonal animals are doubled in the <s>Puruṣamedha</s> (human sacrifice); quadrupled in the <s>Sarvamedha</s> (all-sacrifice).
<7.2.10> (37.10) The <s>Puruṣamedha</s> is like the <s>Aśvamedha</s>.

body.text: <7.2.11-12> (37.11-12) caitryāḥ purastād varadānānta iṣṭayo 'gnaye kāmāya dātre pathikṛte ||
body.translated_text: <7.2.11-12> (37.11-12) Before the [full moon of] <s>Caitra</s>, the offerings up to and including the boon-giving are to <s>Agni Kāma</s> (the god of desire) [and] <s>Dātṛ Pathikṛt</s> (the giver and path-maker).

body.text: <7.2.13> (37.13) <yajamānasya vijitaṃ sarvaṃ samaitu> iti janapadam uccaiḥ śrāvayati ||
body.translated_text: <7.2.13> (37.13) He makes the people (<s>Janapada</s>) hear loudly: "May all that the sacrificer has conquered be united [with him]!"

body.text: <7.2.14> (37.14) <kasmai sahasraṃ śatāśvaṃ svaṃ jñātibhyo dadyām | kena samāpnuyām> iti yajamānaḥ ||
body.translated_text: <7.2.14> (37.14) The sacrificer [declares]: "To whom shall I give a thousand [cattle] with a hundred horses, my own [wealth], to my kinsmen? By whom shall I attain fulfillment?"

body.text: <7.2.15> (37.15) yadi brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vā pratipadyeta siddhaṃ karmety ācakṣate ||
body.translated_text: <7.2.15> (37.15) If a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> or a <s>Kṣatriya</s> accepts, they declare [that] the rite is accomplished.

body.text: <7.2.16> (37.16) na cet pratipadyeta nediṣṭhaṃ sapatnaṃ vijitya tena yajeta ||
body.translated_text: <7.2.16> (37.16) If no one accepts, he should conquer the nearest rival and sacrifice with that [wealth].
<7.2.17> (37.17) He should give that [wealth] to the kinsmen for his [rival's] sake.

body.text: <7.2.18> (37.18) yasya strī saṃbhāṣeta tasya sarvasvam ādāya tām abrāhmaṇīṃ haniṣya ity uccaiḥ śrāvayet ||
body.translated_text: <7.2.18> (37.18) He should make [the assembly] hear loudly: "Whoever's wife speaks [with the victim], [I shall] seize all his property and slay her who is not a <s>Brāhmaṇī</s>."

body.text: <7.2.19> (37.19) taṃ ha snātam alaṃkṛtam utsṛjyamānam <sahasrabāhuḥ puruṣaḥ [19.6]> <kena pārṣṇī [10.2]> ity anumantrayate ||
body.translated_text: <7.2.19> (37.19) Then, the [victim] having been bathed and adorned, being released, he recites following with "sahasrabāhuḥ puruṣaḥ" (The thousand-armed person) [19.6] and "kena pārṣṇī" [10.2].

body.text: <7.2.20> (37.20) saṃvatsaram iṣṭayaḥ pathyāyai svastaye adityā anumataye ||
body.translated_text: <7.2.20> (37.20) For a year, offerings to <s>Pathyā Svasti</s> (auspicious path), <s>Aditi</s>, and <s>Anumati</s>.
<7.2.21> (37.21) At the end of the year, an animal [sacrifice] to <s>Indra</s> and <s>Pūṣan</s>.
<7.2.22> (37.22) The <s>Mahāvrata</s> (great vow) [is] the third [day].

body.text: <7.2.23> (37.23) <udīratām [18.1.44-46]> iti tisṛbhir yūpe badhyamānam anumantrayate | utthāpanībhiś ca vimucyamānam ||
body.translated_text: <7.2.23> (37.23) With "udīratām" [18.1.44-46], three [verses], he recites following as [the victim] is being bound to the post; and with the <s>Utthāpanī</s> (raising) [verses], as [it] is being released.
<7.2.24> (37.24) With the <s>Hariṇī</s> (golden) [verses], [he recites over] the <s>Śāmitra</s> (slaughter-shed) offering being carried.
<7.2.25> (37.25) With "syonāsmai bhava" (Be pleasant for him) [18.2.19-20], two [verses], [he recites over the victim] being laid down.
<7.2.26> (37.26) "sahasrabāhuḥ" (The thousand-armed one) [19.6] — [recited over the victim] slaughtered with the <s>Yāma-Sārasvata</s> [formulas].

body.text: <7.3.1> (38.1) atha bhaiṣajyāya yajamānam <akṣībhyāṃ te [2.33]> <muñcāmi tvā [1.10.4]> <uta devāḥ [4.13]> <yasyās te [6.84]> <apeta etu [sakala at KauśS 97.8, PS 19.23.4-6]> <vāta ā vātu [sakala at KauśS 117.4, PS 19.46.7-9]> iti | methane brahmā <suprapāṇā ca veśantā [20.128.9]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <7.3.1> (38.1) Now, for healing (<s>bhaiṣajya</s>), [they address] the sacrificer with "akṣībhyāṃ te" [2.33], "muñcāmi tvā" (I release you) [1.10.4], "uta devāḥ" [4.13], "yasyās te" [6.84], "apeta etu" [<s>sakala</s> at <s>KauśS</s> 97.8, <s>PS</s> 19.23.4-6], and "vāta ā vātu" [<s>sakala</s> at <s>KauśS</s> 117.4, <s>PS</s> 19.46.7-9]. At the [symbolic] cohabitation, the <s>Brahman</s> [priest recites] "suprapāṇā ca veśantā" [20.128.9].
<7.3.2> (38.2) The previous [verses] are the response following [the <s>Brahman</s>].
<7.3.3> (38.3) "ud īrṣva nārī" (Arise, O woman) [18.3.2] — this has been stated.

body.text: <7.3.4> (38.4) <yan na idaṃ pitṛbhiḥ [sakala at KauśS 88.29, not attested elsewhere]> iti sarve ||
body.translated_text: <7.3.4> (38.4) "yan na idaṃ pitṛbhiḥ" (That which [we have] from the ancestors) [<s>sakala</s> at <s>KauśS</s> 88.29] — [recited by] all.

body.text: <7.3.5> (38.5) brahmodyāt <gāvo yavaṃ prayutā aryo akṣan tā apaśyaṃ sahagopāś carantīḥ | havā idaryo abhitaḥ samāyan kiyad āsu svapatiś chandayāte [ṚV 10.27.8]> ity udgātāram ||
body.translated_text: <7.3.5> (38.5) In the theological debate (<s>Brahmodya</s>), [the <s>Brahman</s> priest addresses] the <s>Udgātṛ</s> with: "gāvo yavaṃ prayutā aryo akṣan tā apaśyaṃ sahagopāś carantīḥ, havā idaryo abhitaḥ samāyan kiyad āsu svapatiś chandayāte" (The cows of the noble one, released, ate the barley — I saw them wandering together with their herdsmen; the calls of the noble one came together from all sides — how much does the good master delight in them?) [<s>ṚV</s> 10.27.8].

body.text: <7.3.6> (38.6) pratipraśne <yasyānakṣā duhitā jātvāsa kas tāṃ vidvā;m abhi manyāte andhām | kataro meniṃ prati taṃ muñcāte ya īṃ vahāte ya īṃ vā vareyāt [ṚV 10.27.11]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <7.3.6> (38.6) In the counter-question: "yasyānakṣā duhitā jātvāsa kas tāṃ vidvān abhi manyāte andhām, kataro meniṃ prati taṃ muñcāte ya īṃ vahāte ya īṃ vā vareyāt" (Whose daughter was born blind without eyes — who, knowing her, considers her [still] blind? Which of the two releases the punishment against him — he who carries her or he who would choose her?) [<s>ṚV</s> 10.27.11].
<7.3.7> (38.7) The fourth [day] is like the fourth of the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> [cycle]; the fifth is an <s>Atirātra</s> (overnight rite).
<7.3.8> (38.8) If the middle [day] is an <s>Ukthya</s>, [then] <s>Agniṣṭomas</s> [are performed] at the end.
<7.3.9> (38.9) [The rites] associated with the <s>Aśvamedha</s> — the directions given by priests and wives — are twofold.
<7.3.10> (38.10) The <s>Aśvamedha</s> is a two-day [rite]; the <s>Puruṣamedha</s> is a three-day [rite]; the <s>Sarvamedha</s> is like the <s>Puruṣamedha</s>.

body.text: <7.3.11> (38.11) ahāny agniṣṭud indrastut sūryastud vaiśvadevastut pauruṣamedhikaṃ tṛtīyaṃ pañcamaṃ vājapeyo 'ptoryāmā ||
body.translated_text: <7.3.11> (38.11) The [ritual] days are: the <s>Agniṣṭut</s> (praise of <s>Agni</s>), <s>Indrastut</s> (praise of <s>Indra</s>), <s>Sūryastut</s> (praise of <s>Sūrya</s>), <s>Vaiśvadevastut</s> (praise of the All-gods), the third <s>Pauruṣamedhika</s> (relating to the <s>Puruṣamedha</s>), the fifth [day], the <s>Vājapeya</s>, and the <s>Aptoryāma</s>.
<7.3.12> (38.12) In this [<s>Sarvamedha</s>], they immolate all [types of] sacrificial victims.
<7.3.13> (38.13) In the final [day] of the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> [cycle], the <s>Viśvajit Atirātra</s> (all-conquering overnight rite) is the tenth [day].

body.text: <7.3.14> (38.14) saṃvatsarānte gārhapatye 'dharāraṇiṃ prahṛtyāhavanīya uttarāraṇim <ayaṃ te yoniḥ [3.20.1]> ity ātmann agniṃ saṃspṛśyāraṇyāya pravrajet ||
body.translated_text: <7.3.14> (38.14) At the end of the year, having placed the lower fire-churning stick on the <s>Gārhapatya</s> and the upper fire-churning stick on the <s>Āhavanīya</s>, with "ayaṃ te yoniḥ" (This is your womb) [3.20.1], having touched <s>Agni</s> upon himself, he should depart for the forest (<s>āraṇya</s>).
<7.3.15> (38.15) Thus [are described] the [great] sacrifices of a <s>Kṣatriya</s> — of a <s>Kṣatriya</s>.
<8.1.1> (39.1) Now the <s>Stotriya</s> variations (modifications of chant-verses).
<8.1.2> (39.2) In single-day (<s>Ekāha</s>) rites, "taṃ te madaṃ gṛṇīmasi" [20.61.1-3].

body.text: <8.1.3> (39.3) bṛhaspatisave <tad vo gāya sute sacā [20.78]> <vayam enam idā hyaḥ [20.97]> iti | savanayor ukthamukhīyatṛcaparyāsau | mādhyandine paryāsādyatṛcavarjam ||
body.translated_text: <8.1.3> (39.3) In the <s>Bṛhaspatisava</s> (pressing dedicated to <s>Bṛhaspati</s>), "tad vo gāya sute sacā" [20.78] and "vayam enam idā hyaḥ" [20.97]. At the two pressings, the <s>Uktha</s>-opening <s>tṛca</s> (verse-triplet) and concluding [verses]; at the midday [pressing], excluding the concluding <s>tṛca</s>.
<8.1.4> (39.4) In the <s>Gosava</s> (cattle rite) and <s>Abhiṣecanīya</s> (consecration), "yuñjanti bradhnam aruṣam" [20.26.4-6].

body.text: <8.1.5> (39.5) śyenasaṃdaṃśājiravajreṣu <surūpakṛtnum ūtaye [20.57.1-3]> <ut tvā mandantu stomāḥ [20.93.1-3]> <tvām id dhi havāmahe [20.98]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <8.1.5> (39.5) In the <s>Śyena</s> (hawk), <s>Saṃdaṃśa</s> (tongs), <s>Ajiravajra</s> (swift-thunderbolt) [rites], "surūpakṛtnum ūtaye" [20.57.1-3], "ut tvā mandantu stomāḥ" [20.93.1-3], and "tvām id dhi havāmahe" [20.98].
<8.1.6> (39.6) In the <s>Apūrva</s> (unprecedented [rite]), "abhi tvā pūrvapītaye" [20.99].

body.text: <8.1.7> (39.7) vrātyastomeṣu <ā tvetā ni ṣīdata []> <adhā hīndra girvaṇaḥ [20.100]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <8.1.7> (39.7) In the <s>Vrātyastomas</s> (rites for the <s>Vrātyas</s>), "ā tvetā ni ṣīdata" and "adhā hīndra girvaṇaḥ" [20.100].

body.text: <8.1.8> (39.8) agniṣṭutsu <īlenyo namasyaḥ [20.102]> <agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe [20.101]> <agnim īliṣvāvase [20.103.1]> <agna ā yāhy agnibhiḥ [20.103.2-3]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <8.1.8> (39.8) In the <s>Agniṣṭuts</s> (praises of <s>Agni</s>), "īlenyo namasyaḥ" [20.102], "agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe" (We choose <s>Agni</s> as messenger) [20.101], "agnim īliṣvāvase" [20.103.1], and "agna ā yāhy agnibhiḥ" [20.103.2-3].

body.text: <8.1.9> (39.9) tīvrasudupaśadopahavyeṣu <ayam u te samatasi [20.45]> <imā u tvā purūvaso [20.104]> iti | vyuṣṭidvyahe ca ||
body.translated_text: <8.1.9> (39.9) In the <s>Tīvrasu</s> (intense pressing), <s>Upaśada</s>, and <s>Upahavya</s> (invocation) [rites], "ayam u te samatasi" [20.45] and "imā u tvā purūvaso" [20.104]; and in the <s>Vyuṣṭidvyaha</s> (two-day dawn rite) as well.

body.text: <8.1.10> (39.10) gosavavivadhavaiśyastomeṣu <indraṃ vo viśvatas pari [20.39.1, 3]> <ā no viśvāsu havya indraḥ [20.104.3-4]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <8.1.10> (39.10) In the <s>Gosava</s>, <s>Vivadha</s>, and <s>Vaiśyastoma</s> (commoner's praise) [rites], "indraṃ vo viśvatas pari" [20.39.1, 3] and "ā no viśvāsu havya indraḥ" [20.104.3-4].
<8.1.11> (39.11) In the <s>Pratīcīnastoma</s> (reversed-praise [rite]), "tvam indra pratūrtiṣu" [20.105.1-2].
<8.1.12> (39.12) In the <s>Rāji</s> (ruling [rite]), "yo rājā carṣaṇīnām" (Who is the king of peoples) [20.105.4-5].
<8.1.13> (39.13) In the <s>Udbhid</s> (bursting forth) and <s>Balabhid</s> (strength-breaking) [rites], "yajña indram avardhayat" [20.27.5, 3; 20.28.1, 2].

body.text: <8.1.14> (39.14) indrastome <indra kratuṃ na ā bhara [20.79]> <tava tyad indriyaṃ bṛhat [20.106]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <8.1.14> (39.14) In the <s>Indrastoma</s> (praise of <s>Indra</s>), "indra kratuṃ na ā bhara" [20.79] and "tava tyad indriyaṃ bṛhat" [20.106].

body.text: <8.1.15> (39.15) vighane <samasya manyave viśaḥ [20.107.1-3]> <tad id āsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭham [20.107.4-6]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <8.1.15> (39.15) In the <s>Vighana</s> (striking [rite]), "samasya manyave viśaḥ" [20.107.1-3] and "tad id āsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭham" [20.107.4-6].

body.text: <8.1.16> (39.16) sūryastuti <ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam [20.47.13-15]> <citraṃ devānāṃ ketur anīkam [20.107.13-15]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <8.1.16> (39.16) In the <s>Sūryastuti</s> (praise of <s>Sūrya</s>), "ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam" [20.47.13-15] and "citraṃ devānāṃ ketur anīkam" [20.107.13-15].

body.text: <8.1.17> (39.17) vajre punaḥstome <tvaṃ na indrā bhara [20.108]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <8.1.17> (39.17) In the <s>Vajra</s> (thunderbolt [rite]) and <s>Punaḥstoma</s> (repeated praise), "tvaṃ na indrā bhara" [20.108].

body.text: <8.1.18> (39.18) sarvajity ṛṣabhe marutstome sāhasrāntye <tad vo gāya sute sacā [20.78]> <vayam enam idā hyaḥ [20.97.1-2]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <8.1.18> (39.18) In the <s>Sarvajit</s> (all-conquering), <s>Ṛṣabha</s> (bull), <s>Marutstoma</s> (praise of the <s>Maruts</s>), and <s>Sāhasrāntya</s> (ending with a thousand) [rites], "tad vo gāya sute sacā" [20.78] and "vayam enam idā hyaḥ" [20.97.1-2].
<8.1.19> (39.19) In the [rites] beginning with <s>Sāhasra</s> (thousandfold), "svādor itthā viṣūvataḥ" [20.109.1-2].

body.text: <8.2.1> (40.1) virāji bhūmistome vanaspatisave tviṣyapacityor indrāgnyoḥ stoma indrāgnyoḥ kulāya <indrāya madvane sutam [20.110]> <yat somam indra viṣṇavi [20.111]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <8.2.1> (40.1) In the <s>Virāji</s> (resplendent [rite]), <s>Bhūmistoma</s> (earth-praise), <s>Vanaspatisava</s> (lord-of-the-forest pressing), <s>Tviṣi</s> and <s>Apaciti</s> (reverence) [rites], and in the <s>Stoma</s> and <s>Kulāya</s> (nest) [rites] of <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>: "indrāya madvane sutam" [20.110] and "yat somam indra viṣṇavi" [20.111].

body.text: <8.2.2> (40.2) virāje 'gneḥ stome 'gneḥ kulāye <agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe [20.101]> <agnim īliṣvāvase [20.103.1-3]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <8.2.2> (40.2) In the <s>Virāji</s> [rite], the <s>Stoma</s> and <s>Kulāya</s> of <s>Agni</s>: "agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe" [20.101] and "agnim īliṣvāvase" [20.103.1-3].

body.text: <8.2.3> (40.3) vinuttyabhibhūtyo rāśimarāyayoḥ śadopaśadayoḥ samrāṭsvarājoḥ <yad adya kac ca vṛtrahan [20.112]> <ubhayaṃ śṛṇavac ca naḥ [20.113]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <8.2.3> (40.3) In the <s>Vinutti</s> (leading away) and <s>Abhibhūti</s> (overpowering) [rites], the <s>Rāśimara</s> and <s>Rāya</s> [rites], the <s>Śada</s> and <s>Upaśada</s> [rites], and the <s>Samrāṭ</s> (sovereign) and <s>Svarāj</s> (self-ruling) [rites]: "yad adya kac ca vṛtrahan" [20.112] and "ubhayaṃ śṛṇavac ca naḥ" [20.113].

body.text: <8.2.4> (40.4) rājasūyeṣu <yat somam indra viṣṇavi [20.111]> <adhā hīndra girvaṇaḥ [20.100]> <abhrātṛvyo anā tvam [20.114]> <tvaṃ na indrā bhara [20.108]> iti ca | caturahapañcāhāhīnadaśāhacchandomadaśāheṣu ca ||
body.translated_text: <8.2.4> (40.4) In the <s>Rājasūya</s> [rites]: "yat somam indra viṣṇavi" [20.111], "adhā hīndra girvaṇaḥ" [20.100], "abhrātṛvyo anā tvam" [20.114], and "tvaṃ na indrā bhara" [20.108]; and in the four-day, five-day, <s>Ahīna</s> (multi-day), ten-day, <s>Chandoma</s> (meter-day), and ten-day [rites] as well.

body.text: <8.2.5> (40.5) tīvrasuccatuḥparyāyayoḥ sāhasrāntyayor daśapeye vibhraṃśayajñe <śrāyanta iva sūryam [20.58.1-3]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <8.2.5> (40.5) In the <s>Tīvrasu</s> (intense pressing) and <s>Catuḥparyāya</s> (four-circuit) [rites], the <s>Sāhasrāntya</s> (ending with a thousand) pair, and in the <s>Daśapeya</s> and <s>Vibhraṃśayajña</s> (scattering sacrifice): "śrāyanta iva sūryam" [20.58.1-3].

body.text: <8.2.6> (40.6) sādyaḥkreṣu śyenavarjam <aham id dhi pituṣ pari [20.115]> iti ca ||
body.translated_text: <8.2.6> (40.6) In the <s>Sādyaḥkra</s> (same-day) [rites], excluding the <s>Śyena</s> (hawk rite): "aham id dhi pituṣ pari" [20.115] as well.

body.text: <8.2.7> (40.7) atirātrāṇāṃ sarvastomayor <mā bhūma niṣṭyā iva [20.116]> <vidhuṃ dadrāṇaṃ salilasya pṛṣṭhe [9.10.9-11]> iti ||
body.translated_text: <8.2.7> (40.7) For all the <s>Atirātras</s> (overnight rites), at both <s>Sarvastomas</s> (all-praise days): "mā bhūma niṣṭyā iva" (May we not be like outcasts) [20.116] and "vidhuṃ dadrāṇaṃ salilasya pṛṣṭhe" [9.10.9-11].

body.text: <8.2.8> (40.8) trivṛtpañcadaśasaptadaśaikaviṃśatriṇavatrayastriṃśanavasaptadaśeṣu <ubhayaṃ śṛṇavac ca naḥ [20.113]> <vayam enam idā hyaḥ [20.97]> <pibā somam indra mandatu tvā [20.117]> iti ||
body.translated_text: In the <s>Trivṛt</s> (nine-fold), <s>Pañcadaśa</s> (fifteen-fold), <s>Saptadaśa</s> (seventeen-fold), <s>Ekaviṃśa</s> (twenty-one-fold), <s>Triṇava</s> (twenty-seven-fold), <s>Trayastriṃśa</s> (thirty-three-fold), <s>Navasaptadaśa</s> [stomas]: "ubhayaṃ śṛṇavac ca naḥ" [20.113], "vayam enam idā hyaḥ" [20.97], "pibā somam indra mandatu tvā" (Drink the <s>Soma</s>, may it delight you, O <s>Indra</s>) [20.117].

body.text: <8.2.9> (40.9) abhijiti <abhi pra gopatiṃ girā [20.22.4-6]> iti ca ||
body.translated_text: At the <s>Abhijit</s> (victory day), "abhi pra gopatiṃ girā" (Approach the lord of cattle with song) [20.22.4-6] as well.
When there is no <s>Atirātra</s> (overnight rite), "abhi tvā vṛṣabhā sute" (O bull, at the pressing) [20.22.1-3].

body.text: <8.2.11> (40.11) caturviṃśe <indrā yāhi citrabhāno [20.84]> <mā cid anyad vi śaṃsata [20.85.1-2]> iti ||
body.translated_text: On the <s>Caturviṃśa</s> (twenty-four-fold) [day], "indrā yāhi citrabhāno" (Come, O <s>Indra</s> of brilliant splendor) [20.84], "mā cid anyad vi śaṃsata" (Do not recite anything else) [20.85.1-2].
At the <s>Viśvajit</s> (all-conquering day), "ya eka id vidayate" (He who alone is known) [20.63.4-6].

body.text: <8.2.13> (40.13) viṣuvati <indra kratuṃ na ā bhara [20.79]> iti ||
body.translated_text: At the <s>Viṣuvat</s> (solstice day), "indra kratuṃ na ā bhara" (O <s>Indra</s>, bring us wisdom) [20.79].

body.text: <8.2.14> (40.14) svarasāmābhiplavagavāyuṣi śeṣeṣu | pṛṣṭhasyaikaviṃśe <indro dadhīco asthabhiḥ [20.41]> <viśvāḥ pṛtanā abhibhūtaraṃ naram [20.54]> <evā hyasi vīrayuḥ [20.60]> iti ||
body.translated_text: In the <s>Svarasāman</s>, <s>Abhiplava</s>, and <s>Gavāyuṣī</s> [days], for the remaining [days]; at the <s>Ekaviṃśa</s> (twenty-one-fold) of the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> [cycle]: "indro dadhīco asthabhiḥ" (<s>Indra</s>, with the bones of <s>Dadhīca</s>) [20.41], "viśvāḥ pṛtanā abhibhūtaraṃ naram" (The man who overcomes all armies) [20.54], "evā hy asi vīrayuḥ" (For thus you are the hero-seeking one) [20.60].

body.text: <8.3.1> (41.1) vyuṣṭyāṅgirasakāpivanacaitrarathadvyahānām <taṃ te madaṃ gṛṇīmasi [20.61]> iti | dvitīyeṣu <viśvāḥ pṛtanā abhibhūtaraṃ naram [20.54]> iti ||
body.translated_text: For the <s>Vyuṣṭi</s>, <s>Āṅgirasa</s>, <s>Kāpivana</s>, <s>Caitraratha</s>, and two-day [rites]: "taṃ te madaṃ gṛṇīmasi" (We praise that rapture of yours) [20.61]. On the second [days], "viśvāḥ pṛtanā abhibhūtaraṃ naram" (The man who overcomes all armies) [20.54].

For the <s>Cāturmāsya</s>, <s>Vaiśvadeva</s>, <s>Garga</s>, <s>Baida</s>, <s>Chandoma</s>, <s>Avatparāka</s>, <s>Antarvasva</s>, and <s>Aśvamedha</s> three-day [rites]: "śagdhy ū ṣu śacīpate" (Prevail now, O lord of might) [20.118.1-2].
Of the <s>Sākamedha</s>, "indram id devatātaye" (<s>Indra</s> alone for divine favor) [20.118.3-4].
Of the <s>Baida</s> and <s>Svarasāman</s>: "tvaṃ na indrā bhara" (O <s>Indra</s>, bring to us) [20.108].

body.text: <8.3.5> (41.5) dvitīyeṣu <tam indraṃ vājayāmasi [20.47.1-3]> <astāvi manma pūrvyam [20.119]> <taṃ te madaṃ gṛṇīmasi [20.61.1-3]> iti ||
body.translated_text: On the second [days]: "tam indraṃ vājayāmasi" (We urge that <s>Indra</s> onward) [20.47.1-3], "astāvi manma pūrvyam" (The ancient hymn has been praised) [20.119], "taṃ te madaṃ gṛṇīmasi" (We praise that rapture of yours) [20.61.1-3].

body.text: <8.3.6> (41.6) aśvamedhasya <vācam aṣṭāpadīm aham [20.42]> <svādor itthā viṣūvataḥ [20.109]> iti ||
body.translated_text: Of the <s>Aśvamedha</s>: "vācam aṣṭāpadīm aham" (I [recite] the eight-footed speech) [20.42], "svādor itthā viṣūvataḥ" (Of the sweet one, thus at the solstice) [20.109].

body.text: <8.3.7> (41.7) pṛṣṭhyatryahasya <evā hy asi vīrayuḥ [20.60.1-3]> ity ukthe ||
body.translated_text: Of the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> three-day rite, "evā hy asi vīrayuḥ" (For thus you are the hero-seeking one) [20.60.1-3] at the <s>Uktha</s> (laudation).

body.text: <8.3.8> (41.8) tṛtīyeṣu <mahā;m indro ya ojasā [20.138]> <abhi pra vaḥ surādhasam [20.51.1-2]> <evā hy asi vīrayuḥ [20.60.1-3]> iti ||
body.translated_text: On the third [days]: "mahām indro ya ojasā" (Great is <s>Indra</s> who by might) [20.138], "abhi pra vaḥ surādhasam" (Approach your bountiful one) [20.51.1-2], "evā hy asi vīrayuḥ" (For thus you are the hero-seeking one) [20.60.1-3].

body.text: <8.3.9> (41.9) sākamedhasya <tam indraṃ vājayāmasi [20.47.1-3]> <śrāyanta iva sūryam [20.58.1-2]> iti ||
body.translated_text: Of the <s>Sākamedha</s>: "tam indraṃ vājayāmasi" (We urge that <s>Indra</s> onward) [20.47.1-3], "śrāyanta iva sūryam" (Like those approaching the sun) [20.58.1-2].

body.text: <8.3.10> (41.10) caturahāṇāṃ <śrāyanta iva sūryam [20.58.1-2]> <tvaṃ na indrā bhara [20.108]> iti ||
body.translated_text: Of the four-day rites: "śrāyanta iva sūryam" (Like those approaching the sun) [20.58.1-2], "tvaṃ na indrā bhara" (O <s>Indra</s>, bring to us) [20.108].

body.text: <8.3.11> (41.11) caturtheṣu <mahā;m indro ya ojasā [20.138]> <ya eka id vidayate [20.63.4-6]> iti ||
body.translated_text: On the fourth [days]: "mahām indro ya ojasā" (Great is <s>Indra</s> who by might) [20.138], "ya eka id vidayate" (He who alone is known) [20.63.4-6].

body.text: <8.3.12> (41.12) sarveṣu <mā bhūma niṣṭyā iva [20.116]> <vidhuṃ dadrāṇaṃ salilasya pṛṣṭhe [9.10.9-11]> iti ||
body.translated_text: In all [rites]: "mā bhūma niṣṭyā iva" (May we not be like outcasts) [20.116], "vidhuṃ dadrāṇaṃ salilasya pṛṣṭhe" (The shining one trembling on the surface of the water) [9.10.9-11].

body.text: <8.3.13> (41.13) saṃsarpacaturvīrayoḥ <ayam u te samatasi [20.45]> <imā u tvā purūvaso [20.104.1-2]> iti ||
body.translated_text: Of the <s>Saṃsarpa</s> and <s>Caturvīra</s> [rites]: "ayam u te samatasi" (This one is equal to you) [20.45], "imā u tvā purūvaso" (These, O you of many gifts) [20.104.1-2].
For five-day rites, beginning with the <s>Trivṛt</s> [stoma] and so forth.

body.text: <8.3.15> (41.15) abhyāsaṅgyapañcaśāradīyayor dvitīye <tvaṃ na indrā bhara [20.108]> iti ||
body.translated_text: Of the <s>Abhyāsaṅgya</s> and <s>Śāradīya</s> [rites], on the second [day]: "tvaṃ na indrā bhara" (O <s>Indra</s>, bring to us) [20.108].
Of the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> five-day rite: "evā hy asi vīrayuḥ" (For thus you are the hero-seeking one) [20.60.1-3].

body.text: <8.3.17> (41.17) pañcame <uttiṣṭhann ojasā saha [20.42]> <indro madāya vāvṛdhe [20.56.1-3]> <indrāya sāma gāyata [20.62.5-7]> iti ||
body.translated_text: On the fifth [day]: "uttiṣṭhann ojasā saha" (Rising together with strength) [20.42], "indro madāya vāvṛdhe" (<s>Indra</s> has grown great for exhilaration) [20.56.1-3], "indrāya sāma gāyata" (Sing the <s>Sāman</s> to <s>Indra</s>) [20.62.5-7].
Of the <s>Abhiplava</s> five-day rite: "ya eka id vidayate" (He who alone is known) [20.63.4-6].
Of the <s>Abhyāsaṅgya</s> and <s>Śāradīya</s> [rites]: "śrāyanta iva sūryam" (Like those approaching the sun) [20.58.1-2].

body.text: <8.3.20> (41.20) ṣaḍahasya gavi <abhrātṛvyo anā tvam [20.114]> iti | āyuṣi <tvaṃ na indrā bhara [20.108]> iti ||
body.translated_text: Of the six-day rite, on the <s>Gava</s> [day]: "abhrātṛvyo anā tvam" (Without a rival kinsman, you) [20.114]. On the <s>Āyuṣī</s> [day]: "tvaṃ na indrā bhara" (O <s>Indra</s>, bring to us) [20.108].
On the fifth [day]: "endra no gadhi priyaḥ" (O <s>Indra</s>, come to us, beloved) [20.64.1-3].

body.text: <8.3.22> (41.22) ṣaṣṭham ukthyaṃ cet <ya eka id vidayate [20.63.4-6]> <yat somam indra viṣṇavi [20.111]> iti ||
body.translated_text: If the sixth [day] is an <s>Ukthya</s> (laudation day): "ya eka id vidayate" (He who alone is known) [20.63.4-6], "yat somam indra viṣṇavi" (When you drink the <s>Soma</s>, O <s>Indra</s>, with <s>Viṣṇu</s>) [20.111].

body.text: <8.4.1> (42.1) pṛṣṭhasya dvitīye <evā hy asi vīrayuḥ [20.60.1-3]> iti ||
body.translated_text: Of the <s>Pṛṣṭhya</s> [cycle], on the second [day]: "evā hy asi vīrayuḥ" (For thus you are the hero-seeking one) [20.60.1-3].

body.text: <8.4.2> (42.2) tṛtīye <indreṇa saṃ hi dṛkṣase [20.40]> <vayaṃ gha tvā sutāvantaḥ [20.52]> <tvaṃ na indrā bhara [20.108]> iti ||
